items.name: Phang Nga Bay: James Bond Island and sea caves
items.nameThai: อ่าวพังงา เกาะเขาพิงกัน
items.coordSource: wikipedia (Khao Phing Kan) + photon/osm islet way 23492416 + Commons Ko Tapu photo geotag, all within 90 m
items.gmapsQuery: James Bond Island, Phang Nga
items.description: A calm bay full of tall limestone islands. Tours stop at James Bond Island (Khao Phing Kan and the Ko Tapu rock), take you by canoe into sea caves and hidden lagoons at Panak or Hong island, and stop for lunch at Koh Panyee, a Muslim fishing village on stilts.
items.feeText: Group tour about 1,400-4,600 THB per person: longtail 1,400-1,800, big boat 1,500-2,800, speedboat 1,700-2,900, small-group or early tours 4,000-4,600 (Love Andaman, Simba, Oct 2026). Park fee 300 THB (child 150) in most 2026 sources; Phuket 101 says 400. It is usually included in the tour.
items.bestTime: Take an early tour (start 7:00-8:30). Boats crowd the islands 10:00-14:00. December to March is the busiest time.
items.gettingThere: Hotel pickup, then a 45-60 min drive to Ao Po (Ao Por) Pier or Royal Phuket Marina on the east coast. Some longtail tours use Bang Rong Pier. Back at the hotel about 17:00-18:00.
tips: You cannot swim at James Bond Island, and boats cannot land on the Ko Tapu rock. Tours stop to swim at other islands.
In the caves a guide paddles the canoe for you. Check that canoeing is included.
At Koh Panyee, walk past the main souvenir walkway to see real village life. See its card.
Speedboats spend less time on the water and more time at the islands.
The Hong by Starlight trip also passes James Bond Island (seen from the boat only), so you may not need both.
No alcohol or smoking inside the national park. Boat crews can be fined for their guests.
items.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. Park fee 300 THB: Thai Holiday Guide (Jul 2026), Siam Tour and Realty (Aug 2026, 300/150) and Simba Sea Trips (2026, 300/150); Phuket 101 (26 Sep 2026) alone says 400/200, so 300 now leads. No landing on Ko Tapu: Thai Holiday Guide (Jul 2026). Tour prices, piers and swim rule: Phuket 101 (26 Sep 2026). E-tickets planned for this park from 15 Oct 2025 (Asian Trails, May 2025), but cash is still common at piers (Siam Tour and Realty, Oct 2026). Alcohol rule: National Park Act 2019 (The Phuket News, Apr 2025). Coords unchanged.
items.openText: Tours run daily in the dry season. The park is open in January.

items.name: Hong by Starlight: evening sea-canoe trip
items.nameThai: เกาะห้อง อ่าวพังงา
items.coordSource: wikidata (Ko Hong, Ko Yao district) + photon/osm islet way 23492452 + thaiholidayguide map link, all within 120 m
items.gmapsQuery: Hong Island, Phang Nga Bay, Phang Nga
items.description: John Gray's Sea Canoe runs this trip from midday into the night. You pass James Bond Island (from the boat), then guides paddle you into sea caves and hidden lagoons at Panak and Hong islands. You make a krathong (small floating offering), eat a Thai buffet at sunset, then paddle in the dark to see glowing plankton.
items.feeText: From 3,950 THB per adult (official site). Hotel transfer, light lunch, buffet dinner, park fees and travel insurance are included.
items.openText: Daily. Pickup about 10:20-11:15, back at the hotel about 21:00-21:30.
items.bestTime: Plankton glows best on dark nights. New moon is Fri 8 Jan 2027, so book early in your trip and skip the full-moon days around Fri 22 Jan.
items.gettingThere: Hotel pickup in Phuket. The boat leaves from Ao Po (Ao Por) Pier in north-east Phuket.
tips: The order of stops can change with the tide.
Bring swimwear: there is time to paddle and swim in the afternoon.
A private-charter version of the same trip is sold from 62,750 THB for 1-12 people.
Other companies sell similar sunset canoe and plankton trips from about 3,300 THB (for example Tisland 'Shine of Andaman').
items.verification: Official tour page (checked 15 Oct 2026): from 3,950 THB, daily, Ao Po, pickup 10:20-11:15, hotel 21:00-21:30, includes lunch, buffet dinner, park fees, insurance; itinerary passes James Bond Island; private charter from 62,750 THB. Tisland lists 'Shine of Andaman' from 3,300 THB. New moon computed: 7 Jan 2027 20:24 UTC (8 Jan 03:24 Thai time).

items.name: Phi Phi Islands and Maya Bay
items.nameThai: หมู่เกาะพีพี อ่าวมาหยา
items.coordSource: osm (viewpoint node 5314772921 'Maya Bay' on the beach) + about 15 Commons photos geotagged on Maya Bay beach, within 40 m
items.gmapsQuery: Maya Bay, Ko Phi Phi Le, Krabi
items.description: The famous islands 45-60 min by speedboat from Phuket. Tours visit Maya Bay (from the film The Beach), Pileh Lagoon, Viking Cave, snorkel spots and often Bamboo Island. At Maya Bay boats stop at a pier in Loh Samah Bay and you walk in. Swimming is banned there: knee-deep wading only.
items.feeText: Group speedboat tour about 1,500-3,500 THB; early or sunrise tours about 3,700-5,310 THB (Simba 5,310 with max 18 guests, Phuket Sail Tours 4,400, Oct 2026). Park fee 400 THB (child 200). The park has sold e-tickets since Oct 2025, but cash is still taken at most piers. Some tours add the fee on top, so ask. Private speedboat about 15,000-37,500 THB per boat; all-inclusive boats for up to 10 cost about 37,500 THB.
items.openText: Maya Bay about 07:00-18:00. Closed every year 1 Aug - 30 Sep, so it is open in January.
items.bestTime: Choose an early-departure or sunrise tour to reach Maya Bay before the main crowds.
items.gettingThere: Hotel pickup 6:30-7:30 to Rassada Pier (Phuket Town) or Royal Phuket Marina. Back about 16:00-17:00. Public boats Rassada - Tonsai leave 08:30-15:30: ferry about 2 h, 450-700 THB; speedboat about 1 h, 750-900 THB.
tips: Maya Bay takes up to 375 people per hour. Expect 30-60 minutes on the beach.
Sunscreen with oxybenzone, octinoxate, 4MBC or butylparaben is banned in Thai national parks (fines up to 100,000 THB).
No alcohol or smoking in the park. In April 2025 a boat driver was fined 10,000 THB after his guests drank and smoked at Pileh Lagoon.
Tours may ask for your passport number for the park ticket. Carry a copy of your passport.
For seasickness, take a pill 30 minutes before and sit at the back of the boat.
Staying a night on Phi Phi Don? Speedboats back to Phuket leave Tonsai until about 17:00. The last big ferries go at about 14:30-15:30.
items.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. Boats: phuketferry.com timetables (19 Oct 2026): Rassada to Tonsai 08:30-15:30, ferries 450-600 THB (PP Cabana 755), speedboats 800-900; Tonsai to Rassada until 17:00 (Bundhaya speedboat), last ferries 14:30-15:30. Visit Thailand Today (6 Oct 2026): ferries 500-700, speedboats 750-850, speedboats back until about 17:00. Phuket 101 (12 Apr 2026): tour, sunrise and private-boat prices, 400/200 fee, last ferry about 15:30. Tisland (28 Sep 2026): Maya Bay 375 per hour, wading only, Loh Samah pontoon, sunscreen ban. E-tickets since 15 Oct 2025 (Asian Trails, May 2025; Tisland, Sep 2026), but Siam Tour and Realty (Oct 2026) says the rollout is phased and most piers still take cash, so the fee and passport texts were softened. Pileh fine: The Phuket News (incident 26 Apr 2025). Coords unchanged.

items.name: Similan Islands
items.nameThai: หมู่เกาะสิมิลัน
items.coordSource: osm beach 'Ao Kueak' (= Donald Duck Bay, Island 8) + google maps 'Donald Duck Bay', 24 m apart; Sail Rock viewpoint node 180 m north
items.gmapsQuery: Donald Duck Bay, Similan Islands, Phang Nga
items.description: A national park of granite islands about 60 km off the Khao Lak coast, with the clearest water and best snorkelling near Phuket. You climb Sail Rock on Island 8 for the famous view of Donald Duck Bay, snorkel between islands and have lunch on Island 4. Open 15 Oct 2026 to 15 May 2027.
items.feeText: Day tour from Phuket about 2,500-3,800 THB by speedboat, 3,600-5,650 THB by catamaran, with transfer, lunch and park fee. Park fee alone: 500 THB (child 250), as an e-ticket bought ahead or before 08:00 on the day; tours buy it for you. 2-day snorkel trips that sleep on a boat from about 9,400 THB.
items.openText: Season 15 Oct 2026 - 15 May 2027. Day visits only: sleeping on the islands is banned. A liveaboard boat is the only legal way to stay overnight.
items.bestTime: January is ideal for sea and sun but very busy. Take an early-departure tour.
items.gettingThere: Long day. Hotel pickup in Phuket about 05:30-07:00 (early tours 03:00-04:30). Thap Lamu Pier is about 100 km from Patong: 1.5-2 h by van (about 70 min from the airport area). Check-in about 08:00, then 1 h 15 min - 1 h 30 min by speedboat. Back at the pier 16:30-17:30 and in Phuket in the evening.
tips: Only 3,325 day visitors (plus 525 divers) are allowed per day, shared by all tour companies. Book ahead.
Avoid the cheapest speedboats: they are crowded. Mid-range boats have shade and space.
Entry is registered by name. Send your passport details when you book and carry a copy.
Do not feed fish, touch coral or take shells. Rangers give fines.
No alcohol on the islands, and no card payments. Bring cash.
Koh Tachai (Island 11) has been closed to landings since 2016, with no reopening date. Tours cannot take you onto its beach.
The ride is much shorter if you stay in Khao Lak.
items.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. Season 15 Oct 2026 - 15 May 2027: Naewna (Thai news, 14 Oct 2026), Tisland (21 Sep 2026), Siam Tour and Realty (15 Oct 2026: parks open). Tisland: quota 3,850 = 3,325 + 525 divers, 500/250 THB, e-ticket via QueQ or e-ticket.dnp.go.th before 08:00, entry registered by name, no sleeping on the islands, no card payments, snorkel liveaboard from 9,400 THB. Tisland tour list (Oct 2026): speedboat tours 2,500-3,800 THB, catamaran 3,600-5,650, fee included. Koh Tachai closed indefinitely, no date announced (Siam Tour and Realty, 15 Oct 2026). Alcohol ban: National Park Act 2019 (The Phuket News, Apr-May 2025). Coords unchanged.

items.name: Koh Racha Yai
items.nameThai: เกาะราชาใหญ่
items.coordSource: google maps 'Patok Beach' (75 m) + osm 'Pa Tok Beach' relation (50 m); The Racha resort pin 150 m east. Pin = Patok Bay beach
items.gmapsQuery: Patok Beach, Racha Yai Island, Phuket
items.description: A hilly island 30-45 min by speedboat south of Phuket, with white sand and very clear water. Day boats land at Patok Bay, where you can snorkel straight from the beach. A short walk leads to quieter Siam Bay. Many tours combine Racha with Coral Island.
items.feeText: Racha + Coral speedboat tour from about 1,300 THB per person with lunch. No national park fee.
items.bestTime: November to April has calm sea and clear water. Day boats arrive from about 10:00. The island empties around 16:00.
items.gettingThere: Hotel pickup 7:00-9:00 to Chalong Pier, then speedboat 30-45 min (big boats 60-90 min). Back at the pier about 15:30-16:30.
tips: Bring a towel: Patok Bay has no public sunbeds.
Bring your own mask if you have one. Rental masks often leak.
Stay a night at a Patok Bay resort to have the beach almost to yourself after 16:00.
Divers: manta rays pass Racha Noi from January to March.
items.verification: Phuket 101 (26 Sep 2026): no public loungers at Patok, island empties about 16:00, mantas Jan-Mar, The Racha open. Tisland (Oct 2026): from 1,300 THB, pickup 07:00-09:00, arrive 10:00, back at pier 15:30-16:30. No park fee: Thai Holiday Guide (Jul 2026). Coords: Google + OSM agree; old gmapsQuery landed on the island centre 450 m away.

items.name: Coral Island (Koh Hey)
items.nameThai: เกาะเฮ
items.coordSource: osm 'Hat Yao' (Long Beach) relation centre + google maps 'Long Beach' pin, 75 m apart
items.gmapsQuery: Coral Island (Koh Hey), Phuket
items.description: A small island only 15 min by speedboat from Chalong or Rawai. Most boats land at busy Long Beach with restaurants, sunbeds and water sports. Banana Beach, further east, is quieter and is mostly visited with its own day packages. Easy snorkelling near the shore. A short and cheap escape.
items.feeText: Free entry. Speedboat tour with lunch 1,100-2,200 THB per person. Banana Beach packages from 1,900 THB. Longtail from Rawai 1,500-2,000 THB per boat. Sunbeds and water sports cost extra.
items.bestTime: November to April has the calmest water. Long Beach is busiest from late morning to early afternoon.
items.gettingThere: Speedboat from Chalong Pier or Rawai Beach (about 15 min), or a shared or private longtail from Rawai.
tips: For a quieter beach, book a boat or package that lands at Banana Beach.
Often sold together with Racha Yai as one full-day trip.
items.verification: Thai Holiday Guide (Jul 2026): free entry, 15 min crossing, tour and longtail prices, Long Beach busiest late morning. Tisland from 1,100 THB (Oct 2026). Banana Beach packages 1,900-3,300 THB on its official site (2026). No source and no OSM path confirm a walk between the beaches, so that tip was removed. Coords: OSM + Google agree.

items.name: Khai Islands (Koh Khai Nok)
items.nameThai: เกาะไข่นอก
items.coordSource: wikidata (Ko Khai Nok) + photon/osm + google maps 'Koh Khai Nok' (31 m), all within 120 m
items.gmapsQuery: Koh Khai Nok, Phang Nga
items.description: Three tiny islands 15-20 min by speedboat from Phuket's east coast. Khai Nok has a white beach with bars and sunbeds. Khai Nai is the largest, with long, shallow sand. Khai Nui has no beach but the best reef: you snorkel from the boat. Short, easy and cheap, but always busy.
items.feeText: Half-day speedboat tour about 1,100 THB (child 900), with transfer, snorkel gear and entry fees. Full day with another island about 1,250 THB. Private speedboat 2,500-5,000 THB. Sunbeds 150 THB for two, free with a food order.
items.bestTime: Leave early in the morning, before the tour groups. November to April is calmest.
items.gettingThere: Hotel pickup to Chalong Pier, Ao Po Pier or Royal Phuket Marina, then 15-20 min by speedboat.
tips: Feeding fish is banned. Rangers give fines.
Keep your life jacket on at Khai Nui: the current can be strong.
Boats skip Khai Nui when the sea is rough.
items.verification: Phuket 101 (updated 29 Aug 2026) for prices, sunbeds, fish-feeding ban and Khai Nui current. No closure news found in English or Thai searches (Oct 2026); Google listing active (1,329 reviews). Coords: Wikidata, OSM and Google agree. The only link was a Phuket 101 guide; no official page exists.

items.name: Koh Yao Noi
items.nameThai: เกาะยาวน้อย
items.coordSource: wikidata + osm island relation label point, 60 m apart (island centre). Google's island pin is 2.5 km south-west; Manoh Pier (arrival) is at 8.0935, 98.5872 (osm + google, 15 m)
items.gmapsQuery: Koh Yao Noi, Phang Nga
items.description: A quiet, green island in Phang Nga Bay, 30 min by speedboat from Phuket. Rent a scooter, ride past rice fields and small villages, swim at Pasai or Klong Jark beach and kayak to Koh Nok. Views over the limestone islands of the bay. Mostly Muslim and not a party island: a real break.
items.feeText: Speedboat about 300-500 THB per person each way (price differs by seller and online). Slow longtail about 300 THB. Scooter 250-350 THB a day. Kayak about 300 THB for a few hours.
items.openText: Speedboats from Bang Rong Pier about 08:40-17:00 (longtail 12:30). Boats back from Manoh Pier about 06:35-16:00: the last one is about 16:00.
items.bestTime: Take the first boat (08:40). Better: stay one or two nights.
items.gettingThere: Grab or taxi to Bang Rong Pier (north-east Phuket, about 17 km and 20-40 min from the airport). Speedboat 30-40 min, or the slow longtail at 12:30 (1 h), to Manoh Pier. Taxis and songthaews wait at the pier.
tips: Dress modestly in the villages. Not every shop sells alcohol.
Kayak to Koh Nok early, at high tide. The afternoon sea is choppy.
Koh Hong (Krabi) is about 20 min by longtail from Klong Jark Beach (about 800 THB per person in 2024).
Bring enough cash. ATMs can run out on busy weekends.
Phuket 101 says two nights is the minimum to enjoy the island.
items.verification: Phuket 101 (27 Aug 2026): about 300 THB, first boat 08:40, last 17:00, longtail 12:30, scooter and kayak prices, ATM tip. Camphadee timetable (Nov 2025): speedboat 400 THB, longtail 300, last boat from Manoh 16:00. Ferryscanner (Sep 2026): Manoh departures 06:35-16:00, EUR 8.70-12.27. Siamtickets lists 400-500 THB. Drive time by OSRM.

items.name: Koh Hong (Krabi): lagoon island
items.nameThai: เกาะห้อง กระบี่
items.coordSource: wikidata (Ko Hong, Krabi) + google maps 'Ko Hong' island (63 m) and 'Hong Lagoon' (65 m); Commons lagoon photo GPS within 120 m
items.gmapsQuery: Hong Island, Krabi
items.description: A limestone island between Koh Yao Noi and Krabi. Boats go into a shallow lagoon ringed by tall cliffs, and there are two white-sand beaches with clear water. Steep stairs lead to a viewpoint. It is part of a national park and is busy from late morning.
items.feeText: Park fee 300 THB per adult (child 150). Most tours collect it in cash at the entry point; the park has also sold e-tickets since Oct 2025. From Koh Yao Noi: longtail about 800 THB per person (2024). From Krabi or Ao Nang: group speedboat tours about 1,350-1,500 THB.
items.bestTime: Go early. Tour boats from Krabi arrive in the late morning.
items.gettingThere: From Phuket, some speedboat island tours include Hong (Krabi); ask for it by name. Or stay on Koh Yao Noi and take a longtail (about 20 min) from Klong Jark Beach.
tips: No alcohol and no drones on the island.
Expect a long, bouncy floating pier to reach the beach.
Koh Pakbia, nearby, is a good picnic stop.
Do not mix it up with Koh Hong in Phang Nga Bay (Hong by Starlight trip).

links.label: Than Bok Khorani National Park (official Facebook)

items.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. Fee 300/150 THB: Simba Sea Trips (2026), Siam Tour and Realty (Aug 2026) and 2026 Krabi tour listings, which say it is paid at the point of entry and not included. E-tickets at Than Bok Khorani park from 15 Oct 2025 (Asian Trails, May 2025; Tisland, Sep 2026), but a phased rollout with cash still common (Siam Tour and Realty, Oct 2026), so the cash note was kept. Phuket 101 Koh Hong page (May 2024): longtail from Klong Jark about 20 min and 800 THB, no alcohol or drones. Krabi tours 1,350-1,500 THB (Baolau, AAA). Coords: OSM islet relation 5805205 centre 95 m from the pin.

items.name: Railay Beach (Krabi)
items.nameThai: ไร่เลย์
items.coordSource: osm West Railay beach relation centre (nominatim) + google maps 'Railay Beach' (19 m); google 'Railay West Beach' pin is 200 m north on the same beach
items.gmapsQuery: Railay Beach West, Krabi
items.description: A beach area in Krabi with no roads, closed in by huge limestone cliffs, so you arrive by boat. West Railay is a beautiful sunset beach and Phra Nang Cave Beach is close by. Famous for rock climbing. A direct ferry from Phuket makes a long day trip possible, but one or two nights is better.
items.feeText: Speedboat Phuket - Railay about 500-1,300 THB one way online, depending on the boat and the seller (phuketferry.com and Ferryscanner, Oct 2026).
items.openText: Boats to Railay leave Phuket about 08:30-15:00 from Rassada, Bang Rong or Laem Hin pier (1 h 20 min - 2 h 30 min). Back from Railay about 09:20-15:15.
items.bestTime: For a day trip take the first ferry. If you stay, watch sunset at West Railay (about 18:25 in mid-January).
items.gettingThere: Speedboat from Rassada Pier (Phuket Town), or from Bang Rong or Laem Hin pier on the east coast, to Railay East floating pier. Then a short walk to West Railay. Longtails link Railay with Ao Nang and Krabi Town.
tips: Book the ferry early: online prices rise close to the date.
Be at the pier 60 minutes before departure.
There are no night ferries back to Phuket.
The Krabi 4 Islands trip (Poda, Chicken, Tup) picks up in Railay and Ao Nang. See its card.
items.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. phuketferry.com (19 Oct 2026): to Railay East from Bang Rong 09:30 and 15:00, Rassada 11:00, 12:00 and 13:30, Laem Hin 13:00, 1 h 30 min - 2 h 30 min; back 09:20-13:40 to Laem Hin, Bang Rong or Rassada; current fares 500-900 THB (crossed-out 1,000-1,160, so the old 1,000-1,160 figure was the list price). Ferryscanner (9 Oct 2026): Rassada departures 08:30-13:30, EUR 17.65-36.08 (about 660-1,360 THB), Railay departures until 15:15. Coords unchanged.

items.name: Khao Sok: Cheow Lan Lake overnight
items.nameThai: เขื่อนเชี่ยวหลาน
items.coordSource: google maps 'Ratchaprapha Marina' + 'Cheow Lan Pier (Ratchaprapha Pier)' + osm pier ways, within 80 m. Old pin (dam viewpoint) was 1.6 km west of the boat pier
items.gmapsQuery: Cheow Lan Pier (Ratchaprapha Pier), Ban Ta Khun, Surat Thani
items.description: A huge jungle lake with limestone cliffs in Khao Sok National Park. Longtail boats take you from the dam pier to floating raft houses. You sleep on the water, swim, and kayak in the morning mist. A 1-day tour exists but is very long (about 15 hours), so one night is better.
items.feeText: 1-day tour from Phuket from 3,500 THB; 2 days / 1 night from 7,900 THB (park fees included). Lake fee alone: 300 THB (child 150).
items.openText: Boats run only between sunrise and sunset.
items.bestTime: January to March is the dry season.
items.gettingThere: Tour pickup in Phuket 05:00-06:30. The 1-day tour reaches the lake about 10:00 and is back about 19:30-20:30. The pier is about 155 km by road from Phuket Airport (about 3 h). All boats leave from Ratchaprapha Pier at the dam.
tips: Some raft houses are up to 1 h 20 min by boat from the pier.
Basic raft houses often have power only in the evening.
Boats are limited in high season, so book ahead.
On the lake, mobile signal works mainly on AIS.
items.verification: thainationalparks.com (fees as of June 2026): lake 300/150 THB, boats only sunrise-sunset, raft houses up to 1 h 20 min, evening power, AIS signal, boat shortages into 2026. Tisland (Oct 2026): 1-day 3,500 THB, pickup 05:00-06:30, lake 10:00, back 19:30-20:30; 2D1N 7,900 THB. Road distance by OSRM. Pin moved to the boat pier (Google + OSM).

items.name: Samet Nangshe viewpoint (sunrise)
items.nameThai: จุดชมวิวเสม็ดนางชี
items.coordSource: osm viewpoint node + Commons photo GPS (13 Apr 2026) + second google listing 'Samet Nangshe Viewpoint' (40 m). The main google listing pins the car park / truck stop 860 m south-east
items.gmapsQuery: Samet Nangshe Viewpoint, Takua Thung, Phang Nga
items.description: A hilltop viewpoint over Phang Nga Bay: green mangroves and dozens of limestone islands in the morning mist. Come for sunrise. From the car park you walk up about 20 minutes or take a pickup truck. There are two viewpoints on the way up.
items.feeText: 30 THB on foot, 90 THB return by pickup truck (entry included). Sunrise tour from Phuket about 2,200-2,400 THB.
items.openText: Opens about 05:00-05:30 every day.
items.bestTime: Arrive by 05:30-06:00. Sunrise in January is about 06:45; the sky gets light from about 06:20.
items.gettingThere: About 50 km (1 h) by car from Phuket Airport, about 80 km (1.5-2 h) from Patong. Cross the Sarasin Bridge and drive north to Takua Thung. Sunrise tours pick up about 04:00.
tips: Private cars must stop at the bottom car park. Google Maps' main pin is this car park and truck stop.
Wear real shoes and bring water. The path is steep and has no shade.
Sleep at the top in a tent (about 130 THB) or a bungalow (500-700 THB) to skip the night drive.
The small platforms fill up fast on clear mornings, especially at weekends.
items.verification: Fees 30/90 THB: Thai Holiday Guide (Jul 2026) and Phuket 101 (Mar 2026) agree; opening 05:00 or 05:30. Two viewpoints about 800 m apart (Thai Holiday Guide); no source says which is better, so that claim was removed. Tour from 2,400 THB, pickup about 04:00 (Tisland, Oct 2026). Sunrise computed: 06:43-06:45. Distances by OSRM.

items.name: Koh Phangan rave trip (2-5 days)
items.nameThai: เกาะพะงัน
items.coordSource: google maps 'OXA - Jungle Party' (address 72/52 Moo 2 Ban Tai matches Megatix). Halfmoon Magic Forest is 480 m south-west (osm + google). Old pin was on Ban Tai beach, 2.3 km south of the party area
items.gmapsQuery: OXA - Jungle Party, Ban Tai, Koh Phangan
items.description: Thailand's party island, in the Gulf. Most jungle raves are inland near Ban Tai. With the group: OXA (Fri 8 and 15 Jan), Lost Jungle psytrance (Sat 9 to Mon 11) and Halfmoon (Fri 15 - Sat 16). In full-moon week: OXA (Tue 19), Waterfall (Wed 20), Jungle Experience (Thu 21) and the Full Moon Party (Fri 22 Jan).
items.feeText: Flight Phuket - Samui about 4,700-4,900 THB one way (Oct 2026), plus the boat. Bus + boat about 600-1,800 THB (Phantip about 600-900, Lomprayah 1,400-1,800). Party tickets: OXA from 500 THB; Halfmoon about 1,500-3,500 THB at the gate (online often a bit less).
items.bestTime: Two good windows. With the group: Sun 10 to Wed 13 Jan (Lost Jungle until 11 Jan, Chill Up on Mon 11, the Lighthouse Party on Tue 12). For the two of you: Tue 19 to Sat 23 Jan, the full-moon week, then fly back for the last Circoloco on Sat 23. See Info, Koh Phangan full-moon week.
items.gettingThere: Fastest: Bangkok Airways Phuket - Koh Samui (about 1 h, 8 flights a day; take one at 14:15 or earlier to catch the boats), then a 20-60 min boat (Lomprayah or Seatran) to Thong Sala Pier. Budget: bus + boat via Donsak, about 7-9 h: Lomprayah from its Phuket office at 09:30 (or a 07:30 hotel pickup) to Thong Sala at 16:30, 1,400-1,800 THB, or Phantip from Bus Terminal 2 at 08:00, about 600-900 THB.
tips: Bring cash. Party bars are cash only and OXA has no ATM.
Bring your passport: Halfmoon checks ID, and some ticket sites say 20+.
Eden Garden on Haad Yuan has deep house and techno on Saturdays. Taxi boat from Haad Rin about 400 THB.
Night taxis charge per car, so share a ride.
Small underground nights post dates only 1-3 weeks ahead. Check RA and phangan.events in December.
Full-moon week (20-24 Jan): rooms cost 2-3 times more and many ask for a 3-5 night minimum. Book in October or November. Ban Tai is the best base.
items.verification: Halfmoon official 2027 chart: beach party Fri 15 Jan (14:00-24:00), main night Sat 16 Jan (from 21:30). OXA Fri 8 and Fri 15 Jan, 21:00-05:00, from 500 THB, cash only (Megatix). Lost Jungle Sat 9 Jan 18:00 to Mon 11 Jan about 17:00 (organiser ticket shop on Vibez, Oct 2026). phangan.events still shows Sat 12:00. Circoloco 9, 16, 23 Jan (EDM House Network, Aug 2026). Halfmoon prices: Thai Holiday Guide (Oct 2026). Transport: Direct Ferries and Cheapflights (Oct 2026). Full Moon 22 Jan is a projected date.

items.name: One Chun
items.coordSource: google maps listing (3 m) + phuket101 map link + wanderlog + Commons photo GPS, within 20 m; michelin geo 65 m
items.gmapsQuery: One Chun Cafe & Restaurant, Thep Krasattri Road, Phuket Town
items.description: Phuket family recipes in an old Old Town shophouse with vintage decor. Order the crab meat yellow curry with rice noodles, moo hong (sweet braised pork belly) and fried prawns in tamarind sauce. Michelin Bib Gourmand 2026.
items.feeText: Dishes about 120-390 THB (crab curry 390, moo hong 265; 2024 menu).
items.openText: 10:00-22:00 daily (Tue until 21:00).
items.bestTime: Lunch, then walk around the Old Town.
tips: Raya, the famous older restaurant with the same Phuket dishes, is a few steps away at 48/1 Dibuk Road (Google lists 11:00-21:00). Its main rooms have no air-con, and it left the Michelin guide in 2026.
Ask for less spicy if you are not used to Thai chili.
items.verification: Michelin page data says Bib Gourmand 2026; on the Phuket Bib list (15 Oct 2026). Hours: Google and Michelin agree (Tue to 21:00); Google listing active (6,708 reviews). Prices: Phuket 101 (Dec 2024). Raya: Phuket 101 (11 Sep 2026) says dropped from the 2026 guide; Google hours 11:00-21:00 (Phuket 101 says 10:00-22:00). Instagram from the restaurant's own link page.

items.name: Mee Ton Poe (Hokkien noodles)
items.nameThai: หมี่ต้นโพธิ์
items.coordSource: google maps listing (3 m) + osm (nominatim/photon 'Mee Ton Poh') + wanderlog, within 5 m
items.gmapsQuery: MeeTonPoe Phuket Town, Phuket Road
items.description: Phuket's best-known Hokkien noodle shop, cooking since 1946 at the clock tower circle in Phuket Town. The classic is mee Hokkien: thick yellow noodles fried with pork, seafood and greens in a rich gravy, topped with a soft egg. Add pork satay. Simple, fast and cheap.
items.feeText: Cheap: mee Hokkien with egg about 80 THB, Phuket fish balls 80 THB, hor mok 20 THB (Wongnai review, Mar 2026).
items.openText: Phuket Town shop 09:30-18:30 daily.
items.bestTime: Breakfast or lunch.
tips: One plate is usually enough. Order a second if you are hungry.
The shop next door serves the same noodles as a soup.
Other branches: Mee Ton Poe 2 in Kathu and Mee Ton Poe 4 on Thep Krasattri Road in Thalang (both open until about 20:00).
items.verification: Google listing active, 09:30-18:30 every day (Google data fetched 15 Oct 2026). Since 1946, dishes, next-door soup shop and branch hours: Phuket 101 (May 2024); the Kathu and Thalang branches are still listed on Google. Prices from a Wongnai review dated 18 Mar 2026 (old 35-60 THB figure replaced).

items.name: Lock Tien (Phuket street dishes)
items.nameThai: ลกเที้ยน
items.coordSource: google maps listing 'ลกเที้ยน original (Lock Tien Local Food Phuket)', 59/14 Bangkok Rd (0 m) + phuket101 page geo
items.gmapsQuery: ลกเที้ยน original, 59/14 Bangkok Rd, Phuket
items.description: A Phuket Town classic for local Hokkien-Chinese dishes in one place: fried Hokkien noodles, fresh spring rolls (popia sot), o-tao (taro and oyster omelette), lo ba (fried pork and tofu) and o-aew jelly dessert. It has moved from its old corner food court to a shophouse on Bangkok Road.
items.feeText: Cheap local prices (dish prices not published).
items.bestTime: Lunch or an afternoon snack.
tips: Old maps still show the closed food court on Yaowarat Road. Go to 59/14 Bangkok Road, opposite the Government Housing Bank.
Paid parking (20 THB) opposite the bank, or free spaces on Bangkok Road.
It is now one kitchen with one menu, not separate stalls. Point at the photos on the awning to order.
items.verification: Phuket 101 (24 Aug 2026): new shop at 59/14 Bangkok Rd, 09:00-19:00 daily, old corner permanently closed. Google now lists the new shop (4.9 stars, 124 reviews, 09:00-19:00 daily) and marks the old Yaowarat Rd listing as closed. Old gmapsQuery landed on a generic building pin; new one lands on the shop. Phuket 101 link removed (not official).

items.name: Go Benz (late-night rice soup)
items.coordSource: google maps listing (14 m) + michelin geo + wanderlog + photon/osm, within 20 m
items.gmapsQuery: Go Benz Rice Porridge, Krabi Road, Phuket Town
items.description: A corner shop open at night, known for kuay jap (rolled rice noodles in peppery pork broth) and khao tom (rice soup), with crispy pork belly on the side. Open until about 1:30 at night, so it is perfect after a party. Michelin Bib Gourmand every year since 2019.
items.feeText: Dishes 50-90 THB (rice soup or kuay jap 50, crispy pork 60-90). Drinks 20 THB. Cash only.
items.openText: Tue-Sun 17:00-01:30. Closed Mon and on Buddhist holy days (in your dates: Fri 15 and Fri 22 Jan).
items.bestTime: Peak is 19:00-21:00 with a 20-30 min queue. Quieter after 21:30 and after midnight.
tips: Take any free seat; staff come to take your order.
The dry rice soup with crispy pork and offal often sells out.
Parking is hard. Come by Grab or taxi.
items.verification: Michelin page data: Bib Gourmand 2026, 163 Krabi Rd. Google hours (fetched 15 Oct 2026): Tue-Sun 17:00-01:30, Mon closed. Phuket 101 (11 Sep 2026): 19:00-02:00, closed on Buddhist holy days, prices, cash only, Bib Gourmand 2019-2026. Kapook calendar lists Fri 15 Jan 2027 as a Buddhist holy day.

items.name: Naam Yoi (Southern Thai curries)
items.coordSource: google maps listing (0 m) + phuket101 map link + michelin geo + wanderlog, within 5 m
items.gmapsQuery: Nam YOI Restaurant, Rumpattana Road, Ratsada, Phuket
items.description: A small, simple local place known for rich, very aromatic Southern Thai curries, cooked to order with produce bought at dawn. Try kaeng som (sour fish curry with tamarind) and kaeng pa (jungle curry). No English menu and plastic chairs, but real local flavour. Michelin Bib Gourmand 2026.
items.feeText: Cheap local prices (no dish prices published). Order several dishes to share.
items.openText: Daily 10:30-14:15 and 16:30-19:15 (weekends until 14:00 and 19:00).
items.bestTime: Lunch.
tips: Hard to find: it is behind tall bushes on a small back road.
They can make dishes less spicy if you ask.
Backup: Ko Tee Sangkasi Restaurant on Yaowarat Road, about 3 km west (Tue-Sun 09:00-20:00, cash only, about 150 THB a dish) for sour curries and crab curry.
items.verification: Michelin page data: Bib Gourmand 2026, 'no English menu'. Regular hours from Google via Wanderlog (Oct 2026); Google also shows a one-off closure 15-18 Oct 2026, and the Michelin page lists only Thursday (likely a data error). Phuket 101 (14 Sep 2026): cheap, kaeng som and kaeng pa. Ko Tee: Google 262/3 Yaowarat Rd, Mon closed; Phuket 101 says 262/8, cash only.

items.name: Mor Mu Dong (mangrove seafood)
items.nameThai: หมอมูดง
items.coordSource: google maps place pin (7.84309, 98.37201) + michelin page geo + osm node, all within 10 m
items.gmapsQuery: Mor Mu Dong Restaurant, Chalong, Phuket
items.description: Southern Thai food in open wooden huts over a mangrove canal near Chalong, about 10 km from Phuket Town. Mostly local diners. Live seafood waits in tanks by the open kitchen. Try stuffed mackerel, salt-fried pork, sea grape salad, lime squid and salt-crusted fish. Michelin Bib Gourmand.
items.feeText: Most dishes 100-200 THB; whole fish by weight. About 300-500 THB per person. Cards are listed as accepted, but bring cash as backup.
items.openText: Daily 10:00-21:00. Closed on the 15th of every month (on your trip: Fri 15 Jan).
items.bestTime: Weekdays are calmer. On weekends arrive before 12:00: the car park fills and you take a queue number. High tide gives the best view (check a tide app). At low tide you see mud and small red crabs.
tips: Order the salt-crusted fish (pla pao) first. It takes about 30 minutes.
No reservations. On busy days you take a number and wait. Ask for a hut over the water.
In the huts you sit on the floor at a low table. Some bigger huts, and the tables under the trees, have chairs.
The menu has photos of every dish, so you can point.
Backup on the 15th or when it is full: Chaiyo Seafood Restaurant (daily 10:30-21:30). It is across the canal, but about 10 km by road.
items.verification: Checked 15 Oct 2026. Google Maps 'Mor Mu Dong Restaurant': operating, daily 10:00-21:00, 3,753 reviews. Michelin site: same hours, and its Phuket Bib Gourmand list (18 places) includes it. Closed on the 15th: Phuket 101 (30 Sep 2026) and Wongnai agree. Coords: Google pin, Michelin geo and OSM node within 10 m. Chaiyo: Google/OSM pin 480 m north across the canal, 9.6 km by road (OSRM).
items.gettingThere: Car, scooter or Grab. About 20-25 min from Phuket Town (10 km), 25-30 min from Kata (11 km) and 35-45 min from Patong (20 km). It is at the end of a small road in the mangroves. Google Maps finds it easily.

items.name: Malin Plaza night market (Patong)
items.nameThai: มาลิน พลาซ่า
items.coordSource: google maps place pin (7.88264, 98.29318) + osm marketplace polygon (edited Sep 2026), 80 m apart
items.gmapsQuery: Malin Plaza, Prachanukhro Rd, Patong, Phuket
items.description: A big covered night market at the south end of Patong. The front half is food: grills, seafood on ice that they cook for you, pad thai, fruit, pancakes and mango sticky rice, with shared tables. The back half sells clothes and souvenirs. Touristy and warm (no air-con), but cheap for Patong.
items.feeText: Free entry. Street dishes about 80-120 THB (pad thai 80, pad kra pao 100-120). Seafood is by weight: ask the total before they cook it.
items.openText: Daily 11:00-23:00. Almost empty until late afternoon.
items.bestTime: 18:00-19:00: stalls are ready and tables are free. Busiest 20:00-22:00, peak around 21:00.
tips: Bargain for souvenirs, not for food. A cap offered at 250 THB sold for 70 THB.
Look at a few food stalls first: a few charge more than the others.
Halal food: several stalls show it on the sign. Check each stall.
Some sellers in the shopping half are pushy. A smile and a 'no' works.
items.verification: Checked 15 Oct 2026. Google Maps 'Malin Plaza' (night market): operating, daily 11:00-23:00, 8,997 reviews. Phuket 101 (12 Aug 2026): same hours, free entry, 2025-2026 prices, layout, tuk-tuk 200 THB, 1.6 km from Bangla Road. No closure news in English or Thai search. Coords: Google pin; OSM marketplace polygon 80 m away. Bangla Road to market 1.5 km by road (OSRM).
items.gettingThere: South end of Patong on Prachanukhro Road, 1.6 km from Bangla Road (about 20 minutes on foot). Tuk-tuk from central or north Patong about 200 THB, or use Grab. Parking is hard: a scooter is fine, a car is not.

items.name: Karon Beach
items.nameThai: หาดกะรน
items.coordSource: google-maps-place (cid 16458406708627662111, re-derived via Google Maps search) + inside osm-beach-way-134394729 (17 m from the middle of the sand, at the midpoint of its 3.3 km length) + wikidata Q13424404 (146 m)
items.gmapsQuery: Karon Beach, Karon, Phuket
items.bestTime: Morning for calm water and space. Late afternoon for a long walk and sunset (about 18:25).
items.openText: Always open.
items.feeText: Free.
items.gettingThere: In Karon you walk to the sand. From Patong about 15 min over the hill road, from Kamala about 30-40 min, by car, scooter or Grab. Kata is next door to the south.
items.description: A wide 3 km beach of soft, pale sand between Patong and Kata. Most hotels are across the beach road, so the sand rarely feels crowded. From December to April the sea is usually calm for swimming. The dry sand squeaks under your feet. Good for long walks at sunset.
tips: Always check the flags. Rip currents are mainly a May-October problem, but they can still happen.
The north end is the quietest part. After heavy rain, dark water from the canal near Nong Harn lake can run across the sand there. Swim away from it.
The south end, near Kata, has TANN Beach Club (11:00-23:00) with a fire show every night at about 19:00.
Karon Temple Market runs Tuesday and Friday, 16:00-22:00, at Wat Karon, about 10 minutes on foot from the middle of the beach.
Jet skis and parasailing work off the sand in high season. Swim away from them.

imageCandidates.credit: กสิณธร ราชโอรส

items.verification: Checked 15 Oct 2026. Phuket 101 Karon page (updated 5 Oct 2026): about 3 km (3.3 km in its fast facts), only two hotels on the sand, swimming season December-May, serious rips May-October, jet skis and parasailing in high season, squeaky sand, the north stretch is often almost empty, TANN Beach Club (formerly Tann Terrace) at the south end with a fire show at 19:00 every night, Karon Temple Market at Wat Suwan Khiri Khet on Tuesday and Friday, 16:00-22:00. Its FAQ says the beach can get busy December-March, so I changed 'never feels crowded' to 'rarely'. Google: Karon Beach 4.6 (9,315 reviews), not closed; Tann Beach club 11:00-23:00 (4,237 reviews); the Wat Karon market pin is 660 m from the beach pin. Nation Thailand (Feb 2023) and Phuket News (Oct 2025): dark water from the canal near Nong Harn lake at the north end, and the wastewater fix was still pending in Oct 2025. Coords: the Google pin, re-derived independently, lies inside OSM sand way 134394729 at the midpoint of its length; Wikidata point is 146 m away. Sunset 18:24-18:29 for 8-18 Jan 2027 (computed). items.name: Kamala Beach
items.nameThai: หาดกมลา
items.coordSource: google-maps-place (cid 10013608853475450584, re-derived via Google Maps search) + wikidata Q10542974 (4 m) + inside osm-beach-relation-6892478 (6 m from the middle of the sand)
items.gmapsQuery: Kamala Beach, Kamala, Phuket
items.bestTime: Morning swim at the north or central part. Sunset (about 18:25) at a bar on the sand.
items.openText: Always open.
items.feeText: Free.
items.gettingThere: In Kamala you walk to the sand. From Patong about 15 min over the hill road, from the airport about 35-45 min, by car or Grab.
items.description: About 2 km of soft, pale sand with shade trees. The quiet town behind it grew from a Muslim fishing village. It is the base suggested in this guide. In the high season the sea is shallow, calm and clear, one of the easiest swims on the island. Small Thai restaurants and bamboo bars sit on the sand, good for sunset.
tips: Swim at the north or central part. At the south end, streams bring brown water and fishing boats park.
For sunset, sit at one of the small bamboo bars in the middle of the beach, or at Pine Beach Bar (8:00-23:00) on the sand below the InterContinental at the north end.
Smile Bar on the beach (13:00-22:00) is a classic Kamala meal: grilled chicken, sticky rice and som tam.
Café del Mar is at the north end of the beach. See Events for its January shows.
Rip currents are a June-November problem. In January the sea is usually calm, but check the flags.
items.verification: Checked 15 Oct 2026. Phuket 101 Kamala page (updated 5 Oct 2026): 2 km, north and central parts best, 'dirty streams release brown waters at the south end, where fishing boats are often parked', rough waves and rips June-November, swimming best December-May, small bamboo bars in the middle, Pine Beach Bar at the InterContinental, Smile Bar for grilled chicken, Café del Mar just down the beach from Pine. It places 'the original Muslim town in the very back', with the tourist strip along the beach, so the description now says the town behind the beach grew from a Muslim village. Google: Kamala Beach 4.4 (3,939 reviews), not closed; Smile Bar 4.8 (11,584), 13:00-22:00; Pine Beach Bar 4.7, 8:00-23:00; Café del Mar Phuket Beach Club pin in the north part of the beach. No 2026 closure news found. Coords: the Google pin, re-derived independently, is 4 m from the Wikidata point and on the OSM sand polygon. Airport drive time widened to 35-45 min (OSRM 34 min without traffic). Wikipedia link moved to sources (not an official link). Commons licenses re-checked; the drone photo is geotagged at the south end of Kamala.

items.name: Surin Beach
items.nameThai: หาดสุรินทร์
items.coordSource: google-maps-place (cid 11607404977767269443, re-derived via Google Maps search) + inside osm-beach-relation-14010442 (8 m from the middle of the sand) + wikidata Q14925036 (48 m)
items.gmapsQuery: Surin Beach, Choeng Thale, Phuket
items.bestTime: Morning, for the clearest water and shade under the trees. Or late afternoon for sunset (about 18:25).
items.openText: Always open.
items.feeText: Free. In early 2026 there were no sunbeds or umbrellas for rent.
items.gettingThere: About 5-10 min north of Kamala by car, scooter or Grab. About 20 min from Patong.
items.description: An 800 m bay of soft, pale sand with casuarina trees for shade, 5-10 minutes north of Kamala. Between 2023 and May 2025 the bars, sunbeds and beach massage were removed from the sand, so it looks natural again. From December to April the water is often clear and calm: some of the best swimming on the island.
tips: Bring a towel or mat. In early 2026 visitors found no sunbeds or umbrellas to rent. Food and drinks are sold at stalls by the car park and in cafes across the road.
Eat at Tukta Food & Drink, on the rocks at the south end (10:30-21:00). The stairs to the upper floors are hidden, but the view is worth it.
From the south end, walk 15-20 min over the rocks (easier at mid to low tide), or take the 100 THB boat, to Laem Singh Beach. The boat may not run in bad weather.
In the low season (May-October) the sea can be rough. In January it is usually calm, but some visitors report deep water and currents a few metres out. Check the flags.
items.verification: Checked 15 Oct 2026. Phuket 101 Surin page (updated 16 Sep 2026): 800 m, all food vendors gone from the sand since May 2025, no beach massages, chairs and umbrellas gone, Tukta on the rocks still open, calm and clear November-April, rough in low season. Tisland guide (checked 26 Sep 2026): sunbeds cleared in Nov 2023 except one operator, last illegal structures demolished in May 2025. It also claims sunbeds come back in high season, but Tripadvisor reviews from Jan and Mar 2026 (high season) say there were no sunbeds or shade, with a food and drink market by the car park. So the guide now says what visitors saw in early 2026 instead of claiming everything is gone. A Dec 2025 review reports deep water and currents 5-6 m out. Laem Singh: Phuket 101 (4 Aug 2026) and Tisland agree on the 15-20 min walk over the rocks (easier at mid to low tide) and the 100 THB boat, which may not run in monsoon weather. Google: Surin Beach 4.5 (3,162 reviews), not closed; Tukta Food & Drink 10:30-21:00 (Phuket 101 says 9:30), pinned at the south end. Coords: the Google pin, re-derived independently, is inside the OSM sand polygon and 48 m from Wikidata. Both Commons photos are from 2008-2009, before the clear-outs.

items.name: Plane spotting at Mai Khao Beach
items.nameThai: จุดชมวิวเครื่องบิน หาดไม้ขาว
items.coordSource: google-maps-place 'Mai Khao Beach - Airport viewpoint' (cid 16722485722951104661, re-derived via Google Maps search) + osm-node-7139218389 'Phuket airport viewpoint' (18 m); 141 m west of the OSM runway 09 threshold (node 11460274152)
items.gmapsQuery: Mai Khao Beach - Airport viewpoint, Thalang, Phuket
items.bestTime: Late morning to about 14:00, when more planes land. Low tide gives a wider beach for photos. From December to June most planes land over the sea. On your flight day, Tue 26 Jan, come about 11:00-13:30.
items.openText: Open beach. Planes land all day.
items.feeText: Free. Motorbike ride from the car park to the runway end: 20 THB. If you come in through Sirinat National Park from the Nai Yang side, the park fee can apply (200 THB per foreign adult in 2026).
items.gettingThere: Drive north past the airport and follow the signs with a plane picture to the car park by the beach. Walk about 500 m south on the sand to the end of the runway, or take a 20 THB motorbike ride. About 20 min from the terminal (the road goes around the runway), 40-50 min from Kamala, about 60 min from Patong.
items.description: At the south end of Mai Khao Beach, planes pass very low over your head just before they land at Phuket Airport. In the high season the wind comes from the east, so most planes come in over the sea and the sand. It is loud, a little crazy and free. Drink and food stalls wait at the car park and the runway end.
tips: Open the FlightRadar24 app to see when the next plane lands. Planes that come in from the west, over the sea, pass over the beach.
Watch from the side. Standing in the landing path is not allowed, and jet blast from planes waiting to take off throws sand hard.
If the wind is from the west, planes land from the other side and only take-offs pass over the beach. In January the wind is usually from the east.
Do not fly a drone. The beach is next to the runway, in the airport no-fly zone.
Bring a cap and water. There is no shade on the sand.
Good last stop on Tue 26 Jan: watch until about 13:30-14:00, walk back to the car park, then drive about 20 minutes around the runway to the terminal (be there by 15:20).
With luggage on the last day, come with a driver who waits for you, or first leave your bags at the AIRPORTELs counter in the terminal (150 baht per bag).
items.verification: Checked 15 Oct 2026. Phuket 101 plane-spotting page (updated 6 Aug 2026): watching is free, signposted car park about 500 m from the runway, 20 THB motorbike ride, east wind in high season so planes land over the sea, best months December-June, more arrivals from late morning to about 14:00, low tide gives a wider beach, standing in the landing path is not allowed, jet-blast warning, vendors at the car park and the runway end. It gives 30 THB for the Sirinat park route, but Thai National Parks (June 2026) lists 200 THB per foreign adult (100 THB child), so the guide uses that figure. Google: 'Mai Khao Beach - Airport viewpoint' 4.6 (1,856 reviews), not closed. OSRM routing: terminal to the car park 8.5 km (16 min without traffic), Kamala 28 km (34 min), Patong 39 km (47 min), so the given times hold with traffic. Coords: the Google pin, re-derived independently, is 18 m from OSM node 7139218389, on the sand 141 m west of the runway 09 threshold, north of Nai Yang Beach (so 'south end of Mai Khao' is right). Removed the unsourced 'bluest sea' claim. Thai CAAT rules ban drone flights near airports. All three image URLs return images; licenses re-checked on Commons.

items.name: Bangla Boxing Stadium (Muay Thai fight night)
items.nameThai: สนามมวยบางลา
items.coordSource: official site schema.org geo (7.89156, 98.30119) + google-maps-place (cid 3364025033711815035, re-derived via Google Maps search) + osm-way-473870666 (Photon 7.89148, 98.30114), all within 10 m
items.gmapsQuery: Bangla Boxing Stadium, Patong, Phuket
items.bestTime: Arrive by about 20:45 to get your T-shirt and seat before the first bout at 21:00. The strongest fights are at the end of the card.
items.openText: Every night. Doors 20:00, first bout 21:00, ends about midnight.
items.feeText: Stadium seat 1,600 THB, Ringside 2,000 THB, the same online or at the gate (official site, Oct 2026). A free T-shirt is included. Drinks are extra.
items.gettingThere: 155/16 Phang Muang Sai Kor Road, Patong, behind Jungceylon mall and opposite Banzaan Fresh Market. About 5-10 min on foot from Bangla Road. From Kamala about 15-25 min by car or Grab.
items.description: Patong's Muay Thai stadium, open since 2004, with fights every night. A card has about 8 bouts, from teenagers up to the main fights, with live traditional music and the Wai Kru dance before each bout. An English commentator explains the action. It is for tourists and not cheap, but a fun first look at Thai boxing.
tips: Book online or pay at the gate: the price is the same. Seats fill faster from November to April, so book a day or two ahead.
Stadium seats are raised, so you see the whole ring. At Ringside you look up through the ropes.
The first bouts are young teenagers. The best fighters come at the end.
Wednesday and Saturday cards also have MMA bouts.
Shelter, the techno room at Illuzion, is about 10 minutes away on foot, so you can go on after the last fight.

imageCandidates.source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Boxer_and_trainer.jpeg (boxer before a fight at Bangla Boxing Stadium, 2013)

items.verification: Checked 15 Oct 2026. Official ticket page: Muay Thai every night, doors 20:00, first bout 21:00, 8 bouts to about midnight, 'MMA on Wednesday, Saturday' (one short blurb says only 'MMA Saturdays'), Stadium 1,600 THB and Ringside 2,000 THB with a free T-shirt, same price online or at the gate, and 'seats fill faster through the November to April high season, so booking a day or two ahead is worth it'. The date picker lists every night of January 2027. About page: founded 22 April 2004, moved from Bangla Road, about 900 seats, live Sarama music, Wai Kru Ram Muay, English-speaking commentator. Phuket 101 (updated 12 Sep 2026): same prices and times, first fighters as young as 12, raised stadium seats give a better view than ringside, 'expensive and relatively violent'. Google 4.1 (641 reviews), not closed. Coords: official schema.org geo, the Google pin and OSM way 473870666 agree within 10 m. Illuzion is 445 m away in a straight line; DJ Mag Top 100 Clubs 2026 names Shelter as its techno room. I replaced the unsourced 'Ringside sells out first' with the official booking advice.

items.name: Blue Elephant Cooking School (Phuket Old Town)
items.coordSource: google-maps-place (cid 17905886336366556401, re-derived via Google Maps search) + official Amelia booking-system location (7.88603, 98.38474; 50 m) + osm-node-4728587890 (Photon 7.88607, 98.38459; 57 m)
items.gmapsQuery: Blue Elephant Phuket Cooking School & Restaurant, Krabi Road, Phuket
items.bestTime: The morning class (9:30), because it includes the market visit. Book ahead online.
items.openText: Classes every day: morning class 9:30-13:15 with a market visit, afternoon class 13:30-17:00 with an extra Thai dessert (official booking system). Restaurant: daily 11:30-22:00 (Google).
items.feeText: Group class 3,800 THB per person, morning or afternoon. Private teacher, half day: 8,300 THB (official booking system, Oct 2026).
items.gettingThere: 96 Krabi Road, Phuket Old Town. From Patong about 30 min, from Kamala about 40-45 min, by car or Grab.
items.description: A Thai cooking class in a restored governor's mansion, more than 100 years old, in Phuket Old Town. You cook 4-5 dishes in half a day, then eat them in the restaurant. The morning class starts with a visit to a local market. The afternoon class adds a Thai dessert. The dishes change every day.
tips: Check the weekly menu on the official class page before you book: each weekday has different dishes.
Classes are taught in English, Thai, French, Dutch or Chinese.
You get an apron, the recipes, a certificate and a bag of Blue Elephant products.
Cheaper, more casual option near the beaches: Phuket Thai Cooking Class by Chef VJ in Kata. Its official site lists 1,800-2,500 THB (Oct 2026), with free pickup in some areas if you book direct.
Thalang Road and the Old Town shophouses start about 300 m to the east, an easy walk after class.
items.verification: Checked 15 Oct 2026. Official booking system (Amelia API on blueelephant.com, read 15 Oct 2026): Phuket group class, morning 3,800 THB (225 min) and afternoon 3,800 THB (210 min); private teacher half day 8,300 THB. Free slots at 9:30 (morning) and 13:30 (afternoon) on every day of 8-18 Jan 2027, so the start times now come from the official system, not from resellers. Official class page (2026 menu): 4-5 dishes, market tour only in the morning, Thai dessert in the afternoon, a different menu for each weekday, 5 languages, apron, recipes, certificate and product bag. Restaurant hours corrected: the old 'lunch 11:30-14:30, dinner 17:30-22:00' were the hours of Blue Elephant Bangkok Sathorn on the same page. For Phuket the official site says 'Mon-Sun 9AM-10:30PM' (whole house) and Google says 11:30-22:00 daily. The mansion dates to about 1903 (Phuket 101). Phuket 101 (28 Sep 2026) still shows an older 3,296 THB price. VJ: the official site (Oct 2026) shows 1,800-2,500 THB and free pickup in some areas. Google lists it as 'Phuket Thai Cooking Class by Chef VJ', 31 Patak Rd, Kata (5.0, 1,610 reviews). Phuket 101's 2,000-2,300 THB and 'Karon' address are older. Google: Blue Elephant 4.7 (3,343 reviews), not closed. Coords: the Google pin, the official booking location and the OSM node agree within 60 m. OSM: Thalang Road starts about 300 m east of the school.

items.name: Renew Sauna & Ice Bath (Bang Tao)
items.coordSource: google-maps-place (cid 13762581260670293142, 7.99258, 98.30821, re-derived via Google Maps search; same place ID and pin in a Phuket Insider link from Apr 2025) + yandex-maps (7.99258, 98.30821; 'Soi Cherngtalay-Bandon 4'), under 5 m apart; not in OSM
items.gmapsQuery: Renew Sauna & Ice Bath Club, Choeng Thale, Phuket
items.bestTime: A slow afternoon on a recovery day. It is open until 23:00, so it also works after dinner.
items.openText: Daily 10:00-23:00 (Google). Ages 16 and over only.
items.feeText: Day ticket 465 THB (official price list, Oct 2026). Food and drinks are extra.
items.gettingThere: On Soi Cherngtalay-Bandon 4, a side street off Bandon-Cherngtalay Road, about 250 m from Boat Avenue, Bang Tao. From Kamala about 10-15 min, from Patong about 30-35 min, by car, scooter or Grab.
items.description: A modern sauna and ice-bath club near Boat Avenue in Bang Tao, about 10-15 minutes from Kamala. It has a Finnish sauna, a steam room, a hot pool, ice plunges and a large pool, plus a cafe with healthy food. Hot-cold rounds help you recover the day after a party. Only for guests aged 16 and over.
tips: Do 3-4 rounds: sauna or steam, then the cold tub, then rest. Drink a lot of water.
Do not go with alcohol still in your body. Heat and ice water are hard on the heart.
Another option: KEDR Spa & Sauna in Si Sunthon (Thalang), a calm, compact place with a sauna, steam room, hot tubs, ice plunges and a rain room. Daily 9:00-24:00, ages 14+.
For a Thai massage near Kamala: Oasis Spa (Turquoise Cove Spa, Kamala), daily 10:00-24:00 (Google).
Questions: Instagram @renew.sauna.
items.verification: Checked 15 Oct 2026. Official site and pricing page (2026): near Boat Avenue on Bandon-Cherngtalay Rd, sauna, cold plunge, steam rooms, hot and cold tubs, outdoor pool, cafe and bar, ages 16+; 1 day 465 THB, 1 month 3,500 THB. Google lists it as 'Renew Sauna & Ice Bath Club' (4.9, 381 reviews), daily 10:00-23:00, not closed; the owner text says it opened on 7 Feb 2025. gmapsQuery now uses that exact name (tested: first result). Phuket Insider: Mon-Sun 10:00-23:00, Finnish sauna 44-48°C, hammam, hot magnesium pool, ice plunge and two ice barrels, large pool, Go Fresh cafe, big car park, single entry 445 THB with towel (older price). Coords: the Google pin and Yandex Maps (address Soi Cherngtalay-Bandon 4) agree within 5 m, so confidence is now high. Yandex may share data with Google. The pin is about 250 m east-southeast of Boat Avenue. KEDR: Google 9:00-24:00, 'kids 14+ only'. Phuket Insider calls it small and compact with a small pool, so 'bigger option' was wrong; the unsourced 'banya' and 'salt-water barrels' claims were dropped. Oasis Spa (Turquoise Cove Spa, Kamala): Google 4.9 (2,302), daily 10:00-24:00. The 'Wednesday until 15:00' was a one-off special-hours flag for 21 Oct 2026, not the normal week. Added the official Instagram link.

items.name: Nai Thon Beach
items.coordSource: OSM beach way 53166566 (centre 8.05786, 98.27761, length about 1.1 km); Google 'Nai Thon Beach' pin 8.06055, 98.27720 is 300 m north on the same sand
items.gmapsQuery: Nai Thon Beach, Sakhu, Thalang, Phuket
items.bestTime: Late morning to early afternoon. November to February has the calmest, clearest sea. On your flight day, leave by about 14:45.
items.openText: Public beach, always open.
items.feeText: Free.
items.gettingThere: About 7.4 km (10-15 min by car) south of the airport and 10 min south of Nai Yang. No Smart Bus stop on the beach: use Grab or Bolt.
items.description: A quiet, sandy bay of about 1 km between two green headlands, 10-15 minutes from the airport. In the dry season the sea is usually clear and good for swimming. A few small restaurants, a minimart and massage shops are across the beach road. Much calmer than the big west-coast beaches.
tips: Rip currents can happen, mostly when the waves are big. Swim in the middle of the bay and never at a red flag.
Snorkelling is only fair: try the rocks at the headlands on calm days.
Bamboo Beach Restaurant (Google 4.7, 186 reviews), at the south end, is open daily 10:00-22:00.
Last swim on Tue 26 Jan: leave by about 14:45 and you reach the terminal in 10-15 minutes.
items.verification: Checked 16 Oct 2026. Lonely Planet: small, secluded beach about 7 km south of the airport, good swimming except at the height of the monsoon, low-key restaurants across the road. Thai Holiday Guide (updated Sep 2026): Nov-Feb is the clearest swimming window, fair snorkelling at the headlands, 15-25 min to the airport. Saltwater Dreaming: rocky headlands and rip currents. Google 'Nai Thon Beach' 4.7 (1,215). Bamboo Beach Restaurant: Google 4.7 (186), daily 10:00-22:00. OSRM beach centre to international terminal 7.4 km, about 8 min free-flow. A Commons photo with a stock-site watermark was skipped. Critic re-check 16 Oct 2026: Google 'Nai Thon Beach' 4.7 (1,215) and OSM way 53166566 (centroid 8.05767, 98.27753, 27 m from the pin) confirmed. Bamboo Beach Restaurant 4.7 (186), daily 10:00-22:00, at 8.05620 (south part of the bay). Google also lists Tops daily (24 h) and Nai Thon Mart minimarts and several massage shops on the beach road, so the description holds. Saltwater Dreaming (updated 2026): 'Beware of rocks and strong rip currents'. OSRM to the international terminal 7.5 km, 10 min free-flow.

items.name: Natural Restaurant (airport branch)
items.coordSource: Google Maps pin (cid 10822961704747340361) from the Maps search API; the Phuket 101 map link gives 8.09344, 98.31463 (12 m). The official site's schema shows the map centre (98.312), 280 m west.
items.gmapsQuery: Natural Restaurant Airport, Baan Nai Yang, Sakhu, Phuket
items.bestTime: Lunch on your last day, about 12:00-13:30. It is 5 minutes from the terminal.
items.openText: Daily 07:00-00:30 (official site and Google Maps, Oct 2026).
items.feeText: Mid-range prices (the restaurant's own price level is ฿฿). Pay by cash, card or Thai QR (PromptPay).
items.gettingThere: 3/10 Moo 1, Baan Nai Yang, Sakhu: about 2-3 km from the international terminal (the restaurant says 3.2 km), about 5 minutes by car or Grab. Free parking.
items.description: Family-run Southern Thai restaurant since 1992, in a tropical garden with a waterfall. The long picture menu has fresh Andaman seafood such as fish and prawns, curries made with house curry pastes, and spicy salads. Air-conditioned rooms too. A relaxed last meal close to the airport.
tips: Google 4.7 from more than 3,000 reviews, so it is busy at lunch. Book on Chope (link on the official site) or come before 12:00.
In Google Maps, pick the 'Natural Restaurant' at 3/10 Moo 1, Baan Nai Yang, Sakhu. The other Natural Restaurant is in Phuket Town.
Ask for the Southern Thai dishes and say how spicy you want them.
items.verification: Checked 16 Oct 2026. Official site (schema.org data): family-owned Southern Thai and seafood restaurant since 1992, open daily 07:00-00:30, price range ฿฿, cash/card/PromptPay, free parking, air-conditioned private rooms, Chope reservations. Google: 'Natural Restaurant' 4.7 (3,083 reviews), same hours, not closed. Phuket 101 (updated 6 Jan 2026): 2.4 km from the airport, long illustrated menu with fish and prawns, curries and spicy salads. OSRM to the international terminal: 2.2 km. Critic re-check 16 Oct 2026: official schema re-read: 'Family-owned Southern Thai restaurant since 1992, 3.2 km from Phuket International Airport', 'tropical waterfall setting', 07:00-00:30 daily, ฿฿, cash/card/PromptPay, air-conditioned private rooms, Chope. 'Ponds' was not in any source, so it was removed. OSRM to the AIRPORTELs pin 2.3 km, 4 min. Both image URLs return JPEG files.

items.name: Sabai Massage & Spa (airport branch)
items.coordSource: Google Maps pin (cid 16687833397833263997), the same listing the official site links to; OSRM 1.0 km by road to the international terminal
items.gmapsQuery: Sabai massage and spa, Phuket airport branch, Sakhu, Phuket
items.bestTime: After check-out on your last day, for example 13:00-15:00, then the free drop-off to the terminal.
items.openText: Daily 10:30-23:30, last booking 22:30 (official site).
items.feeText: Thai or oil massage from 400-500 THB for 60 min; Thai plus foot massage, 120 min, 800 THB (official site, Oct 2026). Free airport drop-off if you spend at least 600 THB and book directly 1 day before.
items.gettingThere: 18/18 Moo 1, Sakhu, on the main road about 1 km from the terminal (5 min by car).
items.description: Massage and spa shop near the airport with a very high rating (Google 4.9 from 2,050 reviews). Thai, oil, foot, herbal-compress and head-and-shoulder massages in air-conditioned rooms. A good way to spend the last hours before a long flight, and they can drive you to the terminal.
tips: Book on LINE @sabaimassage or WhatsApp 085-333-6333 the day before, and ask for the free airport drop-off ('while availability lasts').
Finish by about 15:00 so you are at the terminal by 15:20.
Ask if you can keep your bags next to you during the massage. If not, leave them at the airport left-luggage counter first.
items.verification: Checked 16 Oct 2026. Official site: airport branch at 18/18 Moo 1 Sakhu, open daily 10:30-23:30 (last orders 22:30), walk-ins welcome, prices from 300 THB (30 min head and shoulder), Thai/oil massage from 400-500 THB per hour, 'Traveller Set' 120 min 800 THB, 'FREE Airport Drop off' for the airport branch with 600 THB minimum spend per person and direct booking at least 1 day ahead. OSRM to the international terminal 1.1 km.

items.name: Rassada Pier (Phuket Town)
items.coordSource: Google place via Visit Thailand Today (7.87303, 98.41454); OSM ferry_terminal node 260742667 (32 m) and terminal building way 206895809 (centre 32 m)
items.gmapsQuery: Rassada Pier, Phuket
items.description: Phuket's main ferry terminal, 3.5 km east of Old Town. Big ferries and speedboats leave here for Phi Phi, Ao Nang and Railay in Krabi, Koh Lanta and, in high season, Koh Lipe. Each boat company has its own counter inside, where you swap your ticket for a boarding pass.
items.openText: Terminal open daily about 07:30-18:00. First boats 08:30; last ferry to Phi Phi 15:00, last speedboat about 15:30.

routes.operator: Andaman Wave Master, Phi Phi Cruiser, Chaokoh, Chureang
Bundhaya, Satun Pakbara, Andaman Wave Master and others

routes.to: Ao Nang (Nopparat Thara Pier) and Railay East
routes.times: Bundhaya 11:00 and 13:30 (09:00 from mid-Nov); Andaman Wave Master 08:45 (its own timetable, also to Krabi Town)

routes.operator: Ao Nang Princess (Ao Nang Travel and Tour)
routes.times: 10:30 on Sun, Wed and Fri; a daily 13:30 is added 15 Nov - 19 May
routes.duration: about 2 h (Railay 12:15, Ao Nang 12:30 on the 10:30)
routes.priceText: 850-900 THB; bags over 20 kg cost 100 THB extra
routes.season: all year; the daily 13:30 only 15 Nov - 19 May

routes.operator: Satun Pakbara, Bundhaya, Andaman Wave Master
routes.times: Satun Pakbara 08:30, 11:00, 12:30; Bundhaya 08:30, 10:00 (+12:00, 14:30 in high season); Andaman Wave Master 09:15

routes.to: Koh Lanta via Phi Phi (change boats at Tonsai)
routes.operator: Andaman Wave Master, Phi Phi Cruiser, Chaokoh

routes.to: Koh Lipe (Pattaya Beach), stopping at Phi Phi, Lanta, Koh Ngai, Koh Mook, Koh Kradan
routes.operator: Satun Pakbara Speed Boat Club, Bundhaya

items.facilities: A modern terminal with one counter per boat company, toilets, an ATM and money exchange, a few restaurants and a large car park. There is no pier fee.
items.gettingThere: From Patong 18 km over the hill: 25 min with no traffic, 40-45 min in the morning. Kamala 25 km (30-50 min), Rawai 19 km (25-40 min). The pier taxi counter asks about 700 THB to Patong; Grab and Bolt are usually cheaper, but you may have to walk out to the road to meet the car. Many ferry tickets include a shared van from Patong, Kata, Karon and Phuket Town.
items.feeText: No pier fee. Phi Phi charges 20 THB in cash when you land at Tonsai. Koh Lipe: 200 THB Tarutao park fee on arrival.
tips: Be at the counter 30-45 minutes before sailing to swap your voucher for a boarding pass and a luggage tag.
Ferries take one suitcase plus a hand bag; Andaman Wave Master charges 300 THB for each extra bag. On speedboats bags sit in a pile at the back, so use a dry bag.
If you get seasick, take the big ferry and sit low in the middle. Speedboats bounce and spray.
Tigerline and a few small boats use Chean Vanich (Chianwanich) pier, 1 km north of Rassada. Check the pier on your ticket.
The cheapest ride from Old Town is the air-conditioned EV bus Line 3 (Green Line) to Rassada Pier: 15-40 THB, about 05:45-18:30. The old pink songthaews stopped in June 2025.
items.verification: Fact-check 19 Oct 2026. Andaman Wave Master's own timetable: Rassada - Tonsai 08:30 and 13:45 (700 THB), Lanta via Phi Phi 08:30 and 13:45 (November - April), speedboat 08:45 to Railay, Ao Nang and Krabi Town, 09:15 to Lanta, extra bag 300 THB. Seatran Discovery engine for 12 Jan 2027: Andaman Wave Master 08:30/13:45 and Phi Phi Cruiser 08:30/13:30, 600 THB. Direct Ferries (19 Oct - 1 Nov 2026): Chaokoh 11:00/15:00, Chureang 11:00. Lipe: ferrylipe.com (Satun Pakbara, 15 Oct 2026 - 30 Apr 2027), Bundhaya 2,500 THB to 20 May. Ao Nang Princess 10:30: Ao Nang Travel and Tour (19 Oct 2026); daily 13:30 from 15 Nov: Visit Thailand Today only (5 Oct 2026). Hours, no fee, taxi, songthaew: Visit Thailand Today (Oct 2026). ATM, exchange, restaurants, car park: Phuket 101 (9 Aug 2026). The 'free toilets', the 18 kg bag limit and the free Ao Nang Princess van had no source and were removed.

items.name: Chalong Pier
items.coordSource: land-end gate (meeting point): Google place via Visit Thailand Today (7.82089, 98.34433) + OSM pier way 24936612 start (57 m) + paid car park way 243583133; boats board along the 700 m jetty and at its end (OSM node 270986823)
items.gmapsQuery: Chalong Pier, Phuket
items.description: Phuket's busiest tour pier, on Chalong Bay in the south. Most speedboat day trips to Racha and Coral Island start here, plus many Phi Phi and Khai tours, dive boats and private charters. You meet your group at the gate, then walk out along the jetty (up to 700 m) to your boat.
items.openText: Gates open daily about 07:00-21:00. Most tour boats leave 08:00-09:30.

routes.to: Koh Racha Yai and Coral Island (day tours)
routes.times: hotel pickup 07:00-09:00, back at the pier 15:30-16:30
routes.priceText: Racha + Coral tour from about 1,300 THB per person
routes.season: all year, calmest November to April

routes.to: Koh Racha Yai (The Racha resort guests)
Phi Phi, Maya Bay and Khai Islands (day tours)
routes.duration: Phi Phi about 1 h each way
routes.priceText: Phi Phi tours about 1,500-3,500 THB per person
routes.season: all year (Maya Bay closed 1 Aug - 30 Sep)

items.facilities: Tour company desks and dive shops along the access road, a paid car park, and seafood restaurants by the gate (Kan Eang is 90 m away). The jetty has very little shade.
items.gettingThere: From Rawai 6 km (10-15 min), Patong 17 km over the hill (20-40 min), Kamala 26 km (30-50 min). Grab or Bolt from Kata to Chalong is about 200-300 THB (Aug 2026). Most tours include the van from your hotel.
items.feeText: No passenger fee found; car parking is paid. Racha and Coral Island have no park fee.
tips: Ask which pier your tour uses: Chalong, Rawai, Rassada, Ao Po and Royal Phuket Marina are all used.
The walk out along the jetty can take up to 10 minutes. Arrive on time: tour boats do not wait.
Bring a hat and sun cream: you wait and board in full sun.
items.verification: Fact-check 19 Oct 2026. Visit Thailand Today (Oct 2026): gates 07:00-21:00, very little shade, Kan Eang about 90 m. Phuket 101 piers guide (9 Aug 2026): busiest tour pier, Racha, Coral and Phi Phi tours, The Racha 13:00 transfer, large car park. Phuket 101 Khai page (29 Aug 2026): Khai tours from Chalong. Tisland (Oct 2026): Racha + Coral from 1,300 THB, pickup 07:00-09:00. OSM: jetty 696 m, paid car park. Grab fare evephuket (Aug 2026). OSRM: Patong 16.6 km, Kamala 26.5 km, Rawai 6.0 km.

items.name: Rawai Pier (longtail boats)
items.coordSource: land end of the pier on Rawai beach: OSM pier ways 142750665/808089242 start (7.77500, 98.32755, 12 m) + Commons photo geotag of the 'Rawai Landing Pier' sign (7.77506, 98.32760); OSM ferry_terminal node 1562225016 is at the sea end, 330 m south
items.gmapsQuery: Rawai Pier, Phuket
items.description: A 300 m concrete pier on Rawai beach at Phuket's southern tip. Longtail captains wait on the beach and rent the whole boat: Koh Bon, Coral Island and Koh Lone are 15-20 minutes away. Cheaper than a packaged tour for a group, but simple: no terminal and no fixed timetable.

routes.season: all year, best November to April

routes.priceText: about 1,000-2,200 THB per boat, return (agree first)

items.facilities: No terminal. Seafood restaurants and the Rawai seafood market are along the beach road.
items.gettingThere: From Kata or Nai Harn 10-15 min, Patong 20 km (25-40 min), Kamala 30 km (35-55 min). Grab or Bolt from Kata to Rawai is about 200-300 THB (Aug 2026). The Smart Bus Route 1 ends at Rawai (100 THB).
items.feeText: No pier fee. Coral Island and Koh Bon have no park fee.
tips: Agree the price, the return time and fuel before you get in, and pay at the end.
Ask for life jackets for everyone before you leave the beach.
Go in the morning: the afternoon wind makes the ride wet.
Phuket 101 lists Koh Maiton as closed to visitors in 2026: check before you pay for a trip there.
items.verification: Fact-check 19 Oct 2026. Phuket 101 piers guide (9 Aug 2026): Koh Bon about 15 min, Coral 15-20 min, Racha 30-45 min, prices agreed with the drivers. Phuket 101 islands guide (4 Oct 2026, prices checked Jul 2026): Coral 1,500-2,000 THB per boat, Koh Bon 1,000 (text) to 1,800-2,200 (table), Racha no public boat, Maiton 'Suspended'; the Maiton page (Mar 2026) says access is suspended until further notice, so the tip now says to check rather than 'do not pay'. Pier 335 m in OSM. OSRM: Patong 20.3 km, Kamala 30.2 km.

items.name: Ao Po Pier (Ao Por)
items.coordSource: land end of the 500 m public jetty: OSM pier way 55868243 start (8.06146, 98.43209, 30 m); same spot as the guide's existing 'Directions to Ao Po Pier' (8.06094, 98.43294, 60 m). Boats board at the pontoon 500 m out (OSM node 701552280)
items.gmapsQuery: Ao Po Pier, Pa Khlok, Phuket
items.description: The long public jetty at Ao Po on the north-east coast, facing Phang Nga Bay. Many Phang Nga Bay and James Bond Island tours board here, including John Gray's Sea Canoe. Tour vans stop at the land end; the boats wait at the pontoon at the end of the 500 m jetty.

routes.to: Phang Nga Bay, James Bond Island and Hong islands (tours)
routes.operator: John Gray's Sea Canoe and other tour companies
routes.priceText: about 1,400-3,950 THB per person with transfer

items.facilities: A basic public pier. For cafes and restaurants, Ao Po Grand Marina is 1.3 km north-east.
items.gettingThere: From Kamala 29 km (35-55 min), Patong 36 km (45-70 min), Rawai 42 km (50-75 min), the airport or Nai Yang 20 km (25-35 min). Tours include hotel pickup. Grab or Bolt from Patong: about the same distance as airport - Patong, which is 570-850 THB on the apps (Aug 2026).
items.feeText: No pier fee. Phang Nga Bay park fee 300 THB (child 150), usually included in tours.
tips: Ao Po Pier and Ao Po Grand Marina are different places, 1.3 km apart. Check your voucher.
Sea-canoe tours follow the tide, so the order of stops can change on the day.
items.verification: Fact-check 19 Oct 2026. John Gray's Sea Canoe (official): trips leave from Ao Po, pickup 10:20-11:15, from 3,950 THB. items.name: Ao Po Grand Marina
items.coordSource: Google place (as in the guide's ao-po area: 1 m) next to the OSM slipway and Port of Call restaurant (OSM way 1470100750, 70 m); OSM marina node 2505243405 sits on the outer pontoons, 340 m E
items.gmapsQuery: Ao Po Grand Marina, Phuket
items.description: Phuket's superyacht marina, 1.3 km north-east of the public Ao Po pier, at the gateway to Phang Nga Bay. Premium tours, yacht and catamaran charters and resort boats leave here, for example to Six Senses on Koh Yao Noi and Santhiya on Koh Yao Yai. Cafes and bars make it a pleasant place to wait.

routes.season: listed in Oct 2026; check before you book

routes.operator: yacht and catamaran charter companies based here

items.facilities: Restaurants and bars (Port of Call, D Deck), a pool, a gym and yacht services.
items.gettingThere: From Kamala 30 km (40-60 min), Patong 37 km (45-70 min), Rawai 43 km (55-80 min), the airport or Nai Yang 21 km (about 30 min). Grab or Bolt from Patong: about the same distance as airport - Patong, which is 570-850 THB on the apps (Aug 2026).
items.feeText: No passenger fee. Park fees depend on the trip.
tips: If your boat is late, wait at Port of Call or D Deck rather than on the dock.
Charter companies here quote by the boat, so a group of 8 can split the price.
items.verification: Fact-check 19 Oct 2026. Official site: 230-berth superyacht marina, eateries, bars, fitness and pool, 24-hour access for boats (no parking or passenger services listed, so 'parking' and 'open 24 hours' were removed). Phuket 101 (9 Aug 2026): Port of Call, D Deck, Six Senses guests leave here. Six Senses transfer sheet: 40 min by boat. Santhiya about 20 min: Visit Thailand Today (18 Oct 2026). items.name: Bang Rong Pier
items.coordSource: Google place via Visit Thailand Today (8.04947, 98.41591) + OSM ferry_terminal node 485657809 (24 m); same as the guide's 'Directions to Bang Rong Pier'
items.gmapsQuery: Bang Rong Pier, Phuket
items.description: A small pier on the north-east coast and the main stop for public boats to Koh Yao Noi and Koh Yao Yai: speedboats in 30-40 minutes, a slow longtail in about an hour. A few speedboats go on across the bay to Ao Nang and Railay. It is the closest pier to the airport.
items.openText: Open 24 hours, but boats run only by day: about 08:30-17:00.

routes.operator: Koh Yao King Marine, Supaporn, Green Planet

routes.to: Koh Yao Yai (Chong Lard or Klong Hia Pier)
routes.operator: Koh Yao Sun Smile, Suwimol, Solomon, Green Planet

routes.to: Ao Nang (Nopparat Thara Pier) and Railay East, via Koh Yao
routes.operator: Koh Yao Sun Smile, Green Planet
routes.season: all year (more boats in high season)

items.facilities: Ticket counters, a small waiting area, a few food stalls, toilets and a car and motorbike park.
items.gettingThere: From the airport or Nai Yang 17 km (20-30 min). Kamala 25 km (30-45 min), Patong 32 km (35-55 min), Rawai 38 km (45-70 min). Grab or Bolt: expect roughly 500-800 THB from the west coast (the 35 km airport - Patong ride is 570-850 THB on the apps, Aug 2026).
items.feeText: No pier fee found. Koh Yao Noi and Koh Yao Yai have no island fee.
tips: The last boats leave about 17:00. A late-afternoon flight into Phuket can miss them.
Arrive 15 minutes early and buy the ticket at the counter, or book online a day ahead.
Some Koh Yao resorts send their own boat and car from the airport via Bang Rong: ask them first.
items.verification: Fact-check 19 Oct 2026. Camphadee timetable (2 Nov 2025): Bang Rong 08:40-17:00, longtail 12:30, 400/300 THB. Ferryscanner (25 Sep 2026): Green Planet, Koh Yao King Marine, Supaporn, first 08:40, last 17:00; Koh Yao Yai 08:30-17:00. bangrongpier.com: 09:30, 11:00, 13:30, 17:00 to Chong Lard (550 THB) and 09:30, 11:00, 15:00 to Ao Nang (1,000-1,200 THB). Visit Thailand Today (Oct 2026): open 24 hours, last boats about 17:00. Phuket 101 (9 Aug 2026): counters, waiting area, food stalls. OSRM: airport 16.6 km, Kamala 24.7, Patong 31.6, Rawai 37.7.

items.name: Laem Hin Pier

items.gmapsQuery: Laem Hin Pier, Phuket
items.description: A small pier on the east coast, about 15 minutes north of Phuket Town, next to the popular Laem Hin Seafood restaurant. A Green Planet speedboat leaves at 13:00 for Koh Yao Yai, Koh Yao Noi and Ao Nang, longtails go to Koh Maphrao and Rang Yai, and some Khai Islands tours start here.

routes.times: 13:00 and 14:00 (2026 listings); back from Klong Hia 10:50

routes.to: Ao Nang (Nopparat Thara Pier), via Koh Yao

routes.operator: longtail captains and the tour office at the pier
routes.priceText: about 2,500 THB per boat, return with waiting time

items.facilities: A small tour office in front of the pier, Laem Hin Seafood on the waterfront and two floating seafood restaurants in the channel.

items.feeText: No pier fee found.
tips: Green Planet passengers check in on the pier at least 30 minutes before: look for the Green Planet sign.
Good lunch stop after a Khai or Koh Yao day: Laem Hin Seafood is busy with locals at weekends.

links.label: Laem Hin - Koh Yao Yai boats (Ferryscanner)
