Visit Thailand Today (5 Oct 2026): Green Planet 13:00 from Laem Hin, 1,000 THB. Ferryscanner (2026): Laem Hin - Klong Hia by Green Planet only, first 13:00, last 14:00, back 10:50, from EUR 8.71. items.name: Royal Phuket Marina
items.coordSource: Google Maps link on the official royalphuketmarina.com contact page (!3d7.9667795!4d98.3907544); OSM marina node 2504564145 (90 m). Boat Lagoon marina pontoons (OSM) are 450 m west. In tambon Ko Kaeo, 3.7 km outside the guide's phuket-town area
items.gmapsQuery: Royal Phuket Marina, Phuket
items.description: A marina on the east coast north of Phuket Town. Several premium tour companies, such as Simba Sea Trips, start Phang Nga Bay, Phi Phi and Khai trips here, and private yachts and speedboats can be chartered. Many tours serve breakfast here before you board. Boat Lagoon marina is next door.

routes.to: Phang Nga Bay, Phi Phi and Khai Islands (tours)
routes.operator: Simba Sea Trips and other premium tour companies

items.facilities: Restaurants, a coffee shop, toilets and covered waiting areas.
items.gettingThere: From Patong 21 km (25-40 min), Kamala 19 km (25-45 min), Rawai 27 km (35-50 min), the airport 24 km (35-45 min). Tours include hotel pickup. Grab or Bolt from Patong costs a bit more than Patong - Phuket Town (300-400 THB on the apps, Aug 2026).
items.feeText: No passenger fee. Park fees depend on the trip (Phi Phi 400 THB, Phang Nga Bay 300 THB).
tips: Boat Lagoon is the marina next door: check which one your voucher names.
For a private boat for the group of 8, ask charter companies here and at Chalong for quotes.
items.verification: Fact-check 19 Oct 2026. Official site: map link 7.9667795, 98.3907544 and og:image. Phuket 101 piers guide (9 Aug 2026): Simba Sea Trips and others, Phang Nga, Phi Phi and Similan tours, private charters, restaurants, coffee shop, toilets, covered waiting areas, breakfast before departure, Boat Lagoon next door. Phuket 101 Khai page (29 Aug 2026): Khai tours from Royal Phuket Marina. Area changed from phuket-town to koh-kaew: the pin is 3.7 km outside the phuket-town polygon. OSRM: Patong 20.6 km, Kamala 19.4, Rawai 26.8, airport 24.1.

items.name: Thap Lamu Pier (Khao Lak, for the Similan Islands)
items.coordSource: Google place via Visit Thailand Today (8.57013, 98.22324) + OSM ferry_terminal node 2466095538 (3 m); same as the guide's existing Similan directions. Love Andaman Pier (OSM way 764568204) 90 m; park office (OSM way 438927105) 700 m east
items.gmapsQuery: Tap Lamu Pier, Thai Mueang, Phang Nga
items.description: A working pier 15 km south of Khao Lak, where nearly all Similan day trips start. Vans bring you here, you check in at your company's desk at about 08:00, and speedboats or catamarans leave for the islands, about 70 km out, soon after. Day trips come back at 16:30-17:30.
items.openText: Similan boats run only while the park is open: 15 Oct 2026 - 15 May 2027.

routes.operator: Similan day-trip companies (sold by Tisland and others)
routes.times: check-in about 08:00, boats leave soon after; back at 16:30-17:30
routes.duration: 1 h 15 min - 1 h 30 min each way
routes.priceText: about 2,500-3,800 THB per person from Phuket, with transfer, lunch and park fee

items.facilities: Operator desks, a few cafes and the boats; some companies, such as Love Andaman, have their own small piers here. The Similan park office is 700 m east.
items.gettingThere: About 100 km from Patong (1.5-2 h), 90 km from Kamala, 111 km from Rawai, 71 km from the airport (about 70 min). Tours pick up in Phuket from about 05:30. The airport limousine counter charges 1,600 THB per car to Thap Lamu.
items.feeText: Similan park fee 500 THB adult, 250 child; included in most tours or collected at the pier.
tips: Only 3,325 day visitors a day are allowed: book January trips well ahead.
Sleeping one night in Khao Lak saves the 05:30 pickup and 3-4 hours of driving.
Take a seasickness pill before the 1.5-hour open-sea crossing, even in calm January.
items.verification: Fact-check 19 Oct 2026. items.description: Krabi Town's passenger port, 3 km south of the centre. Big ferries leave here for Koh Phi Phi several times a day, and from November to April also boats to Koh Lanta. If you stay in Ao Nang or Railay, use Nopparat Thara pier or Railay East instead: it saves the drive.

routes.to: Phuket (Rassada, Laem Hin or Bang Rong)

items.name: Tonsai Pier (Koh Phi Phi Don)

items.description: The main pier of Koh Phi Phi Don, in Tonsai village. Almost all ferries and speedboats from Phuket, Krabi, Ao Nang, Railay, Lanta and Lipe land here. There are no cars on the island: you walk, or a porter pushes your bags on a cart. Pay the 20-baht island fee as you step off.

Bundhaya, Andaman Wave Master and other speedboats

routes.season: all year; more boats November to April

items.name: Manoh Pier (Koh Yao Noi)
items.coordSource: Google place via Visit Thailand Today (8.09365, 98.58705) + OSM ferry_terminal node 2415555147 (19 m)

items.description: The main pier of Koh Yao Noi, on the south-west coast. Public speedboats and longtails from Bang Rong on Phuket land here after 30-60 minutes. Shared taxis and hotel drivers wait at the end of the jetty, and longtails cross to Chong Lard pier on Koh Yao Yai in about 10 minutes.

routes.priceText: speedboat about 400 THB, longtail about 300 THB

routes.operator: Bundhaya, Green Planet and other through speedboats (some call here)
routes.duration: about 40 min to Ao Nang, 1 h 10 min to Rassada
routes.priceText: Bundhaya 650 THB to Ao Nang, 550 THB to Rassada
routes.season: mostly mid-Oct to early May (Bundhaya to 4 May)

items.facilities: Shared taxis and hotel drivers wait at the end of the jetty.
items.gettingThere: Boat only: 30-40 min by speedboat from Bang Rong pier on Phuket.
items.feeText: No pier or island fee.
tips: The last boat back to Phuket leaves at about 16:00.
For Krabi, wooden boats leave from Tha Khao pier on the north-east coast (about 40 min to Ao Thalane, 120-150 THB), not from Manoh.
Bring enough cash: ATMs on the island can run out at weekends.
items.verification: Fact-check 19 Oct 2026. items.description: A small pier at the north-east tip of Koh Yao Yai, facing Koh Yao Noi. routes.times: first about 06:30; last boats about 16:00 (16:10 from Klong Hia)

routes.to: Phuket (Laem Hin) and Ao Nang, from Klong Hia Pier

items.gettingThere: Boat only: about 30 min from Bang Rong pier on Phuket.
items.feeText: No pier or island fee.
tips: Ask your hotel which pier is closer: Chong Lard (north-east) or Klong Hia (north-west).
There is no regular public transport: scooters cost about 250-350 THB a day.

items.name: Koh Lipe arrival point (Pattaya Beach)
items.coordSource: OSM ferry_terminal node 5425777804 'Ko Lipe' on Pattaya Beach; Bundhaya Resort (boat check-in area, OSM node 1058873129) 70 m; boats tie up at a floating platform or anchor offshore
items.gmapsQuery: Pattaya Beach, Koh Lipe, Satun
items.description: Koh Lipe has no big pier. Boats from Phuket, Lanta, Pak Bara and Langkawi tie up at a floating platform or anchor off Pattaya Beach, and longtails take you and your bags to the sand. Expect wet feet. The island is in Tarutao National Park, so everyone pays the park fee on arrival.

routes.to: Phuket (Rassada), via Lanta and Phi Phi
routes.operator: Satun Pakbara Speed Boat Club, Bundhaya

items.facilities: Walking Street, with shops, restaurants and a 7-Eleven, starts at Pattaya Beach. No cars: motorbike sidecars cost about 50 THB per person.
items.gettingThere: Only by boat: about 5 h by direct speedboat from Phuket in high season, or 1 h 30 min from Pak Bara all year.
items.feeText: Tarutao National Park fee 200 THB adult, 100 child, cash on arrival; keep the ticket. Divers pay 200 THB more per diving day. Longtail from the boat to the beach about 50 THB per person.
tips: Pack electronics in a dry bag: the longtail transfer is often wet.
From May to October only the Pak Bara boats run.
Lipe is too far for a day trip from Phuket: plan at least 3 nights.
items.verification: Fact-check 19 Oct 2026. items.description: Koh Phangan's main port, in Thong Sala town on the south-west coast. Almost every boat from Samui, Koh Tao and the mainland lands here, and each company has its own counter. Songthaew trucks wait outside; there is no Grab on the island. Ban Tai is about 10 minutes away.

routes.priceText: 350 THB; 500 with the van to Samui airport
350 THB; 500 to Samui airport (there about 12:00 or 12:30 on the morning boats)

routes.operator: Lomprayah; Boonsiri and Songserm (sold by Seatran Discovery)
routes.times: Lomprayah 08:30 (also stops at Koh Nang Yuan), 08:45 (speedboat), 11:15, 12:00 (ferry), 13:00, 13:05, 16:45; Boonsiri 08:45, 13:15, 15:45; Songserm 12:00 (ferry, from its own pier 300 m north-west)

items.facilities: Counters for every boat company, a 7-Eleven, ATMs and food stalls. Songthaew taxis wait outside the gate.
items.gettingThere: Shared songthaew to Ban Tai or Haad Rin about 100-200 THB per person (20-30 min); Thong Nai Pan 400-600 THB per truck (45-60 min). Lomprayah sells a drop at your hotel for 200 THB per person.
items.feeText: No pier fee.
tips: There is no Grab or Bolt on Koh Phangan: agree the songthaew price before you get in.
The morning after the Full Moon (Sat 23 Jan) is the busiest of the month: book the boat when you book the flight.
Give a Samui flight about 2.5 hours from the boat's arrival at Bangrak.
Koh Tao day trip: the 08:30 Lomprayah (it stops at Koh Nang Yuan), back on the 15:30 catamaran or the 16:30 ferry from Mae Haad. See the Mae Haad Pier card.

items.name: Haad Rin Pier (Haad Rin Queen, Koh Phangan)
items.coordSource: OSM 'Haadrin Queen Pier' ferry_terminal node 1827305028 and 'Haad Rin Queen' ticket node 3770137358 (65 m); Commons photo geotag (9.67333, 100.06333, 60 m)
items.gmapsQuery: Haadrin Queen Pier, Haad Rin, Koh Phangan
items.description: The small pier at the west end of Haad Rin village, about 5 minutes' walk from Sunrise Beach, where the Full Moon Party happens. Only the Haad Rin Queen boats use it: a wooden ferry and a speedboat to the Big Buddha pier on Samui. On Full Moon nights speedboats run all night.

routes.to: Koh Samui (Big Buddha pier), Full Moon night
routes.times: all night on Full Moon Party nights
routes.season: Full Moon nights only (next: Fri 22 Jan 2027)

items.facilities: Haad Rin Queen ticket desk; Haad Rin village shops and bars around it.
items.gettingThere: From Thong Sala pier 11 km (20-30 min by songthaew, 100-200 THB per person); from Ban Tai 10-20 min.
items.feeText: No pier fee. The Full Moon Party entry (200 THB) is separate.
tips: Buy tickets at the pier desk (cash), on the official website or through the Seatran Discovery site.
After the Full Moon, the 09:30 ferry is the first boat to Samui; the 12:30 speedboat reaches Bangrak at 12:55.
items.verification: Fact-check 19 Oct 2026. Haad Rin Queen's own schedule API for 19, 22 and 23 Jan 2027: Haad Rin - Samui ferry 09:30 (10:20) and 16:00 (16:50), 200 THB; speedboat 12:30 (12:55) and 17:00 (17:25), 500 THB. The Seatran Discovery engine sells the same boats, so 'other booking sites do not sell them' was wrong. Visit Thailand Today (28 Sep 2026): west end of the village, 5 min walk from Sunrise Beach, all-night Full Moon speedboats about 18 min and about 500 THB. The 2003 photo of another ferry was dropped. Full Moon date as in the guide.

Bus and boat tickets from Phuket drive straight to the right pier.

Koh Phangan (Thong Sala), from the Seatran pier
Nathon and Thong Sala, from the Lomprayah pier

items.feeText: No pier fee.
tips: Raja adds extra sailings from 30 Dec to 30 Apr when many cars wait.
To reach Samui the same evening, arrive before the 19:00 boat.

items.name: Koh Lanta
items.nameThai: เกาะลันตา
items.coordSource: google maps 'Ban Sala Dan Pier (Koh Lanta)' + osm ferry_terminal node 260742654 'Sala Dan Pier' (7.64875, 99.04116), 58 m apart (re-checked 19 Oct 2026). Pin = Saladan Pier in the north, where all boats from Phuket land
items.gmapsQuery: Ban Sala Dan Pier, Koh Lanta, Krabi
items.description: A long, relaxed island south-east of Phi Phi. The west coast has sunset beaches (Klong Dao, Long Beach, Klong Khong, Kantiang) and the east coast a wooden Old Town on stilts. Good for 3 or more quiet nights and snorkel trips to Koh Rok and the Trang islands. A few beach bars, but not a party island.
items.feeText: Speedboat from Phuket about 1,260-1,700 THB one way (1 h 30 min); slow ferry via Phi Phi 820-1,000 THB (about 4 h). National park at the south tip 200 THB. Scooter 200-300 THB a day.
items.openText: Boats leave Rassada Pier at 08:30, 11:00 and 12:30 (Oct 2026 timetable; check again in December). Back from Saladan Pier: ferry 08:00, speedboats 09:00-14:30.
items.bestTime: Stay at least 3 nights. November to April has calm sea for the Koh Rok trip. The west-coast beaches face the sunset.
items.gettingThere: Speedboat or ferry from Rassada Pier (Phuket Town) to Saladan Pier; the boats stop at Phi Phi. From Phi Phi it is 30 min by speedboat (about 700 THB). Grab barely works on Lanta: use tuk-tuks (Saladan to Kantiang 400-800 THB) or a scooter.
tips: Best day trip: the Koh Rok speedboat, about 1,800 THB plus a 400 THB park fee. Koh Rok is open in January.
The 4 Islands trip (Emerald Cave on Koh Mook, Kradan, Ngai, Chueak) costs about 1,000-2,000 THB plus a 200 THB park fee.
Nightlife is small: beach bars on Long Beach and Klong Khong, a fire show at 20:30 at Why Not Bar, and Pangea's Deep Sundays (see Events).
Lanta Old Town is good in the late afternoon, with a seafood dinner over the water.
The last speedboat back to Phuket leaves Saladan at about 14:30. Do not plan a flight on the same day.

links.label: Koh Lanta guide (Visit Thailand Today, Oct 2026)

items.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. phuketferry.com (19 Oct 2026): Rassada speedboats 08:30, 11:00, 12:30 (Satun Pakbara, Bundhaya) 1,490-1,500 THB adult, 1 h 30 min; ferries 08:30 (Phi Phi Cruiser 820, Lanta Petpailin 1,000) 4 h; back: ferry 08:00, speedboats 09:00-14:30; Phi Phi - Lanta 30 min, 700 THB. Visit Thailand Today (15 Oct 2026): speedboat 1,260-1,700 THB, ferries via Phi Phi Nov-Apr, Koh Rok about 1,800 + 400 THB fee (Koh Rok closed Jun-Sep), 4 Islands longtail about 1,000 THB + 200 fee, Grab barely works, tuk-tuk 400-800, 3 nights minimum. Why Not Bar fire show 20:30: Visit Thailand Today nightlife page (2026). Park fee 200 THB at the south tip: thainationalparks.com (Jun 2026). Scooter 200-300 THB: Byklo (2026), 12Go. Coords: Google + OSM agree. The Koh Haa name was taken out of the Koh Rok tip: the sources price the Koh Rok trip only.

items.name: Bamboo Island (Koh Mai Phai)
items.nameThai: เกาะไม้ไผ่
items.coordSource: Commons geotags 'Bamboo Beach, Ko Mai Phai' and 'Long tail boats at Ko Mai Phai' (7.8183-7.8184, 98.7972) on osm beach way 270845225 'Bamboo Beach' (12 m from its edge, 88 m from its centre; re-checked 19 Oct 2026). Pin = the boat landing on Bamboo Beach
items.gmapsQuery: Ko Mai Phai (Bamboo Island), Krabi
items.description: A small, flat island about 5 km north of Phi Phi Don, with white sand and shallow, clear water. There are no restaurants or hotels, only a ranger station. Snorkelling at the edges is fair. Most Phi Phi day tours stop here for 30-45 minutes, so midday is busy.
items.feeText: Phi Phi national park fee 400 THB per adult (child 200), the same ticket as Maya Bay. Usually part of a Phi Phi tour (1,500-3,500 THB). Private longtail or speedboat from Phi Phi Don about 1,500-2,500 THB per boat.
items.openText: Day visits only. Camping on the island is not allowed.
items.bestTime: Morning, about 09:00-10:00: few boats and clear water. Midday and early afternoon are busiest, with 15-20 speedboats.
items.gettingThere: Pick a Phi Phi speedboat tour from Phuket that lists Bamboo Island, or stay on Phi Phi Don and hire a boat at Tonsai for an early trip.
tips: There are no restaurants on the island. Bring water, a snack and something for shade.
No alcohol: the island is national park land.
Ask your tour at what time it stops here. A morning stop means more space and clearer water.
Do not stand on coral, and use reef-safe sunscreen.
items.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. Phuket 101 (updated 20 Mar 2026): about 5 km north of Phi Phi, ranger station only, no restaurants or hotels, 400/200 THB fee, private boat from Phi Phi Don 1,500-2,500 THB, 30-45 min tour stops, 15-20 speedboats at midday, quieter about 09:00-10:00. No camping on the outer islands: thainationalparks.com (Jun 2026; it lists 200 THB, but Phuket 101, Tisland and Siam Tour and Realty 2026 give 400). Coords: Commons geotags + OSM beach.

items.name: Koh Yao Yai
items.nameThai: เกาะยาวใหญ่
items.coordSource: Google 'Laem Haad Beach', Ko Yao Yai (8.0823005, 98.5986407), 19 Oct 2026; the old pin was Chong Lard Pier, now its own card
items.gmapsQuery: Laem Haad Beach, Ko Yao Yai
items.description: The bigger, emptier sister of Koh Yao Noi, 30 min by speedboat from Phuket. Rubber farms, Muslim fishing villages and long quiet beaches: Laem Haad sandbar in the north, Loh Pared on the west coast for swimming and sunset. No bars or nightlife. Good for a calm scooter day or a resort night.
items.feeText: Speedboat Bang Rong - Koh Yao Yai 390-400 THB one way (30-40 min). Laem Haad sandbar is free. Scooter about 250-350 THB a day.
items.openText: Speedboats from Bang Rong Pier about 08:30-17:00. Back to Bang Rong about 06:30-16:00; the last one leaves Chong Lard Pier at 16:00 (Oct 2026).
items.bestTime: Go to Laem Haad at low tide, when the sandbar is out. Loh Pared is best for swimming and sunset. November to April is calm.
items.gettingThere: Grab or taxi to Bang Rong Pier (north-east Phuket). Speedboat 30-40 min to Chong Lard or Klong Hia Pier at the north end. Book a scooter or hotel pickup ahead: transport at the pier is not guaranteed.
tips: Check a tide table the night before. At high tide the Laem Haad sandbar is mostly under water.
Alcohol is not sold everywhere. Dress modestly in the villages.
There is little shade at Laem Haad. Bring water and sun cream.
Other boats: Rassada Pier at 09:00 (about 800 THB, hotel pickup) and Laem Hin Pier at 13:00 (about 400 THB).
From the island, longtails go to Koh Hong, Koh Panyee and James Bond Island.
items.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. phuketferry.com (19 Oct 2026): Bang Rong to Chong Lard or Klong Hia 08:30-17:00, 390-400 THB, 30-40 min (Solomon, Koh Yao Sun Smile, Green Planet); back 06:30-16:00 (last: Solomon 16:00 from Chong Lard); Rassada 09:00 Bundhaya 800 THB with hotel pickup; Laem Hin 13:00 Green Planet 400 THB. The old tip read as if both cost 800; fixed. Phuket 101 (31 Jul 2026): Laem Haad free, Loh Pared on the west for swimming and sunset, no bars, alcohol not sold everywhere, arrange pickup, longtail trips to Koh Hong, Panyee and James Bond Island, motorbike from about 250 THB. Thai Holiday Guide (Sep 2026): sandbar only at low tide. Coords: OSM + Google agree.

items.name: Koh Panyee (stilt village)
items.nameThai: เกาะปันหยี
items.coordSource: Commons geotags 'Pier - panoramio (11)' and village photos (8.3359-8.3362, 98.5035); google maps 'Ko Panyi Darussalam Mosque' 95 m west; osm islet relation 5886070 'Ko Panyi' centre 72 m away (re-checked 19 Oct 2026). Google's plain 'Ko Panyi' pin is 2.9 km off. Pin = the main pier
items.gmapsQuery: Ko Panyi Darussalam Mosque, Phang Nga
items.description: A Muslim fishing village built on stilts against a limestone rock in Phang Nga Bay, home to about 1,600 people. Walk past the souvenir lanes to the mosque, the school and the floating football pitch. Most James Bond Island tours stop here for lunch. No alcohol is sold.
items.feeText: The island is inside Ao Phang Nga National Park: park fee 300 THB (child 150), included in most tours. Phang Nga Bay tours from about 1,400 THB. On your own: longtail from Surakul Pier about 1,500 THB per boat, 20 min each way.
items.openText: Tour boats arrive about 11:00-13:00. When the tours leave in the afternoon, the village goes quiet.
items.bestTime: Before 10:00 or in the late afternoon, outside the tour lunch rush (11:00-13:00).
items.gettingThere: Most people come on a Phang Nga Bay tour from Phuket. On your own: drive about 90 min to Surakul Pier (Phang Nga) and hire a longtail there.
tips: Cover shoulders and knees, most of all near the mosque. No alcohol, pork or smoking in the village.
Ask before you photograph people, their homes or the school.
The floating football pitch is at the far end, past the souvenir area. Kids play there in the evening.
Simple rooms exist on the island if you want to see it after the tours leave.
items.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. Phuket 101 (updated 26 Mar 2026): stilt village (not floating), about 1,600 people in 360 families, mosque on the only solid ground, football pitch renovated in 2024, tours 11:00-13:00, before 10:00 is quiet, Surakul longtail about 1,500 THB and 20 min, about 90 min drive from Phuket, no alcohol, pork or smoking, simple bungalows (James Bond Hotel). Thai Holiday Guide (Jul 2026): about 1,600 people, lunch stop crowded by mid-morning, park fee 300 THB. The old 'No entry fee' was changed: Tourscanner and a charter site say visitors pay the Ao Phang Nga park fee (300/150); no source says the village itself charges. The claim that the souvenir shops close had no source and was cut. Surakul Pier = osm node 2328228554. Coords: Commons geotags + Google mosque + OSM islet.

items.name: Surin Islands (Mu Ko Surin)
items.nameThai: หมู่เกาะสุรินทร์
items.coordSource: google maps 'Tourist Information National Park Kho Surin Ao Chong Kad' + osm way 660649792 'Chong Khad Coffee' (9.42239, 97.86950) at the park HQ, 9 m apart; osm beach 'Ao Chong Khad' 120 m north (re-checked 19 Oct 2026). Pin = park HQ at Ao Chong Khad on Koh Surin Nuea, where the boats land
items.gmapsQuery: Chong Khad Bay, Mu Ko Surin National Park
items.description: A remote marine park near the Myanmar border, known for clear water and shallow coral reefs. Day trips snorkel in several bays and visit a Moken (sea people) village on Koh Surin Tai. From Phuket it is a very long day (11-12 h), so many people go from Khao Lak or sleep a night in the park tents.
items.feeText: Park fee 500 THB (child 250), e-ticket. Day tour from Khao Lak about USD 100, from Phuket about USD 114. Park tent 300-450 THB a night, bungalow 3,000 THB. 2-day tent tour from Phuket from 6,500 THB (Tisland).
items.openText: Season 15 Oct 2026 - 15 May 2027, daily 08:30-16:30. In January the park campsite is at Ao Mai Ngam (open 1 Dec - 15 May).
items.bestTime: December to April has the calmest sea. Boats leave the pier about 09:00 and are back about 17:00.
items.gettingThere: Tours include the van to Khura Buri Pier (pickup about 05:30 in Phuket, or about 1 h from Khao Lak), then a speedboat of about 1-1.5 h. There are no public ferries.
tips: No alcohol on the islands (fine 1,000 THB). Bring cash: there are no ATMs.
In the Moken village, wear a shirt over swimwear and ask before you take photos.
Book park tents by phone (076 472 145 or 076 472 146). The online booking was down in 2026.
The open sea can be rough. Take a seasickness pill before the 1-1.5 h boat ride.
Bring your passport or a copy for the park ticket.
Do not mix it up with Surin Beach in Phuket.
items.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. thainationalparks.com (Jun 2026): 500/250 THB, open 15 Oct - 15 May 08:30-16:30, campsites Ao Chong Khad 15 Oct - 30 Nov and Ao Mai Ngam 1 Dec - 15 May, tents 300-450 THB, bungalows 3,000 THB, online booking down, phone 076 472 145 / 146, Moken village on Ko Surin Tai, boats from Khura Buri Pier, no public ferries, day trips from Phuket not advised (pier 3.5-4 h by road). Tisland tour page (Oct 2026): 2D/1N tent from 6,500 THB, pickup 05:30, boat 09:00-10:20 and 15:30-17:00, park fee included, alcohol fine 1,000 THB. Siam Tour and Realty (15 Oct 2026): Surin open for 2026-27. Thai Holiday Guide (Jul 2026): Khao Lak day trip USD 100 (9-10 h), Phuket USD 114 (11-12 h), no ATM. Coords: Google + OSM.

items.name: Koh Lipe
items.nameThai: เกาะหลีเป๊ะ
items.coordSource: google maps 'Pattaya Beach' on Koh Lipe; osm beach way 91115478 'Pattaya Beach' 12 m away (108 m from its centre); osm ferry_terminal node 5425777804 (floating pier) 360 m south-east (re-checked 19 Oct 2026). Pin = Pattaya Beach, where the boats from Phuket arrive
items.gmapsQuery: Pattaya Beach, Koh Lipe, Satun
items.description: A small island near the Malaysian border with white sand and very clear water, in the Tarutao national park area. Walking Street has cafes and bars, and Pattaya Beach has fire shows at night; Sunrise and Sunset beaches are quieter. It is 5 hours by speedboat from Phuket, so plan at least 3 nights.
items.feeText: Speedboat from Phuket 2,430-2,450 THB one way. Tarutao national park fee 200 THB in cash (valid 5 days). Longtail from the floating pier to the beach about 50 THB if not included.
items.openText: Speedboat from Rassada Pier at 08:30, arriving about 13:30 (stops at Phi Phi, Lanta and the Trang islands). Back from Lipe at 10:30, in Phuket about 16:00.
items.bestTime: November to April. The nearby park islands (Adang, Rawi) close from mid-May to mid-October.
items.gettingThere: Satun Pakbara Speed Boat Club or Bundhaya speedboat from Rassada Pier (about 5 h). From Koh Lanta: 10:30 boat, 3 h, about 1,700 THB. Boats stop at a floating pier off Pattaya Beach; a longtail takes you to the sand.
tips: With only a few free days, Koh Lanta (1.5 h) or the Trang islands (about 3 h) are much closer.
Fire shows on Pattaya Beach are the main night out. Bars line Pattaya Beach and Walking Street.
Longtail day trips go to Koh Adang (viewpoint), Koh Rawi and the pebble beach of Koh Hin Ngam.
Keep your park ticket: it is valid for 5 days on the other Tarutao islands.
items.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. phuketferry.com (19 Oct 2026): Rassada 08:30 to Pattaya Beach 13:30 (Satun Pakbara, Bundhaya), 2,430-2,450 THB adult, 6 stops; back 10:30 to Rassada 16:00; Lanta 10:30 to Lipe 13:30, 1,690-1,700 THB (route runs Oct-May only). GoAsia (17 Oct 2026): no deep-water pier, floating platform then longtail, park fee in cash. go-ferry and operator listings: longtail about 50 THB if not included. Thaizer (2026): park fee 200 THB valid 5 days, fire shows on Pattaya Beach, Nov-Apr. Coords: on the OSM Pattaya Beach way.

items.name: Trang islands: Koh Ngai, Koh Mook and Koh Kradan
items.nameThai: เกาะไหง เกาะมุก เกาะกระดาน
items.coordSource: osm hotel node 1700049055 'Thapwarin Resort' (7.42069, 99.20642) on Koh Ngai's east beach, 43 m away, + Commons geotag 'Ko nghai LT' (7.42035, 99.20676); osm island relation 12088738 centre 500 m south-west (re-checked 19 Oct 2026). Pin = Koh Ngai's main east beach, the first stop of the boats from Phuket. Emerald Cave (Koh Mook) is at 7.3694, 99.2836
items.gmapsQuery: Ko Ngai, Trang
items.description: Three quiet islands south of Lanta. On Koh Mook you swim 80 m through the dark Emerald Cave to a hidden beach. Koh Kradan has a long white beach with coral close to shore, and Koh Ngai has calm water and resorts. No nightlife. Best with 2 or more nights.
items.feeText: Speedboat from Phuket 1,850-1,950 THB one way (2.5-3.5 h). From Koh Lanta 650-900 THB (40-50 min). Emerald Cave and Kradan (Hat Chao Mai park): park fee 200 THB. 4 Islands day tour from Lanta about 1,000-2,000 THB.
items.openText: Boats leave Rassada Pier at 08:30 and 12:30. The morning boat reaches Koh Ngai about 11:00, Koh Mook 11:20 and Kradan 11:35. Back: about 11:00-12:50, in Phuket 14:30-16:00.
items.bestTime: Enter the Emerald Cave before 09:00, before the tour groups; times move with the tide. Open October to May (the cave is closed 1 Jun - 30 Sep).
items.gettingThere: Satun Pakbara Speed Boat Club or Bundhaya speedboat from Rassada Pier; it is the same boat that continues to Koh Lipe. Longtails link the three islands. From the mainland, boats leave Pak Meng and Hat Yao piers in Trang.
tips: The cave tunnel is pitch dark in the middle and floods at high tide. Life jackets are used, and guides help weak swimmers.
Sleep on Koh Mook to swim into the Emerald Cave early, before the day boats from Lanta arrive.
Too far for a day trip from Phuket. From Koh Lanta, the 4 Islands tour covers all three in one day, with lunch on Kradan.
items.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. phuketferry.com (19 Oct 2026): Rassada 08:30 (Bundhaya, Satun Pakbara) to Koh Ngai 11:00-11:10 (1,850-1,900 THB adult) and 12:30 to 15:40; Koh Mook 08:30 to 11:20 and 12:30 to 15:50 (1,950); Kradan 11:35 (1,950); back from Koh Ngai 11:30 and 12:50, Koh Mook 11:00 and 12:30, in Rassada 14:30-16:00; Lanta to Koh Ngai 650 THB, to Koh Mook 900 THB. Thai Holiday Guide (Jul 2026): Emerald Cave 80 m pitch-dark swim, floods at high tide, closed 1 Jun - 30 Sep, Hat Chao Mai fee 200/100 THB, best before 09:00, life jackets and guides with ropes, mainland piers Pak Meng, Khuan Tung Ku and Hat Yao. Lanta 4 Islands about 1,000 THB (Visit Thailand Today, Oct 2026) to USD 57 (Expedia, 2026).

items.name: Koh Racha Noi
items.nameThai: เกาะราชาน้อย
items.coordSource: osm node 9412211176 'Banana Bay' (dive and snorkel mooring, 7.49839, 98.32507), in the bay about 200 m off the east coast of the osm island way 24936539 'Ko Raya Noi' (re-checked 19 Oct 2026). The old pin (7.50394, 98.32664) was inland, 640 m from this node, not 'the same point' as claimed. Pin = Banana Bay, where the snorkel boats moor; the island has no pier
items.gmapsQuery: Ko Racha Noi, Phuket
items.description: A wild island south of Racha Yai, 60-90 min by speedboat from Phuket. No village, hotel or restaurant: just rocky coves and very clear water, often over 20 m visibility. Snorkel boats stop in sheltered bays such as Banana Bay on the east side. Divers come for big boulders, leopard sharks and, with luck, manta rays.
items.feeText: Free entry. Snorkel day tour Racha Noi + Racha Yai from about 2,800 THB with breakfast, lunch and hotel transfer (Tisland). Dive shops in Chalong run dive day trips.
items.openText: Day trips only. Tour boats leave the pier about 09:00 and are back about 16:00-17:00.
items.bestTime: November to April, on a calm day. Manta rays pass from about January to March, but sightings are rare.
items.gettingThere: Hotel pickup about 07:00, then speedboat from Chalong Pier (60-90 min). Most tours have lunch on Racha Yai. The south coast has strong currents and swell: snorkellers stay in the sheltered bays.
tips: There is nothing to buy on the island. Tours serve lunch on Racha Yai.
Pick a calm day: Racha Noi gets more swell and current than Racha Yai.
Some tours add Koh Maiton to look for dolphins. Landing on Maiton is suspended (Phuket 101, Mar 2026).
items.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. Thai Holiday Guide (Jul 2026): no village, restaurant or shop, about 90 min from Chalong, visibility often 20-30 m, shallower northern bays calmer, exposed south coast with stronger current, mantas seasonal and not guaranteed, free entry, Nov-Apr. Dive-site pages (Aussie Divers, Phuket 101, Sea Bees): Banana Bay is the sheltered bay on the east side, halfway between the north and south tips, good for snorkelling. The old text put Banana Bay 'in the north'; fixed. Tisland tour page (Oct 2026): from 2,800 THB, pickup 07:00, boat 09:00, Racha Noi 10:00-11:00 with Banana Bay snorkel, lunch on Racha Yai, Maiton dolphin stop, at the pier 17:00. Phuket 101 (12 Mar 2026): Maiton access suspended. No free photo found on Commons or Wikidata.

items.name: Koh Samui
items.nameThai: เกาะสมุย
items.coordSource: google maps 'Chaweng Beach'; osm beach way 246391044 'Hat Chaweng' 54 m east of the pin, with beachfront hotels around it (re-checked 19 Oct 2026). Pin = central Chaweng Beach; Samui airport (osm) is about 1.9 km north
items.gmapsQuery: Chaweng Beach, Koh Samui
items.description: Thailand's second-biggest island, in the Gulf. You land here on the way to Koh Phangan. Chaweng is the busy beach and bar strip (Sound Club, see Events); Fisherman's Village in Bophut has a walking street on Monday, Wednesday and Friday evenings. Ang Thong park trips start here.
items.feeText: Flight Phuket - Samui about 4,700-4,900 THB one way (Oct 2026). Boat Samui - Koh Phangan 350 THB, or 500 THB with the van from the airport. Grab Bangrak - Chaweng about 250-350 THB.
items.openText: Fisherman's Village walking street: Mon, Wed and Fri about 17:00-23:00 (Friday is the biggest).
items.bestTime: On this trip Samui is a transfer point. Allow about 2.5 hours between a boat to Bangrak pier and your flight.
items.gettingThere: Bangkok Airways flies Phuket - Samui in about 1 hour. Bangrak (Big Buddha) pier, for boats to Koh Phangan, is about 10 minutes from the airport; Chaweng is about 15 minutes from Bangrak.
tips: Grab works on Samui, but not on Koh Phangan.
Fisherman's Village is close to Bangrak and the airport: a good dinner stop. Bring cash for the stalls.
Ang Thong Marine Park tours leave from Nathon or Bophut. See its card.

links.label: Koh Phangan to Koh Samui guide (Sep 2026)

items.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. Visit Thailand Today (28 Sep 2026): Bangrak about 10 min from the airport and 15 min from Chaweng, Grab Bangrak - Chaweng 250-350 THB, boats 350 THB, allow 2.5 h between the boat and a flight. Thai Holiday Guide (Jun 2026): walking street Mon, Wed, Fri 17:00-23:00, Friday biggest, cash for stalls (older Hotels.com pages say Friday only; Friday is safe either way). Flight fares and Grab on Samui: this guide's Info and Apps pages (Google Flights 16 Oct 2026; Grab city list). Samui is Thailand's second-largest island after Phuket. Coords: next to the OSM Chaweng beach way.

items.name: Koh Tao and Koh Nang Yuan
items.nameThai: เกาะเต่า เกาะนางยวน
items.coordSource: Google 'Koh Nang Yuan Viewpoint' (10.1148721, 99.8139339) and the OSM islet (relation 7155241, 10.11508, 99.81410), 19 Oct 2026; the old pin was Mae Haad Pier, now its own card
items.gmapsQuery: Koh Nang Yuan Viewpoint, Ko Tao
items.description: A small, rocky diving island 1 hour north of Koh Phangan. Koh Nang Yuan, off its north-west coast, is three islets joined by sandbars, with a famous viewpoint and good snorkelling. Sairee Beach has the bars and beach parties at night. An easy day trip from Koh Phangan.
items.feeText: Boat Thong Sala - Koh Tao 450-600 THB one way. Koh Nang Yuan (a private island) entry about 250 THB in cash (2026; one guide still says 100). Longtail Koh Tao - Nang Yuan about 100-200 THB per person each way.
items.openText: Fast boats leave Thong Sala 08:30-16:45; the 08:30 Lomprayah also stops at Nang Yuan. Back to Koh Phangan for a day trip: Lomprayah 15:30 catamaran or 16:30 ferry.
items.bestTime: Reach Nang Yuan before 11:00, when the day-trip speedboats arrive. Climb the viewpoint first, before the queue.
items.gettingThere: Lomprayah or Boonsiri from Thong Sala Pier (1-1.5 h), or the Songserm ferry from its own pier 300 m north-west (about 1 h 45 min), to Mae Haad Pier. Longtails to Nang Yuan wait at Mae Haad and Sairee Beach (10-15 min). A speedboat snorkel tour from Koh Phangan is the easy option.
tips: Single-use plastic, such as plastic bottles, is not allowed on Nang Yuan. Bring a refillable bottle.
The viewpoint climb takes 15-25 minutes with some rock scrambling. Wear shoes, not flip-flops.
Agree the price and the return time with the longtail driver before you go.
Good for the two of you on Wed 20 or Thu 21 Jan, between the night parties. Check the wind: speedboats can stop on windy days.
Google lists the Nang Yuan viewpoint as open 10:00-15:00.

links.label: Koh Phangan to Koh Tao boats (Oct 2026)

items.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. Visit Thailand Today (18 Oct 2026): Thong Sala departures 08:30-16:45 (Lomprayah, Boonsiri, Songserm), 450-600 THB, 08:30 Lomprayah stops at Nang Yuan 09:45, day-trip returns 15:30 and 16:30, Nang Yuan fee 250 THB, Oct-Dec rough season. The World Travel Guy (2026): 250 THB adult, 100 child, cash, privately owned resort island. Inside Samui (2026): about 100 THB (older figure), no single-use plastic, longtail 100-200 THB, calm until about 11:00, viewpoint 15-25 min; it does not say bags are checked, so that claim was cut. Khaosod (19 Feb 2026): speedboats to Koh Tao and Nang Yuan told to take care in strong wind. Lub d (2026): Sairee is the party beach. Coords: Google + OSM. Directions point moved from the Songserm pier (osm node 1167801500) to the Lomprayah and Seatran ticket offices at the main Thong Sala pier (osm node 3629479156), 330 m east.

items.name: Ang Thong Marine Park
items.nameThai: อุทยานแห่งชาติหมู่เกาะอ่างทอง
items.coordSource: google maps 'Mu Ko Ang Thong National Park Headquarters' + osm camp_site node 4835785007 (20 m) and information node (33 m) at the HQ on Koh Wua Ta Lap; osm pier 150 m north-east; Pha Jun Jaras viewpoint 410 m south (re-checked 19 Oct 2026). Pin = the park HQ beach, start of the viewpoint trail
items.gmapsQuery: Mu Ko Ang Thong National Park Headquarters, Ko Wua Talap
items.description: A national park of limestone islands north-west of Koh Samui. Day tours kayak and snorkel, climb a steep trail to a viewpoint over the islands, and walk up to Emerald Lake, a green salt lake inside an island (no swimming). It closes every year about 1 Nov - 15 Dec, so it is open in January.
items.feeText: Park fee 300 THB (child 150), paid separately in cash. Speedboat day tour from Koh Phangan about 1,900 THB (Click2Go) or from USD 72; bigger boats leave from Samui.
items.openText: Daily 08:00-17:00. Closed about 1 Nov - 15 Dec each year for the monsoon and reef recovery.
items.bestTime: December to April. From Koh Phangan the Click2Go speedboat leaves at 09:20 and is back about 15:45. From Samui, an early speedboat beats the big boats, which arrive about 10:00.
items.gettingThere: Only with a licensed tour boat. From Koh Phangan, speedboat tours pick you up at your hotel (07:30-08:30) or meet at the pier. From Samui, tours leave Nathon or Bophut.
tips: The viewpoint trail is about 500 m but steep, with ropes: 25-45 minutes each way. Wear closed shoes and bring water.
Emerald Lake is about 240-300 steps up. Swimming in the lake is not allowed.
From Thong Nai Pan or Than Sadet, pickup costs 300 THB extra. Bottle Beach (Haad Khuad), Haad Khom and Haad Yuan have no pickup.
No alcohol in the park. Bring cash for the fee: card machines are not reliable.
Strong wind can cancel the trip for a day. Do not plan it for your last day before a flight.
For tour prices and operators from Koh Phangan, see the Ang Thong boat tour card.

links.label: Ang Thong speedboat tour from Koh Phangan (Click2Go)

items.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. Thai Holiday Guide (Jul 2026): 300/150 THB paid separately, 08:00-17:00, closed about 1 Nov - mid-Dec, licensed tours only, viewpoint about 500 m with ropes (25-45 min), Emerald Lake 240-300 steps and no swimming, an early speedboat beats the 10:00 big boats, cash, Phangan speedboat tour from USD 72. Click2Go (Oct 2026): 1,900 THB, pickup 07:30-08:30, departs 09:20, viewpoint or kayak at 13:00, back about 15:45, fee excluded, 300 THB extra for Thong Nai Pan and Than Sadet, no pickup at Haad Khuad (Bottle Beach), Haad Khom, Haad Yuan. So the old 'leave before 08:00' advice does not fit tours from Koh Phangan; reworded. Annual closure 1 Nov - 15 Dec confirmed by Asian Trails (27 Oct 2025) and Siam Tour and Realty (Aug 2026); the old Panorama Destination link is dead (404). Wind closures happen (The Nation, Nov 2023: 2-3 m waves). Coords: Google + OSM. Directions point moved from the Songserm pier to the Lomprayah and Seatran ticket offices at the main Thong Sala pier (osm node 3629479156), 330 m east.

items.name: Koh Phi Phi Don: a night on the island
items.nameThai: เกาะพีพีดอน
items.coordSource: osm pier way 407741133 'Koh Phi Phi Ton Sai Pier' (50 m) + osm ferry_terminal node 3233091096 'Ton Sai Pier' (7.73737, 98.77045), same point (re-checked 19 Oct 2026). Pin = Tonsai Pier, where all ferries land
items.gmapsQuery: Tonsai Pier, Koh Phi Phi Don, Krabi
items.description: Phi Phi's main island, with no cars. Tonsai village sits between two bays, Tonsai and Loh Dalum. When the day boats leave, you get the viewpoint at sunset, quiet beaches and early boats to Maya Bay. At night the Loh Dalum bars run fire shows and loud party music until about 02:00. A backpacker party, not techno.
items.feeText: Ferry from Rassada 450-700 THB (about 2 h); speedboat 750-900 THB (about 1 h). Pier fee 20 THB in cash on arrival. Viewpoint 30-50 THB. Porter cart for bags about 100 THB.
items.openText: Boats from Rassada 08:30-15:30. Back to Phuket until about 17:00 (last speedboat). Slinky Bar on Loh Dalum: 09:00-02:00; the party starts about 23:30.
items.bestTime: One or two nights. Climb the viewpoint before 08:00, or for sunset (busy). Take an early boat to Maya Bay (open from 07:00), before the Phuket day tours arrive.
items.gettingThere: Ferry or speedboat from Rassada Pier (Phuket Town) to Tonsai Pier. From Koh Lanta it is 30 min by speedboat. On the island everything is on foot.
tips: Loh Dalum is a short walk from Tonsai. Slinky and Stones are the big beach bars: buckets and fire shows, cash only.
Rooms right on Loh Dalum can be noisy until about 02:00.
Bars may check your age: carry your passport or a photo of it.
The viewpoint is about 30-45 minutes on foot from the village, with about 320 steps.
items.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. Visit Thailand Today (6 Oct 2026): ferries 500-700 THB, speedboats 750-850, ferries back 09:00-15:30, speedboats until about 17:00, 20 THB pier fee in cash, no cars, porter about 100 THB, stay 1-2 nights. phuketferry.com (19 Oct 2026): Rassada departures 08:30-15:30, 450-900 THB; Tonsai to Phuket until 17:00 (Bundhaya). Thai Holiday Guide (Jun 2026): viewpoint 50 THB, 06:00-19:30, 30-45 min, 320 steps, quiet before 08:00. Visit Thailand Today Slinky page (Oct 2026): 09:00-02:00, fire shows, buckets, cash only, party from about 23:30, about 6 min walk from Tonsai Pier, photo of passport usually fine. Stones Bar on Loh Dalum, open to about 02:30, fire dancers: Hotels.com and Trip.com bar lists. Maya Bay 07:00-18:00: Tisland (28 Sep 2026). Coords: OSM.

items.name: Phi Phi, Maya Bay and Bamboo: small-group speedboat
items.coordSource: google maps 'Maya Bay floating pier' + osm floating pier way 1307182047, 20 m apart (osm bay node 2421130506 'Lo Sa Ma Bay' 120 m east). Tour boats tie up at this pier in Loh Samah Bay and you walk to Maya Bay
items.gmapsQuery: Maya Bay floating pier, Ko Phi Phi Leh, Krabi
items.description: A good way to see Phi Phi Le in one day: a speedboat with max 18 guests that reaches Maya Bay before or after the crowds. Stops: Maya Bay (walk in from the pier, no swimming), Pileh Lagoon, Viking Cave, two snorkel spots and Bamboo Island, with lunch on Phi Phi Don or back at the marina. See also the Maya Bay card.
items.feeText: Small group (max 18), all-inclusive: Simba sunrise from 5,310 THB or its sunset and shark trip from 4,810 THB (Nov-Apr), Phuket Sail Tours 4,400 THB (early or sunset trip). Other good options: Amazing Canoeing 3,300 THB with park fee, Love Andaman 3,500 THB plus 300 THB pickup (park fee not stated). Official sites, Oct 2026.
items.priceText: Small group (max 18), all-inclusive: Simba sunrise from 5,310 THB or its sunset and shark trip from 4,810 THB (Nov-Apr), Phuket Sail Tours 4,400 THB (early or sunset trip). Other good options: Amazing Canoeing 3,300 THB with park fee, Love Andaman 3,500 THB plus 300 THB pickup (park fee not stated). Official sites, Oct 2026.
items.privateCharter: For 8 people a private speedboat costs about the same: Amazing Canoeing Phi Phi + Bamboo 37,500 THB per boat (up to 10, pickup, lunch and park fees included), Andy's Scuba 35,500-37,500 THB (basic boat, up to 10, no transfers, meals or park fees), Phuket Sail Tours from 20,000 THB. See the private speedboat card.
items.includes: Simba and Phuket Sail Tours: hotel pickup from Phuket's main coast, breakfast (on early trips), lunch, drinks, snorkel gear, life jackets, insurance and the 400 THB park fee. Amazing Canoeing: pickup and park fee included; the longtail into Pileh Lagoon costs extra. Love Andaman: pickup 300 THB per person extra; ask about the park fee.
items.departsFrom: Boat Lagoon Marina (Simba, 06:00; its sunset trip leaves mid-morning), Ao Po Pier (Phuket Sail Tours, 08:00), Royal Phuket Marina (Amazing Canoeing, 09:00), Visit Panwa Pier on Cape Panwa (Love Andaman, 09:00).
items.bestTime: Simba leaves at 06:00 and lands at Maya Bay about 07:15, before the day boats. Late options: Phuket Sail Tours' Magic Sunset trip reaches Maya Bay about 16:30, after the crowds; Simba's sunset and shark trip runs November to April.
items.openText: Daily, weather permitting. Maya Bay is open in January (it closes only 1 Aug - 30 Sep).

operators.label: Simba Sea Trips: Phi Phi Sunrise (official)
Phuket Sail Tours: Phi Phi early trip (official)
Amazing Canoeing: Phi Phi + Bamboo (official)
Love Andaman: Phi Phi + Bamboo (official)

links.label: Phuket Sail Tours: Phi Phi Magic Sunset (late Maya Bay)
Simba Sea Trips: Phi Phi Sunset and Shark (Nov-Apr)

tips: Simba stops selling at 18 adults a day, so book January dates early.
After Circoloco (Sun 10 or Sun 17 Jan) skip the 05:00 pickup. Take a late trip: the Magic Sunset picks up about 09:00, and Simba's sunset trip leaves mid-morning.
At Maya Bay you walk in from the pier and may only wade knee-deep. Plan 30-60 minutes there.
Cheaper two-island day: Phi Phi + Khai by speedboat, 2,900 THB with pickup and park fee (Amazing Canoeing).
Seasick? Take a pill 30 minutes before and sit at the back. The morning sea is usually calmer than the ride back.
Bring a dry bag, a towel, cash and reef-safe sunscreen.
items.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026 on the official pages. Simba: from 5,310 THB, Boat Lagoon 06:00, Maya about 07:15, max 18 adults, park fee and pickup included, lunch back at its Soho Pool Club, free cancel 24 h+, TAT 34/02111; sunset and shark trip from 4,810 THB (Nov-Apr); Google 4.9 (1,215). Phuket Sail Tours: 4,400 THB both trips, Ao Po Pier, max 18, Maya about 16:30 on the sunset trip, Google 4.9 (553), no licence number on its site. Amazing Canoeing: 3,300 THB with pickup and park fee. Love Andaman: schema price 3,500 THB, pickup +300 THB, no park fee in its text, TAT 31/00986. Pin: Google 'Maya Bay floating pier' and OSM floating pier way 1307182047 within 20 m. Maya Bay no-swimming rule confirmed by Simba's own 2026 fee guide.

items.name: James Bond Island early speedboat (Phang Nga Bay)
items.coordSource: osm islet way 23492416 (Ko Khao Phing Kan) centre 31 m + google maps 'Khao Phing Kan' island pin 70 m
items.gmapsQuery: James Bond Island, Phang Nga
items.description: Phang Nga Bay by fast boat with a small group that leaves early, so you see James Bond Island and the sea caves before the 10:00-14:00 crowd. Local guides paddle you by canoe through caves into hidden lagoons. The bay is calm, so it suits people who get seasick. See also the Phang Nga Bay card.
items.feeText: Simba 4,500-4,600 THB (max 18, all-inclusive; its site shows both prices). Love Andaman early program (Hong Island first): listed at 4,000 THB plus 300 THB pickup. Cheaper but later: Amazing Canoeing speedboat 2,900 THB, boat at 10:00, max 30. Official sites, Oct 2026.
items.priceText: Simba 4,500-4,600 THB (max 18, all-inclusive; its site shows both prices). Love Andaman early program (Hong Island first): listed at 4,000 THB plus 300 THB pickup. Cheaper but later: Amazing Canoeing speedboat 2,900 THB, boat at 10:00, max 30. Official sites, Oct 2026.
items.privateCharter: Amazing Canoeing private James Bond speedboat from 33,300 THB per boat (up to 10, all-inclusive), or a private longtail from Tha Dan Pier in Phang Nga from about 17,800-19,800 THB (its pages differ). Simba private Phang Nga day from 40,700 THB for 2-4 people, more for 8.
items.includes: Simba: pickup from most of Phuket, breakfast, lunch on Koh Yao Noi, drinks, canoe with a paddle guide, dry bags and the park fee. Amazing Canoeing: pickup anywhere in Phuket, lunch at Koh Panyee, canoe and park fee. Love Andaman: pickup costs 300 THB per person extra; its page does not say if park fees are in.
items.departsFrom: Boat Lagoon Marina (Simba, 07:00-07:15), Visit Panwa Pier on Cape Panwa (Love Andaman early program, 06:30), Royal Phuket Marina (Amazing Canoeing, 10:00).
items.bestTime: Leave by 07:00. Love Andaman's early program leaves at 06:30, visits Hong Island first and James Bond Island about 09:40, and is back at the pier at 15:00.
items.openText: Daily. Simba needs at least 6 guests to run the trip.

operators.label: Simba Sea Trips: Phang Nga Bay (official)
Love Andaman: early program, Hong + James Bond (official)
Amazing Canoeing: speedboat tour (official)

tips: You cannot swim at James Bond Island. Swim stops are at other islands.
Cave canoeing depends on the tide, so the order of stops can change. A Simba guest had a 05:20 pickup because of the tide.
Park fee: 300 THB per adult (150 per child). Simba and Amazing Canoeing include it; ask Love Andaman.
Love Andaman's normal 09:00 program is not sold now (Oct 2026). Its booking button goes to the early program.
Want the bay at sunset with glowing plankton? See the big-boat sunset trip or Hong by Starlight.
items.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026 on the official pages. Simba: 4,500 THB on the tour page and 4,600 on its list, 07:00-07:15 from Soho Pool Club (Boat Lagoon), min 6, max 18, lunch on Koh Yao Noi. Love Andaman: James Bond page says the normal program is unavailable and sends bookings to the early program (05:30 check-in, boat 06:30 from Visit Panwa, Hong 07:30, James Bond 09:40, back 15:00); schema price 4,000 THB; pickup +300 THB; park fee not stated. Amazing Canoeing: 2,900 THB, check-in 09:00, boat 10:00, max 30, park fee included; private from 33,300 THB, longtail 17,800 or 19,800 THB on different pages. Park fee 300/150 THB: Simba 2026 guide and Visit Thailand Today (8 Oct 2026). Pin: Google 'Khao Phing Kan' within 70 m.

items.name: Phang Nga Bay by big boat with sea-cave canoeing
items.coordSource: google maps 'Phanak Island' (247 reviews) + second google listing 'Ko Pa Nak Island' 140 m away; osm island relation 12509126 lies on the same island
items.gmapsQuery: Phanak Island, Ko Yao, Phang Nga
items.description: A slow, steady two-deck boat with lunch on board and canoes. Guides paddle you into the sea caves and hidden lagoons of Panak and Hong islands, then you stop at James Bond Island and a swimming beach. Cheaper than a speedboat and good if you get seasick. A sunset version adds glowing plankton at night.
items.feeText: Amazing Canoeing big boat 2,800 THB with pickup, lunch, two canoe trips and park fee. Phuket Sail Tours James Bond Sunset (big boat, max 20) 4,400 THB with lunch and dinner. Basic big-boat tours from about 1,500 THB plus the 300 THB park fee (Visit Thailand Today, Oct 2026).
items.priceText: Amazing Canoeing big boat 2,800 THB with pickup, lunch, two canoe trips and park fee. Phuket Sail Tours James Bond Sunset (big boat, max 20) 4,400 THB with lunch and dinner. Basic big-boat tours from about 1,500 THB plus the 300 THB park fee (Visit Thailand Today, Oct 2026).
items.privateCharter: June Bahtra junk boat for up to 25 guests: 69,750 THB for 8 hours or 62,500 THB for 4 hours (boat and crew only, 2025 rate card valid to March 2026), plus meals, park fees, canoes, guide and transfers. John Gray's private Hong by Starlight: from 62,750 THB for 1-12 people. Phuket Sail Tours charters its Thai big boat: price on request.
items.includes: Amazing Canoeing: pickup anywhere in Phuket, two canoe trips, paddleboard, lunch, park fee, insurance. Phuket Sail Tours: pickup anywhere in Phuket, park fee, halal lunch and dinner, soft drinks, insurance. June Bahtra: boat, crew, fuel, water and snacks; meals, fees and transfers cost extra.
items.departsFrom: Ao Po Pier, north-east Phuket (Amazing Canoeing at 09:00, Phuket Sail Tours at 14:00). June Bahtra sails from Yacht Haven Marina.
items.bestTime: For plankton choose a dark night early in the trip: new moon is Fri 8 Jan 2027, full moon Fri 22 Jan.
items.openText: Daily.

operators.label: Amazing Canoeing: big boat tour (official)
Phuket Sail Tours: James Bond Sunset big boat (official)
June Bahtra junk cruises (official)

tips: Amazing Canoeing's boat holds 80 people but they cap bookings at 65. Phuket Sail Tours takes max 20.
The sunset trip picks up about 12:00 and is back at the pier about 20:30: good after a late night.
John Gray's Hong by Starlight is the original evening canoe trip, from 3,950 THB. See its card.
Bring swimwear, a towel, insect repellent and a dry change of clothes for the evening.
June Bahtra cancellation is strict: 50% charge from 21 days before, 75% from 14 days, 100% within 7 days.
items.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026 on the official pages. Amazing Canoeing: 2,800 THB adult, pickup about 07:00-07:20, Ao Po check-in 09:00, back at the pier about 17:00, boat for 80 capped at 65, park fee included, Travellers' Choice 2026, no licence number on its site. Phuket Sail Tours: 4,400 THB, max 20, Ao Po public pier, check-in 13:30, back about 20:30, park fee included. June Bahtra: rate PDF says bare-boat rates valid until March 2026; its FAQ gives up to 25 guests and the 21/14/7-day cancellation rule; sails from Yacht Haven.
