items.name: Phang Nga Bay: paddle your own sea kayak
items.coordSource: google maps 'Goh Roi' island + osm islet way 23492476 (Ko Roi), 90 m apart
items.gmapsQuery: Koh Roi, Ko Yao Noi, Phang Nga
items.description: For those who want to paddle, not sit. Paddle Asia runs private trips in real sit-inside kayaks around Koh Kudu and Koh Roi, with a short sea cave into a hidden lagoon, in the quiet north-east of the bay. A longtail boat follows you and lunch is on a beach. No James Bond Island and no crowds.
items.feeText: Paddle Asia: 4,850 THB per person, minimum 2 people, private for your group; ask for the group discount (official site, Oct 2026).
items.priceText: Paddle Asia: 4,850 THB per person, minimum 2 people, private for your group; ask for the group discount (official site, Oct 2026).
items.privateCharter: Every Paddle Asia trip is private: 8 people pay about 38,800 THB before the group discount. John Gray's Sea Canoe 'Day in the Islands' (self-guided kayaking, private): from 35,000 THB for 1-4 people; packages go up to 6 people.
items.includes: Transfers from anywhere in Phuket, kayaks, life jackets, dry bags, guide, lunch and insurance. Not included: breakfast and soft drinks.
items.departsFrom: Bang Rong Pier, north-east Phuket. Public speedboat ferry to Koh Yao Noi (30 min), then a private longtail to the islands. Back on the 16:00 ferry.
items.bestTime: Morning trips only. Pickup 07:15-07:30, back on Phuket about 16:30.
items.openText: Advance booking only.

operators.label: Paddle Asia: Phang Nga Bay kayak day (official)
John Gray's Sea Canoe: Day in the Islands (official)

tips: No solo travellers on this day trip: book at least 2 people.
The bay is not good for snorkelling. This is a kayaking day.
Good for 2-4 people from the group who want exercise while the others take a speedboat day.
Bring shoes that can get wet, a hat, sunscreen, a towel and dry clothes.
items.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. Paddle Asia official page (updated 14 Jul 2026): 4,850 THB per person, 2-person minimum, pickup 07:15-07:30, Bang Rong Pier, public speedboat to Koh Yao Noi (30 min), private longtail, 16:00 ferry back, no James Bond Island and no snorkelling, TAT licence 34/00224; Google 4.9 (98). John Gray 'Day in the Islands' from 35,000 THB (packages 1-4, 5 and 6 people), described as self-guided kayaking. Pin: Google 'Goh Roi' and OSM way 23492476 (Ko Roi) within 85 m.

items.name: Hong Islands (Krabi) + James Bond Island in one day
items.coordSource: osm node 5235188622 'Hong Lagoon' (exact) + google maps 'Hong Lagoon' 73 m; the 'Ko Hong' island pin is 190 m south-east
items.gmapsQuery: Hong Lagoon, Koh Hong, Krabi
items.description: Two national parks in one speedboat day from Phuket: the Hong Islands in Krabi (lagoon, white beach, viewpoint) and James Bond Island in Phang Nga Bay, with sea-cave canoeing. More time on the boat than a normal James Bond tour, but you see Krabi's islands without staying there. See also the Koh Hong (Krabi) card.
items.feeText: Amazing Canoeing 5,500 THB with both park fees, pickup, halal lunch and canoeing. Love Andaman early program (Hong, James Bond, Koh Panyee, canoe): listed at 4,000 THB plus 300 THB for pickup; ask about park fees. Official sites, Oct 2026.
items.priceText: Amazing Canoeing 5,500 THB with both park fees, pickup, halal lunch and canoeing. Love Andaman early program (Hong, James Bond, Koh Panyee, canoe): listed at 4,000 THB plus 300 THB for pickup; ask about park fees. Official sites, Oct 2026.
items.privateCharter: Amazing Canoeing private Hong + James Bond: 44,600-46,600 THB per boat (up to 10, two prices on its site). Simba private Krabi day (Hong, Railay, Chicken Island): from 41,690 THB for 2-4 people, extra per person above 4.
items.includes: Amazing Canoeing: pickup anywhere in Phuket, both park fees, lunch, canoe, life jackets, insurance. Love Andaman: lunch at Koh Panyee and canoeing at Tham Lod; pickup 300 THB extra, and its page does not say if park fees are in.
items.departsFrom: Royal Phuket Marina (Amazing Canoeing, check-in 09:00, boat 09:30) or Visit Panwa Pier on Cape Panwa (Love Andaman early program, boat at 06:30).
items.bestTime: Love Andaman's early program reaches Koh Hong about 07:30, before the boats from Krabi. Amazing Canoeing does Hong first and James Bond Island last, about 15:00. Tides decide the order of stops.
items.openText: Daily, weather permitting.

operators.label: Amazing Canoeing: Hong Krabi + James Bond (official)
Love Andaman: early program, Hong + James Bond (official)
Simba Sea Trips: private Krabi charter (official)

tips: Two park fees apply: Phang Nga 300 THB and Hong 300 THB per adult. Check that both are in the price.
No alcohol and no drones on Koh Hong.
Love Andaman's normal 09:00 program is not sold now (Oct 2026). Only the early program runs, with a very early pickup (check-in about 05:30).
items.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026 on the official pages. Amazing Canoeing: 5,500 THB adult, both park fees included, pickup from about 07:00, Royal Phuket Marina check-in 09:00, boat 09:30, Hong 10:30, James Bond 15:00, back about 17:00; private 44,600 THB in its FAQ and 46,600 THB on a tile. Love Andaman: its James Bond page says the normal program is unavailable and links to the early program (boat 06:30 from Visit Panwa, Hong 07:30, James Bond 09:40, back 15:00); schema price 4,000 THB; pickup +300 THB; park fees not stated. Simba Krabi: from 41,690 THB for 2-4, TAT 34/02111. Fees: Simba 2026 guide (Hong in Than Bok Khorani, 300/150 THB). Pin: Google 'Hong Lagoon' within 75 m.

items.name: Similan Islands by speedboat from Khao Lak
items.coordSource: google maps 'Ko Miang' (Similan Island 4, 219 reviews) + osm node 12473526013 'Similan island number 4 - Ko Miang', 190 m apart; island pin, the lunch beach is on this island
items.gmapsQuery: Ko Miang, Similan Islands, Phang Nga
items.description: The clearest water near Phuket. Speedboats leave Khao Lak at 07:00-09:00 and take about 75 minutes to the islands: Sail Rock on Island 8, snorkel stops with turtles and clownfish, lunch and beach time on Island 4. From Phuket it is a very long day; from Nai Yang the drive is shorter. See the Similan Islands card.
items.feeText: Love Andaman 3,900 THB (park fee not stated, ask). Khao Lak Land Discovery 4,100 THB (child 3,100) with the 500 THB park fee, lunch and snorkel gear; price listed until 31 Dec 2026. Pickup from Phuket costs extra: Love Andaman 300 THB, Khao Lak Land Discovery 400 THB per person. Official sites, Oct 2026.
items.priceText: Love Andaman 3,900 THB (park fee not stated, ask). Khao Lak Land Discovery 4,100 THB (child 3,100) with the 500 THB park fee, lunch and snorkel gear; price listed until 31 Dec 2026. Pickup from Phuket costs extra: Love Andaman 300 THB, Khao Lak Land Discovery 400 THB per person. Official sites, Oct 2026.
items.privateCharter: For 8 people: Khao Lak Land Discovery private van from Phuket 4,500 THB round trip, then join the boat. A private speedboat to the Similans costs much more: one Phuket charter agent lists it from 48,000 THB per boat (2026). Ask Love Andaman for a quote.
items.includes: Khao Lak Land Discovery: speedboat, guide, breakfast at the pier, picnic lunch, soft drinks, mask, fins, life jacket and the 500 THB park ticket, bought ahead with your passport details; free pickup only in Khao Lak. Love Andaman: breakfast and lunch; its page does not say if the park fee is in.
items.departsFrom: Thap Lamu Pier, Khao Lak (Love Andaman, boat at 09:00). Khao Lak Land Discovery: its own pier at Nam Khem Pier, about 30 min north of Khao Lak; it leaves around sunrise.
items.bestTime: January has calm sea and sun but is busy. Take the earliest boat you can.
items.openText: Season 15 Oct 2026 - 15 May 2027. Day trips only: no overnight stays on the islands.

operators.label: Love Andaman: Similan day trip (official)
Khao Lak Land Discovery: Similan tour (official)

tips: Send passport photos when you book: the park ticket is bought in your name and daily numbers are capped.
Driving time to Thap Lamu Pier without traffic: about 1 h 30-1 h 35 from Kamala or Patong, 1 h 10 from Nai Yang. Nam Khem Pier is 40 min further north.
With Khao Lak Land Discovery the Khao Lak pickup is 05:00-05:30, so from Phuket you leave before sunrise.
Khao Lak Land Discovery gives free seasickness tablets at its pier. The open-sea crossing can be bumpy.
Use reef-safe sunscreen only. Do not stand on coral or feed fish.
Khao Lak Land Discovery refunds only if you cancel 48 hours ahead, and park fees are never refunded.
items.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026 on the official pages. Love Andaman: schema price 3,900 THB, Tablamu (Thap Lamu) Pier, boat 09:00, back 17:30, Phuket pickup +300 THB in its notes (another line says included, so ask), no park-fee line, TAT 31/00986. Khao Lak Land Discovery: 4,100 THB, priceValidUntil 2026-12-31, park fees included, passport photos needed, Nam Khem pier, Khao Lak pickup 05:00-05:30, Phuket +400 THB or 4,500 THB per van, 48 h cancellation, free seasickness tablets, TAT 41/00132, Google 4.7 (537). Drive times: OSRM free-flow (Patong 95, Kamala 88, Nai Yang 71 min; Nam Khem +38 min). 48,000 THB: phuketprivateboats.com listing. Pin: Google 'Ko Miang' listing.

items.name: Racha Yai + Coral Island: speedboat, dive boat or catamaran
items.coordSource: google maps 'Siam Bay' on Racha Yai (889 reviews); the Patok Bay landing beach is about 470 m south-west
items.gmapsQuery: Siam Bay, Racha Yai Island, Phuket
items.description: The easy southern islands, 30-45 min by speedboat from Chalong. Racha Yai has white sand and clear water to snorkel from the beach; Coral Island is a short hop with a busy beach. No national park fee. Choose a cheap speedboat, a big and steady dive boat that takes snorkellers, or a catamaran with deck space.
items.feeText: Speedboat Racha + Coral from about 1,100-1,300 THB with lunch (Ticket2Attraction, Tisland, Oct 2026). Dive-boat snorkel day with Andy's Scuba: Racha Yai 2,200 THB, Racha Yai + Racha Noi 2,500 THB. Phuket Dive Tours Racha Yai day 2,800 THB. Shared catamarans 2,500-3,500 THB (Tisland list, Oct 2026).
items.priceText: Speedboat Racha + Coral from about 1,100-1,300 THB with lunch (Ticket2Attraction, Tisland, Oct 2026). Dive-boat snorkel day with Andy's Scuba: Racha Yai 2,200 THB, Racha Yai + Racha Noi 2,500 THB. Phuket Dive Tours Racha Yai day 2,800 THB. Shared catamarans 2,500-3,500 THB (Tisland list, Oct 2026).
items.privateCharter: Andy's Scuba private boat for up to 10: Racha Yai 24,900 THB (basic boat from Rawai Beach, no transfers or lunch) or 32,900-39,900 THB (Domino boat from Chalong with breakfast, lunch and a sound system; its pages show both prices). Private sailing catamaran to Coral + Racha: 29,900 THB for 1-20 people (Phuket Dream Company, Apr-Oct 2026 rate; ask for January).
items.includes: Usually pickup, lunch, mask and snorkel. Andy's Scuba dive-boat day: pickup from Rawai, Nai Harn, Chalong, Kata, Karon and Patong, breakfast, lunch and snorkel gear. Fins often cost 100-200 THB extra. No national park fee for Racha or Coral Island.
items.departsFrom: Chalong Pier for most boats. Phuket Dive Tours and some catamarans leave from Cape Panwa; Andy's Scuba's basic private boat leaves from Rawai Beach.
items.bestTime: Day boats reach Racha Yai from about 10:00 and leave about 16:00. November to April has the clearest water.
items.openText: Daily, weather permitting.

operators.label: Andy's Scuba Diving: Racha snorkel trips (official)
Phuket Dive Tours: Racha Yai snorkel day (official)
Tisland: Racha tours and catamarans (agency)
Banana Beach Koh Hey: Coral Island only (official)

tips: Dive boats are big and slow but steady: a good pick if anyone gets seasick.
Bring your own mask if you have one. Rental masks often leak.
Racha Noi has better coral and manta rays from January to March, but almost no beach.
From a Rawai villa, Chalong Pier is about 10 minutes away.
See the Koh Racha Yai and Coral Island cards for the islands.
items.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. Andy's Scuba (Rawai, TAT 34/01648, Google 4.9 from 156, site dated 2025): dive-boat snorkel days 2,200 / 2,500 THB with pickup, breakfast and lunch; basic private boat 24,900 THB from Rawai Beach without transfers or meals; Domino 32,900 THB on the snorkel page and 39,900 THB on its charter page, from Chalong, transfers and park fees extra. Phuket Dive Tours: Racha Yai 2,800 THB from Panwa pier. Ticket2Attraction: Racha + Coral speedboat from 1,100 THB (Chalong, 09:30-16:30). Tisland: speedboat 1,300 THB, catamarans 2,500-3,500 THB. Phuket 101 (26 Sep 2026): Chalong, 30-40 min, dive boats steadier, mask tip, Racha Noi mantas and almost no beach. Pin: Google 'Siam Bay' listing.

items.name: Khai Islands half day by speedboat
items.coordSource: google maps 'Khai Nai Island' beach (6,271 reviews) + osm islet way 242675595 (Ko Khai Nai), 40 m apart
items.gmapsQuery: Khai Nai Island, Phang Nga
items.description: The shortest and cheapest island trip: 15-20 min by speedboat from Phuket's east coast to three tiny islands. White sand at Khai Nok and Khai Nai, snorkelling from the boat at Khai Nui. Busy, but easy for a lazy morning or afternoon, and good for a solo day. See the Khai Islands card.
items.feeText: About 1,000-1,200 THB per adult for a half day with pickup, snorkel gear and the island entry fee (Phuket 101, Aug 2026; seller listings, Oct 2026). Phi Phi + Khai in one day by speedboat: 2,900 THB (Amazing Canoeing).
items.priceText: About 1,000-1,200 THB per adult for a half day with pickup, snorkel gear and the island entry fee (Phuket 101, Aug 2026; seller listings, Oct 2026). Phi Phi + Khai in one day by speedboat: 2,900 THB (Amazing Canoeing).
items.privateCharter: Phuket 101 (Aug 2026): private speedboat 2,500-5,000 THB, private longtail to all three islands 3,500-4,000 THB per boat. Amazing Canoeing's private Khai + Rang Island day is priced by group size (one of its pages says from 32,500 THB). Love Andaman sells a private Khai + Maiton day on request.
items.includes: Pickup, mask and snorkel, life jacket, water and fruit. Half days often have no full lunch. Fins about 100 THB. Sunbeds 150 THB for two, free if you order food. Pickup from Kamala costs about 100 THB extra, Cape Panwa or Bang Tao about 200; from Rawai or Nai Yang some sellers want a private van.
items.departsFrom: Depends on the company: Chalong Pier, Ao Po Pier, Royal Phuket Marina or a small east-coast pier. Your voucher names the pier.
items.bestTime: Morning trips (pickup about 07:30, back at the pier about 13:00) beat most tour groups. Afternoon trips run about 11:30-17:30.
items.openText: Daily, weather permitting.

operators.label: Amazing Canoeing: Phi Phi + Khai (official)
Amazing Canoeing: private Khai + Rang (official)
Love Andaman: private charters, incl. Khai + Maiton (official)

links.label: Khai Islands guide with prices (Phuket 101, Aug 2026)

tips: Feeding fish is banned and rangers give fines. A seller that offers fish feeding is a red flag.
Keep your life jacket on at Khai Nui: the current can be strong.
Short and cheap: a good solo half day on Sun 24 or Mon 25 Jan. From Nai Yang, ask the pickup price before you pay.
Boats skip Khai Nui when the sea is rough.
items.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. Phuket Dive Tours' Khai page now says 'CURRENTLY NOT RUNNING', and its 800 THB is the child price (adult 1,500), so it was dropped as an operator and price source. Phuket 101 (29 Aug 2026): about 1,100 adult / 900 child, entry fees included, piers, private prices, sunbeds, fish-feeding ban, Khai Nui current. Phuket Tours Direct (TAT 31/01200): 1,100 THB, morning 09:00-13:00 and afternoon 13:30-17:30 at the pier, pickup surcharges (Kamala +100, Cape Panwa and Bang Tao +200, Rawai and Nai Yang private van 1,300 THB); not listed as an operator because its page offers fish feeding. Expedia sellers list about AU$44-49 (Oct 2026). Amazing Canoeing Phi Phi + Khai 2,900 THB. Pin: Google + OSM way 242675595 within 40 m.

items.name: Krabi 4 Islands by longtail from Ao Nang
items.coordSource: google maps 'Ko Poda' island (889 reviews) + nominatim relation 6736886 centre, 110 m apart; island pin, the landing beach is not mapped
items.gmapsQuery: Ko Poda, Krabi
items.description: Only if you stay in Ao Nang or Railay. Longtail boats hop to Poda Island, Chicken Island, Tup Island with its low-tide sandbar, and Phra Nang Cave Beach: short rides, flat water, lunch on Poda. Similar trips go to the Hong Islands, and the 7 Islands tour (about 12:00-20:00) adds a sunset, a BBQ dinner and glowing plankton.
items.feeText: Shared longtail 599-1,000 THB with Ao Nang pickup and lunch, plus a park fee of about 200 THB (4islandkrabi.tours, Sep 2026). Shared speedboat about 750-1,300 THB. 7 Islands sunset trip with BBQ dinner and a plankton swim about 900-1,200 THB. Hong Islands from Ao Nang about 1,350-1,500 THB plus the 300 THB park fee.
items.priceText: Shared longtail 599-1,000 THB with Ao Nang pickup and lunch, plus a park fee of about 200 THB (4islandkrabi.tours, Sep 2026). Shared speedboat about 750-1,300 THB. 7 Islands sunset trip with BBQ dinner and a plankton swim about 900-1,200 THB. Hong Islands from Ao Nang about 1,350-1,500 THB plus the 300 THB park fee.
items.privateCharter: Railay Eco Tour (licence 34/02672): local longtail for up to 4 people from 4,500 THB (half day) or 7,500 THB (full day); speedboat for up to 8 from 17,000-22,000 THB. For 8 people take two longtails or one speedboat.
items.includes: Shared trips: Ao Nang pickup, lunch on Poda, mask, life jacket and guide. The park fee is usually not included: pay the ranger in cash and keep the ticket.
items.departsFrom: Ao Nang Beach (Ao Nang Longtail Boat Service Club office at the south end of the beach) or Nopparat Thara Pier.
items.bestTime: Take the first boat at 09:00. Phra Nang Beach is crowded at midday. The Tup sandbar appears only at low tide.
items.openText: Daily in the dry season. Longtails are the first boats cancelled when the sea is rough.

operators.label: Ao Nang Longtail Boat Service Club (Google Maps)
Railay Eco Tour: private 4 Islands and Hong trips (official)

links.label: 4 Islands guide: prices and park fee (Sep 2026)

tips: The beach office has mixed reviews (Google 3.1). Agree the price, stops and return time before you board.
Some captains ask for the park fee themselves. Pay only the ranger and keep the ticket.
Staying in Phuket? The Hong Islands + James Bond speedboat day is easier. 4 Islands tours from Phuket cost about 1,800-4,900 THB.
Boats land on the beach: wear shoes that can get wet.
Park fee: most 2026 sellers say 200 THB per adult, some signs still say 400. Carry 400 THB in small notes.
From Railay you can walk to Phra Nang Cave Beach early, before the tour boats come.
From Phuket a few tours do it in one long day (about 9.5 h): van to Rassada Pier, ferry to Ao Nang, then a speedboat.
items.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. 4islandkrabi.tours (updated 25 Sep 2026): shared longtail 599-1,000 THB, 8-12 passengers, pickup 08:00-08:30, boats 09:00 from Nopparat Thara or Ao Nang Beach, shared speedboat 749-1,200 THB, 7 Islands 899-1,195 THB (12:00-20:00, BBQ, plankton), from Phuket 1,800-4,900 THB, park fee usually 200/100 THB with some signs at 400/200. TripThaiTour (5 May 2026): speedboat 1,300 THB, fee 200 THB cash. Railay Eco Tour (licence 34/02672): local longtail for 4 from 4,500 / 7,500 THB, speedboat for 8 from 17,000-22,000 THB. The Expedia 7 Islands price and the backpackbob source could not be confirmed and were dropped. Club office: Google + OSM within 10 m, Google 3.1 (1,251).
items.dirLabel: Directions to the Ao Nang longtail office

items.name: Private speedboat for the group of 8
items.coordSource: google maps 'Pi Leh Bay' (8,646 reviews) + osm node 2468500348 'Pileh Lagoon', 35 m apart. Pin = Pileh Lagoon, a stop on most private Phi Phi days
items.gmapsQuery: Pi Leh Bay, Ko Phi Phi Leh, Krabi
items.description: With 8 people a private speedboat costs about the same per person as a good small-group tour, and you choose the start time and the stops. Common days: Phi Phi with Bamboo or Khai, James Bond Island, Racha, or the Hong Islands in Krabi. Leave at 07:00 and you reach the famous spots before the day boats.
items.feeText: Priced per boat, not per person: about 20,000-46,600 THB for a full day, so about 2,500-5,800 THB each for 8 people (operator price lists, Oct 2026). A half-day private boat to Koh Rang Yai costs 15,950 THB (Simba).
items.priceText: Priced per boat, not per person: about 20,000-46,600 THB for a full day, so about 2,500-5,800 THB each for 8 people (operator price lists, Oct 2026). A half-day private boat to Koh Rang Yai costs 15,950 THB (Simba).
items.privateCharter: Amazing Canoeing (up to 10, pickup, lunch and park fees included): Phi Phi + Bamboo 37,500, Phi Phi + Khai 34,500, James Bond 33,300, Hong + James Bond 44,600-46,600 THB. Andy's Scuba (up to 10, no transfers): Racha Yai 24,900, Phi Phi 35,500-37,500 THB. Phuket Sail Tours from 20,000 THB. Simba 33,770-41,690 THB for 2-4 people, more for 8.
items.includes: Amazing Canoeing and Phuket Sail Tours: hotel transfers, lunch, drinks, snorkel gear and park fees. Andy's Scuba basic boat: captain, crew, masks, water and fruit; no transfers, meals or park fees. Its Domino boat adds breakfast, lunch, a paddleboard and a sound system. Alcohol and tips are extra.
items.departsFrom: Royal Phuket Marina (Amazing Canoeing), Ao Po Pier (Phuket Sail Tours), Rawai Beach or Chalong Pier (Andy's Scuba), Boat Lagoon Marina (Simba).
items.bestTime: Start at 07:00 to reach Maya Bay or James Bond Island before 09:00.
items.openText: Daily, by booking.

operators.label: Amazing Canoeing: private charters (official)
Phuket Sail Tours: private charters (official)
Andy's Scuba Diving: private boats (official)
Simba Sea Trips: private charters (official)

tips: Ask how many people the price covers. Amazing Canoeing and Andy's Scuba quote up to 10; Simba's prices cover only 2-4 people.
Get the boat name, pier and pickup time in writing, and ask if park fees are in (Phi Phi 400, Phang Nga 300 THB each).
Ask for a boat with shade and a toilet. Andy's Scuba's Domino boat has a sound system for your own music.
Cheapest private boat: Simba's Locals Island trip to Koh Rang Yai, 14:30 to sunset, 15,950 THB for up to 25. You may bring your own food and drinks.
Pay the deposit by card or PayPal on the operator's site, not in cash to a street agent.
January is high season: book the boat as soon as you fix the date.
items.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026 on the operator pages. Amazing Canoeing: per boat for up to 10, transfers, lunch and park fees included; its tiles show slightly different prices on some pages (for example Phi Phi + Khai 32,500 vs 34,500 THB). Phuket Sail Tours: 'Starting from 20,000 THB', speedboat up to 30, transfers, meals, park fees and insurance. Andy's Scuba (site 2025): basic boat Racha Yai 24,900, Phi Phi 35,500 (charter page) or 37,500 THB (snorkel page), from Rawai Beach, no transfers or meals; Domino from Chalong, transfers extra. Simba: from-prices cover 2-4 people with extra charges above 4; Locals Island 15,950 THB flat for up to 25, 14:30 to sunset. Phuket 101 (12 Apr 2026): 15,000-25,000 THB for a basic private Phi Phi boat. Pin: Google 'Pi Leh Bay' listing.

items.name: Private catamaran day for the group
items.coordSource: google maps 'Banana Beach (Koh Hey)' (4,572 reviews). Pin = Banana Beach on Coral Island, a common catamaran stop
items.gmapsQuery: Banana Beach (Koh Hey), Rawai, Phuket
items.description: A slow, stable boat with a big deck, paddleboards and space for 8 to swim and relax. Most day charters sail from Chalong to Coral Island, Racha Yai or Maiton. It is slower than a speedboat, so choose the close islands, not Phi Phi. Good for a calm day between party nights.
items.feeText: Per boat: a sailing catamaran to Coral + Racha is 29,900 THB for 1-20 people (Phuket Dream Company, rate for 10 Apr - 31 Oct 2026; ask for January). Asia Marine's day charters start at 58,000 THB (Speedcat 36); its Lagoon 56 catamaran is from 123,000 THB a day.
items.priceText: Per boat: a sailing catamaran to Coral + Racha is 29,900 THB for 1-20 people (Phuket Dream Company, rate for 10 Apr - 31 Oct 2026; ask for January). Asia Marine's day charters start at 58,000 THB (Speedcat 36); its Lagoon 56 catamaran is from 123,000 THB a day.
items.privateCharter: For 8 people about 5,000-7,500 THB each. Phuket Dream Company: 29,900 THB per boat, food on board 6,900 THB, hotel van 2,000-2,700 THB round trip, so about 39,000 THB in all (low-season rate). Asia Marine: from 58,000 THB before food and transfers. Love Andaman: catamaran on request, with meals, park fees and transfers.
items.includes: Phuket Dream Company: boat and crew, paddleboard, masks and snorkels, water, soft drinks, fruit, beach chairs at Coral Island and insurance. Not included: lunch, transfers, guide and island fees. Love Andaman's private charters include meals, park fees, transfers and insurance.
items.departsFrom: Chalong Pier for the southern islands (Phuket Dream Company). East-coast marinas for Phang Nga Bay.
items.bestTime: Phuket Dream Company's day is 08:00-16:00; extra hours cost 4,500 THB each. For a sunset return (about 18:25 in mid-January), ask for a later start.
items.openText: Daily, by booking.

operators.label: Phuket Dream Company: Coral + Racha catamaran (official)
Asia Marine yacht charters (official)
Love Andaman: private charter (official)

tips: Many sites show April-October prices. Ask for a written January quote with lunch, transfers and fees.
Some boats do not let you take food and drinks onto the island. Ask before you bring a cooler.
Landing at Banana Beach on Coral Island costs about 100 THB per person (Tisland, 2026).
Phi Phi or Phang Nga by catamaran takes much longer. For those, a speedboat is the better choice.
Asia Marine has run yacht charters in Phuket since 1989. It suits a bigger budget.
items.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. Phuket Dream Company: 29,900 THB (1-20 pax) and 34,900 (21-30 pax), valid 10 Apr - 31 Oct 2026 ('original price' 42,000 THB shown), Chalong Pier 08:00-16:00, extra hour 4,500 THB, catering 6,900 THB, van 2,000/2,400/2,700 THB by area (Rawai 2,000, Kamala 2,400, Nai Yang 2,700), no licence number shown. items.name: Sunset boat day: Phi Phi + Maiton or Racha + Promthep
items.coordSource: google maps 'Maiton Private Island' resort (603 reviews), on the island. Boats stop in the water off Maiton
items.gmapsQuery: Maiton Private Island, Phuket
items.description: Shared day boats that end with the sunset at sea. Love Andaman's double-deck catamaran does Phi Phi, then stops off Maiton Island for its water slide, paddleboards and snorkelling, and cruises back at sunset. Cheaper catamarans do Racha and Coral Island and finish off Promthep Cape.
items.feeText: Love Andaman Phi Phi + Maiton sunset 4,500 THB, Phuket pickup 300 THB extra (official site, Oct 2026). Racha + Coral + Promthep sunset catamaran from about 1,450-1,690 THB (Ticket2Attraction, Click2GoThailand, 2026); bigger cruises 2,700-2,900 THB (Tisland).
items.priceText: Love Andaman Phi Phi + Maiton sunset 4,500 THB, Phuket pickup 300 THB extra (official site, Oct 2026). Racha + Coral + Promthep sunset catamaran from about 1,450-1,690 THB (Ticket2Attraction, Click2GoThailand, 2026); bigger cruises 2,700-2,900 THB (Tisland).
items.privateCharter: Simba Locals Island: private boat to Koh Rang Yai, 14:30 to sunset, 15,950 THB for up to 25 people. Simba private Phang Nga Bay sunset (4.5 hours): from 33,770 THB for 2-4 people, more for 8. June Bahtra private junk sunset cruise for up to 25 people (3-4 hours): ask the price.
items.includes: Love Andaman: breakfast, buffet lunch on Phi Phi Don, snorkel gear, slide and paddleboard, snacks at sunset; Phuket pickup 300 THB extra. Its list includes park fees only for Thai guests, so expect to pay the 400 THB Phi Phi fee in cash. Budget Racha sunset boats: buffet lunch and snorkel masks; pickup can cost extra.
items.departsFrom: Visit Panwa Pier on Cape Panwa (Love Andaman, boat at 10:00). Racha sunset catamarans leave from Chalong Pier.
items.bestTime: Sunset during your trip is about 18:23-18:31.
items.openText: Daily, weather permitting.

operators.label: Love Andaman: Phi Phi + Maiton sunset (official)
Tisland: Racha catamarans with sunset (agency)
Simba Sea Trips: private sunset charter (official)

tips: Maiton is a private island: the boat stops in the water and you do not land.
Love Andaman reaches Maya Bay at midday, the busiest time. Book it for the fun boat, not for an empty Maya Bay.
Back at the pier about 18:20, then the drive: plan a late dinner.
Love Andaman has 4.9 on Google (238 reviews, Oct 2026). Read reviews from the last few months.

items.name: Ang Thong Marine Park day trip from Koh Phangan
items.coordSource: Google 'Blue Lagoon (Emerald Lake) Viewpoint', Ko Mae Ko (9.6575233, 99.666236), 160 m from the OSM lake Thale Nai (way 23977540), 19 Oct 2026
items.gmapsQuery: Blue Lagoon (Emerald Lake) Viewpoint, Ko Mae Ko
items.description: For your days on Koh Phangan (19-23 Jan, or 10-13 Jan if the group goes): 42 limestone islands, about 45 minutes away by speedboat. You walk up to the Emerald Lake, a sea lake inside an island, kayak along the cliffs, snorkel and swim. Fit people can climb the steep main viewpoint. It needs a calm sea.
items.feeText: Angthong Tours: speedboat 1,800 THB (sale price, normally 2,200), big boat 1,500-2,200 THB (its pages show both), Oct 2026. Lomlahk Khirin speedboat from Thong Sala: about USD 68 on Pelago. Park fee 300 THB per adult (child 150), cash, not included.
items.priceText: Angthong Tours: speedboat 1,800 THB (sale price, normally 2,200), big boat 1,500-2,200 THB (its pages show both), Oct 2026. Lomlahk Khirin speedboat from Thong Sala: about USD 68 on Pelago. Park fee 300 THB per adult (child 150), cash, not included.
items.privateCharter: Angthong Tours private speedboat for 1-10 people: 33,000 THB per group (36,000 before the sale; official site, Oct 2026).
items.includes: Hotel pickup on Koh Phangan, speedboat, guide, buffet lunch, water and soft drinks, snorkel and kayak gear, life vests and accident insurance. Thong Nai Pan and Than Sadet pay 400 THB per person extra; no pickup from Bottle Beach, Haad Yuan or Haad Thien.
items.departsFrom: Thong Sala Pier, Koh Phangan (Lomlahk Khirin meets at the Lomprayah office there; Angthong Tours' office is in Thong Sala).
items.bestTime: Pickup 07:30-08:30, back at the hotel about 17:00 (big boat about 18:30). Choose a morning after a quiet night: Wed 20, Thu 21 or Fri 22 Jan, or 11-12 Jan if the group is on Koh Phangan.
items.openText: Daily. The park closes every year from 1 Nov to 15 Dec, so it is open in January.

operators.label: Angthong Tours: day tour by speedboat (official)
Lomlahk Khirin speedboat from Thong Sala (Pelago)

tips: The main viewpoint climb is steep and hard. Wear shoes with grip.
Seas in the Gulf can be choppy in January. Angthong Tours refunds in full if you cancel 48 hours ahead.
Bring cash for the park fee, a towel and reef-safe sunscreen.
Not on Sat 23 Jan: that is your travel day back to Phuket.

Pelago: Lomlahk Khirin from Thong Sala Pier, USD 68.27, 4.3 from 69 reviews, park fee not included. Pin: Google park HQ listing; dir point within 40 m of OSM Thong Sala Pier.

items.name: AMP Listening Bar (Analogue Me Phuket)
items.coordSource: google-maps-place (cid 11140459740010937348, 7.9864723, 98.2983699; place data re-read 19 Oct 2026); the official Facebook page gives the same address (9 Landmark, 64 Soi Bang Thao 2); not in OSM
items.gmapsQuery: AMP Listening Bar (Analogue Me Phuket), Choeng Thale, Phuket
items.bestTime: From about 19:00 for a seat at the bar. Not on Tuesdays.
items.openText: Mon and Wed-Sun 15:00-01:00, closed Tuesday (Google Maps, Oct 2026). Phuket Insider lists 18:00-01:00.
items.feeText: No entry fee. Cocktails about 300 THB (Phuket Insider).
items.gettingThere: 9 Landmark, Soi Bang Thao 2, Choeng Thale, inland from Bang Tao Beach. About 10-15 min from Kamala by car or Grab, 25-35 min from Patong.
items.description: A small vinyl bar in Bang Tao in the style of Japanese listening bars. The owner plays records from a big collection behind the bar on an all-analogue sound system and makes the cocktails. Reviews and posts talk about jazz and soul. It is for listening and talking, not for dancing.
tips: It is small and owner-run. Check Instagram @amplisteningbar for the hours before you go: Google says from 15:00, a 2025 guide says from 18:00.
Closed on Tuesdays (Google Maps).
It holds vinyl buy-sell-trade meetups for collectors (one was set for Sun 25 Oct 2026). Ask if one is on in January.
Catch Beach Club is about 1 km away: sunset at Catch, then records at AMP.
For live jazz nearby: Moonshine on Lagoon Road, 17:00-24:00, closed Monday (Phuket 101, Oct 2026).
items.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. Google Maps place data (read directly): 'AMP Listening Bar (Analogue Me Phuket)', 9 Landmark, 64 Soi Bang Thao 2, 5.0 from 147 reviews (latest 2 Oct 2026), Mon and Wed-Sun 15:00-01:00, Tue closed, not marked closed. Official Facebook page: same address, phone +66 64 238 8619, 'a vinyl sanctuary with cocktails', jazz posts (Bill Evans), posts up to 11 Oct 2026 and an event 'Buy Sell Trade Vinyl' on Sun 25 Oct 2026. Instagram bio: vinyl on a pure analogue system (45 posts). Phuket Insider: owner Rob (USA), cocktails about 300 THB, 18:00-01:00; the Facebook contact gives another name, so the text names no one. The 'moving to Bang Tao Laguna' note could not be found on the Facebook page or anywhere else, so that tip was dropped. Undiscvered: soulful vinyl bar inspired by Japanese listening bars. items.name: Tree Bay Clubhouse (cliff-top sunset DJ bar, Kata)
items.coordSource: official-site Google Maps link (ll=7.7985786,98.2997012) + google-maps-place, main listing 'Tree Bay Clubhouse' (cid 17239610904049624022, 7.79849, 98.29926), about 50 m apart; a second Google listing, 'Hookah lounge viewpoint Kata @Tree Bay Clubhouse' (cid 12294452350899704734), is 30 m away; not in OSM
items.gmapsQuery: Tree Bay Clubhouse, Kata, Phuket
items.bestTime: Arrive about 17:30 for a table before sunset (about 18:30 in January). The guest DJ sunset sessions on its events page were on Fridays to Sundays.
items.openText: Daily 12:00-23:00, kitchen to 22:00, happy hour 12:00-16:00 (official site and Google Maps, Oct 2026). Pizza from 15:00.
items.feeText: No entry fee. Cocktails 350-480 THB, beer 200-270 THB, pizza from 480 THB. Menu prices add 7% VAT and 10% service (official menu, Oct 2026).
items.gettingThere: 101/13 Moo 1 (Soi Laem Mum Nai), Karon, on the hill road above Kata and Kata Noi, about 300 m from Karon Viewpoint. About 30-40 min from Kamala, 20-30 min from Patong, 5-10 min from Kata.
items.description: A cliff-top bar and restaurant about 270 m above Kata Bay, with wide sunset views over the Andaman Sea. Resident and guest DJs play from afternoon ambient to deep, organic and progressive house in the evening. Wood-fired pizza, seafood and cocktails. A calm, music-first sundowner in the south.
tips: Pair it with Karon Viewpoint, about 300 m away: see the three bays first, then go to Tree Bay for sunset.
Check Instagram @treebayphuket for the DJ of the night. The events page on the website still lists only May-June 2026 sessions.
Saturday has a Golden Hour Brunch from 12:00.
Google also lists it as a hookah lounge. Shisha is illegal in Thailand (TAT), and Phuket officials raided hookah bars in 2026. Do not smoke it.
items.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. Official site (2026): cliff-top bar 270 m above sea level above Kata Beach, daily 12:00-23:00, kitchen to 22:00, happy hour 12:00-16:00, resident and guest DJs 'from afternoon ambient to late-night deep house', Saturday Golden Hour Brunch from noon, wood-fired pizza and seafood, booking on treebay.bookmai.com. Its events page lists only 2026 sunset sessions from 8 May to 28 June (Attgaruda, Poppy, DJ Raf, Anastasia, MBJ, Kameroo; organic, deep and progressive house; Fri-Sun), so the January 2027 DJs are not out. Official menu (Bookmai): cocktails 350 THB, signature cocktails 480, Singha or Chang 200, Heineken 240, Corona 270, Margherita (cheapest pizza) 480, pizza from 15:00, plus 7% VAT and 10% service. Google Maps has two listings: the main 'Tree Bay Clubhouse' (4.7 from 2,467 reviews, 12:00-23:00 daily, reviews to Sep 2026), which the researcher missed, and 'Hookah lounge viewpoint Kata @Tree Bay Clubhouse' (category hookah bar, 4.7 from 66, 15:00-23:00). So the place is not new, and the 15:00 opening was the second listing. Shisha: TAT (4 Nov 2019) says shisha smoking is illegal in Thailand; ASEAN Now (5 Aug 2026) reports hookah-bar raids in Patong (April 2026) and then Rawai. Coords: official map link, main Google pin 50 m.

items.name: Bebop Live Music Bar (jazz, Phuket Old Town)
items.coordSource: google-maps-place (cid 8306070432420837236, 7.8838847, 98.3874971; 20/24 Yaowarat Rd, place data re-read 19 Oct 2026); matches Phuket 101's location (VELA building, Yaowarat Rd at Phang Nga Rd); not in OSM
items.gmapsQuery: Bebop Live Music Bar, Yaowarat Road, Phuket
items.bestTime: From 21:00, when the band starts. On Friday and Saturday book a table or arrive before the music.
items.openText: Mon-Fri 18:00-24:00, Sat-Sun 15:00-24:00 (Google Maps, Oct 2026). Live band from about 21:00 (Phuket 101).
items.feeText: No cover charge. Drinks are fairly priced, and the band likes tips (Phuket 101, Oct 2026).
items.gettingThere: 2nd floor of the VELA building, where Yaowarat Road meets Phang Nga Road in Old Town. About 25-35 min from Kamala, 20-30 min from Patong by car.
items.description: Phuket Town's jazz bar, upstairs in the new VELA building in Old Town. A house band plays jazz, soul and blues from about 21:00 in a room with a grand piano, velvet curtains and a long green marble bar. Seated and candlelit. Good live music before a late party in Old Town.
tips: Courage Bar, home of Old Town's underground parties, is about 1 km away (15 min on foot).
On Sunday the Walking Street market starts about 200 m away (16:00-22:00), so you can eat there first.
Tip the band if you like the set. There is no cover charge.
items.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. Phuket 101 live-music page (updated 3 Oct 2026): 2nd floor of the new VELA building, 20/24 Yaowarat Road at Phang Nga Road, house band plays jazz, soul and blues from around 21:00, grand piano, brass pillars, velvet curtains, long green marble bar, no cover charge, book on weekends, 18:00-24:00, phone 080 245 8945. Google Maps place data: 'Bebop Live Music Bar' (live music bar, jazz club), 4.7 from 517 reviews, Mon-Fri 18:00-24:00, Sat-Sun 15:00-24:00, not marked closed; a review says it moved to a much larger new room, which fits the VELA move. items.name: Yona Beach Club (floating club in Patong Bay)
items.coordSource: google-maps-place 'Patong Jetty Docking Service' (cid 903688734317498464, 52 Thaweewong Rd, 7.88599, 98.28895), the result Google Maps gives for 'Patong Boat Pier'; the Google pins 'Patong Pier', 'Chokaree Pier' and 'Tender port' are all within 50 m at the south end of Patong Beach. Used as the high-season check-in pier; the club is moored offshore in Patong Bay; not in OSM
items.gmapsQuery: Patong Jetty Docking Service, Thaweewong Road, Patong
items.bestTime: The afternoon session (14:00-21:30) for the DJs and the sunset. Check in by 17:00.
items.openText: Daily. Afternoon session 14:00-21:30, adults 20+, last check-in 17:00. Morning session 9:30-14:00 only on Tue, Thu and Sat (Phuket 101, Aug 2026, and Google Maps). Boats about every 20 minutes.
items.feeText: Passes include the boat and a food and drink credit. Agent prices for 2026 (valid to 31 Dec 2026): general pass 4,000 THB (2,000 credit), ladies pass 2,000 THB (1,000 credit), afternoon Maxi Cabana for 8 people 52,000 THB (36,000 credit). 2027 prices are not out yet.
items.gettingThere: Boats leave from Patong Boat Pier at the south end of Patong Beach from 16 Nov 2026 to 4 Apr 2027 (Royal Phuket Marina the rest of the year). The ride takes about 10 minutes. About 15-25 min from Kamala by car.
items.description: A three-level floating beach club moored in Patong Bay from mid-November to early April, with a 22 m infinity pool, four bars and a rooftop. The afternoon session is 20+ with DJs, mostly house and afro house. Past guests include Amémé and Shimza. A fun group day at sea, not underground.
tips: Be at the pier about 30 minutes before your boat. Last check-in is 17:00. If you are late, your seat can be resold with no refund.
Smart casual: swimwear with a cover-up is fine. No tank tops, sportswear or football shirts. Bring ID (20+).
Rough sea can delay or cancel the boats. Do not plan anything tight after it.
Outside food and drinks, inflatables, balloons and pro camera gear are not allowed. The credit is for food and drinks only.
items.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. Phuket 101 (updated 29 Aug 2026): 1,200 m2 boat on three levels, 22 m infinity pool, four bars, a restaurant and a rooftop, opened 2021; moored in Patong Bay mid-November to late March with check-in at Patong Boat Pier; shuttle every 20 min, about 10 min; morning 9:30-14:00 (Tue, Thu, Sat), afternoon 14:00-21:30, 20+, DJ; past DJs Amémé, Shimza, Carlita, Themba, Mambo Brothers; dress code checked at the pier; no outside food, inflatables, pro cameras or balloons. Phuket 101 nightclub table: house and afro house. Expedia and Travelocity listings: check-in at Royal Phuket Marina 30 Mar - 15 Nov 2026 and at Patong Boat Pier 16 Nov 2026 - 4 Apr 2027; shuttles 14:00-17:00, last check-in 17:00, late arrival may lose the seat without refund. Google Maps: main 'Yona Beach Club' listing 4.7 from 3,210 reviews, Mon/Wed/Fri/Sun 14:00-21:30, Tue/Thu/Sat 9:30-21:30. Chillpainai (TAT licence 11/07211): general 4,000/2,000 credit, ladies 2,000/1,000, afternoon Maxi Cabana 8 pax 52,000/36,000, valid 16 Jan - 31 Dec 2026, so January 2027 prices may differ. Phuket 101 beach clubs (4 Oct 2026): rough sea can delay or cancel the boats. yonabeach.com blocks bots. Pin: Google pier listing, not confirmed by Yona as the exact boarding point.

items.name: Catch Beach Club (Bang Tao)
items.coordSource: google-maps-place (cid 14902243713867490591, 7.988975, 98.28922; re-read 19 Oct 2026) + osm-node-3014367766 ('Bliss Beach Club', name:en 'Catch Beach Club'), 45 m apart
items.gmapsQuery: Catch Beach Club, Choeng Thale, Phuket
items.bestTime: Arrive by 14:00-15:00 for a daybed and stay for the sunset (about 18:30) and the evening DJs.
items.openText: Daily 07:30-24:00. Day beds 11:00-18:00 (DJ daybeds to 20:00). Friday BBQ 19:00-22:00, Sunday brunch 12:00-15:00 (official site).
items.feeText: Beds are booked with food and drink credit of the same value: DJ daybed for 1-3 people 6,000-8,000 THB, cabana for 1-3 people 6,000-8,000 THB, pool sala for 1-2 people 6,000 THB, front-row pool sunbed for 2 people 8,000 THB (official site, Oct 2026).
items.gettingThere: 202/88 Moo 2 on Bang Tao Beach, Choeng Thale. About 10-15 min from Kamala, 25-35 min from Patong.
items.description: One of Phuket's original beach clubs, now on Bang Tao Beach after it left Surin. Daybeds, pool cabanas and a big central bar face the sunset. DJs play house and nu-disco, with After Dark club nights in high season. Stylish and pricey, but a good group day on the sand.
tips: For 8 people, book three DJ daybeds (1-3 people each) online. You eat and drink the full amount.
Book the Friday BBQ or Sunday brunch ahead in January.
AMP, a vinyl listening bar, is about 1 km inland for later in the evening.
Nomad, Maya and Beach Pig on Bang Tao are closed until further notice after a crackdown on illegal beach buildings. Catch, RAVA and Xana are open (Phuket 101, Oct 2026).
items.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. Official site (modified 5 Oct 2026, 'Festive season 26/27' menu link): daily 07:30-24:00, breakfast 07:30-10:30, day pass 11:00-18:00, lunch and dinner 12:00-22:30, Friday BBQ 19:00-22:00, Sunday brunch 12:00-15:00, After Dark club nights; beds as F&B credit: pool sunbed 2 pax 8,000 (1st row) or 6,000, pool sala 1-2 pax 6,000, cabana 1-3 pax 8,000, chill cabana 6,000, DJ daybed 1-3 pax 8,000 (1st row, 11:00-20:00) or 6,000, seaview daybed 6,000. items.name: Baba Nest (rooftop sunset bar, Sri Panwa)
items.gmapsQuery: Baba Nest, Sri Panwa, Cape Panwa, Phuket
items.bestTime: Book a 17:30-18:00 slot to be there for the sunset (about 18:30 in January).
items.openText: Daily 17:00-20:00. Advance booking only. Closed when it rains (official site).
items.feeText: Outside guests pay a minimum spend of 3,000 THB net per person to confirm the booking. It is not refundable and is used for drinks and food (official site).
items.gettingThere: Inside Sri Panwa resort near the tip of Cape Panwa, 88 Sakdidej Road. About 40-60 min from Kamala, 35-50 min from Patong, 30-40 min from Rawai.
items.description: A small rooftop deck on top of Sri Panwa resort, wrapped by an infinity pool, with 360-degree views over the islands and Phuket's south-east coast. Cocktails, wine and Mexican tapas at sunset. Expensive and short, only 17:00-20:00, but one of the island's most famous sunset spots.
tips: Book early by phone 076 371 008 or on Chope. Tables are held for only 15 minutes.
If it rains, the minimum spend moves to Baba Poolclub or Baba Soul Food at the same resort.
Sri Panwa is the group behind Baba Beach Club in Natai, where Circoloco plays.
Before sunset, swim at Ao Yon Beach or climb the Khao Khad viewpoint tower, both on Cape Panwa.
items.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026 on the official page: 'open daily from 5pm - 8pm', advance reservation required, booking line 076-371-008, wrap-around infinity pool and 360-degree views over the islands and the south-east of Phuket, Mexican tapas menu; non-hotel guests pay a mandatory, non-refundable minimum spend of 3,000 THB net per person, closed automatically in rain, the spend can move to Baba Poolclub and Baba Soul Food in bad weather, bookings held 15 minutes. Chope page live. Google: 4.6 from 149 reviews, 17:00-20:00 daily (Google's phone is the resort line 076 371 000). Commons images: CC BY-SA 3.0 and CC0 checked. items.name: The Kitchen Patong (late food by Bangla, to 03:00)
items.coordSource: google-maps-place (cid 3018588601995933430, 7.8931128, 98.2985146; 167 Rat-U-Thit 200 Pee Rd, the address on the official site); not in OSM

items.feeText: Mid-range to high for Patong. Prices are not published online.
items.gettingThere: 167 Rat-U-Thit 200 Pee Road, at the inland end of Bangla Road, about 120 m from Illuzion. About 15-25 min from Kamala by car or Grab.
items.description: A busy restaurant at the inland end of Bangla Road that stays open until 03:00 every night. It serves Thai and international food: burgers, pizza and grilled meats, up to a Tomahawk steak. A reliable sit-down meal after a club night, when most kitchens in Patong are closed.
tips: No reservations: just walk in (official site).
Other late food nearby: the Bangla Night Market stalls (18:00-02:00) and Took Took Prime Thai Kitchen near Jungceylon (12:00-02:00), per Google Maps.
After Shelter closes at 04:00, Chokchai Dim Sum in Phuket Town opens at 04:00, about 15-20 min away by car at night.

items.name: Chokchai Dim Sum (opens 04:00, Phuket Town)
items.coordSource: google-maps-place (cid 16278206988699097948, 7.8875344, 98.3756894; 46/2 Mae Luan Rd, the address KTC also gives); not in OSM
items.gmapsQuery: Chokchai Dim Sum, Mae Luan Road, Phuket
items.bestTime: From 04:00, straight after a party, or for an early breakfast. It closes at 12:00.
items.openText: Daily 04:00-12:00 (Google Maps, Oct 2026, and KTC).
items.feeText: Cheap local prices. No price list online.
items.gettingThere: 46/2 Mae Luan Road, on the north-west side of Phuket Town. At night about 15-20 min from Patong and 20-25 min from Kamala by car.
items.description: A local Phuket-style dim sum shop that opens at 04:00 every day. That makes it a good breakfast straight after Shelter or an Old Town party. Choose steamed dumplings, buns and other small plates. A 2026 local guide calls it a popular early-morning spot with a huge choice of steamed dim sum.
tips: Boonrat Dim Sum, 26/41 Bangkok Road in Old Town, is the famous alternative. It opens 05:30-10:30 daily (Google Maps).
Go Benz (rice soup, to 01:30) is the other late-night classic in Phuket Town.

items.name: Fruit Fusion Kamala (healthy cafe)
items.gmapsQuery: Fruit Fusion Kamala Cafe, Na Hat Road, Kamala
items.bestTime: A late breakfast or lunch on a recovery day.
items.openText: Daily 08:30-20:30 (Google Maps, Oct 2026).
items.feeText: Prices are not published online. Some reviews call it a little pricey.
items.gettingThere: 66/6 Na Hat Road, the beach road in central Kamala. Close to most Kamala villas, about 15-20 min from Patong.
items.description: A small cafe on Kamala's beach road for the morning after a party. It serves smoothie and fruit bowls, overnight oats, avocado toast, wraps, juices and coffee, with many vegetarian and vegan dishes. Service can be slow when it is full.
tips: Near Renew Sauna in Bang Tao: Hosay Bowl at Boat Avenue (acai and poke bowls, 08:30-20:00) and Bartels on Lagoon Road (sourdough, juices, 07:00-20:00), per Google Maps.
For specialty coffee in Kamala: Sync Coffee Bar & Roastery, 104/8 Na Hat Road, 08:00-18:00 (Google Maps).
items.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. Google Maps place data: 'Fruit Fusion Kamala Cafe', 66/6 Na Hat Road, 4.7 from 883 reviews, daily 08:30-20:30, not marked closed. The 2026 expat breakfast guide the researcher cited does not mention this cafe, so 'energy balls' and 'cold-pressed juices' were dropped. Menu now from Google reviews (smoothie bowl, fruit bowls, overnight oats, salmon and avocado toast, wraps, juices, coffee, many vegan and vegetarian dishes) and Wanderlog (vegan and vegetarian focus, slow service because of few blenders, 'slightly pricey'). Hosay Bowl: its own site says acai and poke bowls; Google 08:30-20:00 (Sunday shows longer hours). Bartels 07:00-20:00 and Sync 08:00-18:00 from Google. Coords: Google pin and OSM node 4 m apart.

items.name: ZIMA Spa & Wellness (Russian banya, Rawai)
items.coordSource: google-maps-place (cid 10545526912243510908, 7.7805211, 98.3175576; 83/14 Rawai, the address on the official site); not in OSM
items.gmapsQuery: Zima Spa&Wellness Club, Rawai, Phuket
items.bestTime: A slow afternoon on a recovery day. Entry before 16:00 is cheaper.
items.openText: Tue-Sun 09:00-23:00, closed Monday. A standard visit is 3 hours (official site, Oct 2026).
items.feeText: 3-hour entry: 650 THB from 09:00-16:00, 1,000 THB from 16:00-23:00. Steaming with a steam master 1,500-5,000 THB, Thai massage 500 THB for 60 min (official price list, Oct 2026).
items.gettingThere: 83/14 Rawai, about 5 minutes from Rawai Beach. About 30-40 min from Kamala, 20-30 min from Patong, about 10 min from Kata.
items.description: A wood-fired Russian banya and spa in Rawai, built as a real banya with steam masters and oak brooms. There are ice plunges, a hammam, an onsen pool, a relaxation area and a cafe. Hot-cold rounds here are a good reset after a big weekend, especially if your villa is in the south.
tips: Book a massage or a steaming session with your visit and the entry is 25% cheaper (official site).
Wednesday and Sunday are family days, so children aged 3-13 may be there.
Do not go with alcohol still in your body. Heat and ice water are hard on the heart.
Closed on Mondays. On a Monday use Renew Sauna & Ice Bath in Bang Tao (10:00-23:00).
items.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. Official site: wood-fired Russian banya and spa complex in Rawai, 83/14 Rawai, 5 minutes from Rawai beach, 09:00-23:00 Tue-Sun, closed Monday, Wed and Sun family days (kids 3-13), steam room with venik brooms and steam masters, ice plunge, hammam, Japanese onsen, pool, massage and a restaurant. Price page: standard visit 3 hours, entry 650 THB (09:00-16:00) or 1,000 THB (16:00-23:00), children 250 THB; steaming programmes run from 1,500 THB (10 min) to 5,000 THB (45 min), not 1,500-3,000 as the researcher wrote; scrub 1,000 THB (20 min) or 500 THB (30 min); Thai massage 500 THB for 60 min; 25% off entry with a massage or steaming booking. Google: 4.7 from 386 reviews, same hours. The pin falls 150 m inside the guide's Nai Harn polygon, within the check's 1 km limit. Coords: Google pin only.

items.name: Bangtao Muay Thai & MMA (group Muay Thai class)
items.gmapsQuery: Bangtao Muay Thai & MMA, Cherngtalay, Phuket
items.bestTime: The 16:00 Muay Thai class on a weekday. It leaves the evening free.
items.openText: Muay Thai classes (90 min): Mon-Fri 08:00 and 16:00, Sat 09:00. Beginner Muay Thai Fundamentals (60 min): Mon-Fri 06:45. Sunday is open gym only (official schedule). Gym Mon-Fri 07:00-19:00, Sat-Sun 08:00-16:00 (Google).
items.feeText: Day pass 900 THB per person, valid for all classes that day. One week 4,500-5,000 THB. Private coaching on request (official price page, checked Oct 2026).
items.gettingThere: In Cherngtalay near Bang Tao Beach. About 10-15 min from Kamala, 25-35 min from Patong.
items.description: A big, well-rated Muay Thai and MMA camp in Bang Tao that welcomes beginners and drop-ins. With a day pass the whole group can join a 90-minute Muay Thai class together and use the gym after. A fun, sweaty group morning or afternoon, only 10-15 minutes from Kamala.
tips: Ask for a private class for your group of 8. The price is on request.
Bring a T-shirt, shorts and lots of water. Ask about gloves and hand wraps when you book.
Skip it the morning after a big party. Heat and dehydration are a real risk.
In the south, Soi Ta-iad in Chalong is Phuket's fitness street, with many camps such as Tiger Muay Thai.
items.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. Price page (last changed 21 Aug 2025, still live): day pass 900 THB for all classes, 1 week 4,500 (Muay Thai or fitness) to 5,000 THB (all access), MMA week 4,000, private coaching on request. Schedule page (changed 5 Jan 2026), timetable data read: Muay Thai Mon-Fri 08:00 and 16:00, Sat 09:00; Muay Thai Fundamentals Mon-Fri 06:45; 'Muay Thai classes are 90 minutes', Fundamentals classes 1 hour; Sundays open gym. Google: 4.8 from 1,789 reviews, Mon-Fri 07:00-19:00, Sat-Sun 08:00-16:00; a review mentions big morning groups in high season with many trainers. Tiger Muay Thai and Soi Ta-iad from the guide's Chalong area text. Coords: Google pin only; it falls 220 m inside the guide's Surin polygon, within the check's 1 km limit.

items.name: Phuket Surf House (FlowRider wave, Patong)
items.coordSource: google-maps-place (cid 7758746576964785798, 7.8957069, 98.2964829) + osm-node-4707574192 ('Surf House Patong', amenity=training, 7.895846, 98.296326), 23 m apart
items.gmapsQuery: Phuket Surf House - Patong Beach, Thaweewong Road
items.bestTime: The 09:30-11:00 morning session for the longest ride, or a night session before Bangla Road. The 22:00 session has bar deals.
items.openText: Daily 09:30-24:00 (Google Maps). Shared 1-hour sessions run every hour until midnight (official pricing page).
items.feeText: Shared 60-minute session 1,280 THB per person, with an instructor, practice board and guide rope. The 09:30-11:00 morning session gives 90 minutes for the same price. Private sessions on request (official pricing page).
items.gettingThere: 162/8-11 Thaweewong Road, on the Patong beach road about 250 m north of the Bangla Road corner. About 15-25 min from Kamala.
items.description: An artificial-wave bar on Patong's beach road. You ride a FlowRider wave on a body board or flow board while friends watch from the bar. Instructors hold a rope for beginners. A fun group alternative to jet skis, and it runs until midnight.
tips: Sessions are shared, so you ride in turns with other people.
Ride before you drink, not after. Falls on the wave are hard.
In Kata the similar wave is WAVA Flow Fit Fun (ex Super Surf Kata), 4 Soi Pakbang, 09:00-22:00 (Google Maps).
items.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. Official pricing page (changed 23 Feb 2026): standard shared session 1,280 THB for 60 minutes with a professional instructor, practice boards and guiding rope, hourly to midnight (one block says from 10:00, a duplicate from 09:30); 'Mega Jumbo 90' 1,280 THB for 90 minutes, 09:30-11:00 daily (added); 'Standard Jumbo 60' double-pumped 19:00-20:00; 'Crazy Jumbo' from 22:00 with buy-1-get-1 shooters; private session on request; membership 8,800 THB. Google: 'Phuket Surf House - Patong Beach', 4.5 from 601 reviews, daily 09:30-24:00. Kata: Google names 4 Soi Pakbang 'WAVA Flow Fit Fun' (4.7, 588), 09:00-22:00; the Phuket 101 page linked is about Super Surf Kata. Coords: Google pin and OSM node 23 m apart; about 265 m north of the Bangla Road beach corner.

items.name: Flying Hanuman (jungle zipline, Kathu)
items.gmapsQuery: Flying Hanuman, Kathu, Phuket
items.bestTime: A morning slot, before the midday heat.
items.openText: Daily 08:00-17:00, last admission 16:00 (official site). Free hotel pickup with all packages.
items.feeText: FH1, 42 platforms and 14 ziplines with a meal: 3,290 THB. FH2, 28 platforms and 7 ziplines: 2,490 THB. FH3 with canopy walk: 1,990 THB. Canopy walk only: 1,500 THB per person (official site, Oct 2026).
items.gettingThere: 89/16 Moo 6, Namtok Kathu, off Wichitsongkram Road in Kathu, between Patong and Phuket Town. About 20-30 min from Kamala or Patong. Hotel pickup is included.
items.description: A zipline park in the old rainforest of Kathu. Guides take groups along platforms high in 100-year-old trees, over sky bridges and down ziplines at up to 60 km/h. The biggest package has 14 ziplines and takes 2-3 hours. An easy, fun half-day for the whole group of 8.
tips: Combo SD3 adds a 30-minute ATV ride for 2,650 THB per person, a simple way to try ATVs with the group.
Wear closed shoes and clothes you can move in. Keep phones in a zip pocket.
Book online a few days ahead in January and choose a morning pickup.
items.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026 on the official site (2026, SKY TREK ADVENTURES Co., Ltd.): open daily 08:00-17:00, last admission 16:00 (added), 89/16 Moo 6 Namtok Kathu, Wichitsongkram Road; package cards: FH1 3,290 THB (42 platforms, 14 ziplines, 4 sky bridges, 2-3 h, meal, transfer), FH2 2,490 (28 platforms, 7 ziplines, 3 sky bridges, 1-2 h), FH3 + canopy 1,990 (12 platforms, 3 ziplines, 30 min-1 h), canopy walk 1,500, SD3 FH3 + 30 min ATV 2,650; 'Free hotel pickup included with all packages'; up to 60 km/h, 100-year-old trees, EN 15567 equipment. The page's hidden schema data still shows older prices (2,990 / 2,290 / 1,490); the visible package cards were used. Google: 4.8 from 2,962 reviews, 08:00-17:00. Coords: Google pin and OSM way 38 m apart.

items.name: Try scuba diving at Racha Yai (Sunrise Divers)
items.coordSource: google-maps-place 'Sunrise Divers Phuket' (cid 1143964270555004102, 7.834997, 98.298055) + osm-node-4772536325 ('Sunrise Divers', 7.834931, 98.29818), 16 m apart; Directions go to the Chalong Pier meeting point (Google 'Chalong Pier Meeting Point', 7.82089, 98.34433), where the boat leaves
items.gmapsQuery: Sunrise Divers Phuket, Patak Road, Karon
items.bestTime: Any day with calm sea. January is the calm season for boat trips. Book a few days ahead.
items.openText: Trips daily. Hotel pickup about 07:15-07:45, boat leaves Chalong Pier at 08:30, back about 15:30 (2 dives) or 18:00 (3 dives). Dive shop Mon-Sat 09:00-17:00, Sun 10:00-15:00 (Google).
items.feeText: Discover Scuba 4,500 THB for 2 dives at Racha Yai, or 5,200 THB for 3 dives at Racha Noi and Yai. Friends who do not dive: 2,000 THB. Gear, insurance, breakfast, lunch and transfers are included (official site).
items.gettingThere: Shop at 269/24 Patak Road, Karon. Free pickup from Patong, Karon and Kata. From Kamala ask about pickup, or take a Grab to Chalong Pier (about 35-45 min in the morning).
items.description: A first dive without a licence. An instructor explains everything on the boat, then takes you down to a maximum of 12 m on the reefs of Racha Yai, about 1.5 hours by boat south of Phuket. It is not a course, just a taster. Friends who do not dive can come on the same boat.
tips: You must be able to swim, feel at ease in water and be healthy. Fill in the 'fit to dive' form before you book.
Do not dive the day after a heavy night. Leave at least 18 hours between diving and a flight (Sunrise Divers).
Certified divers pay 3,000 THB for 2 dives, plus 500 THB for a full gear set.
items.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026 on the official site. Discover Scuba page (changed 28 Jun 2026): 4,500 THB for 2 dives at Racha Yai, 5,200 THB for 3 dives at Racha Noi and Yai, equipment, insurance, breakfast, lunch, drinks and hotel transfers from Patong, Karon or Kata included; not a certification; max depth 12 m; daily; itinerary 07:45 pickup, 08:30 Chalong Pier, 10:00 first dive, back about 15:30, 3-dive trips about 18:00; must be able to swim; 'allow 18 hours before flying'. Day-trip page (changed 4 Aug 2025): certified divers 3,000 THB, gear 500 THB, non-divers 2,000 THB, pickup 07:15-07:45. Park fees are not mentioned. Google: 4.8 from 122 reviews; shop 09:00-17:00, Sun 10:00-15:00. Kamala to Chalong Pier: OSRM 29 min free-flow, so 35-45 min with morning traffic (was 40-50). Directions now go to the Chalong Pier meeting point. Coords: Google pin and OSM node 16 m apart.

items.name: eFoil and kitesurf lessons in Rawai (KBA)
items.coordSource: google-maps-place (cid 2289071027861189487, 7.7951631, 98.3346066; 16, 26 Wiset Rd, the address on the official site); not in OSM
items.gmapsQuery: KBA Kiteboarding Asia Phuket, Wiset Road, Rawai
items.bestTime: January is good kite season in the south: KBA's own chart rates kitesurfing 'excellent' and eFoil 'good' in January.
items.openText: Daily 08:30-18:00 (Google). Wingfoil, eFoil and SUP all year. Kitesurfing in the east-wind season, November to April (official site).
items.feeText: eFoil: 1-hour trial 3,500 THB, 4-hour course 11,000 THB. Kitesurf: 1-hour trial 2,200 THB, 6-hour beginner course 11,000 THB (official site, checked Oct 2026).
items.gettingThere: 26 Wiset Road, Rawai, near Friendship Beach on Chalong Bay. About 30-40 min from Kamala, 25-30 min from Patong.
items.description: A water-sports school in Rawai for thrills without jet skis. An eFoil is an electric board with a hydrofoil: after a short lesson you glide quietly above the water. In January the east wind also makes south Phuket a good place for a first kitesurf lesson. You must be able to swim.
tips: A 1-hour trial shows if you like it. To ride a kite alone you need about 6 hours of lessons (KBA).
Book on WhatsApp +66 93 480 4040, or call the Phuket centre on +66 81 591 4594 (official site).
KBA's Nai Yang centre is open only April to September, so in January go to Rawai.
items.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. Official Phuket page (changed 23 Jun 2026): Rawai centre at 16, 26 Wiset Rd, open year-round for wingfoil, eFoil and SUP, kitesurfing in the easterly wind season November-April; Nai Yang centre (74/10 Nai Yang Beach) open April-September; KBA Phuket centre phone +66 81 591 4594, KBA WhatsApp +66 93 480 4040 (the main line on every KBA page). Lesson pages (changed 1 Dec 2025, the same prices for all KBA centres): eFoil 1-hour trial 3,500 THB, 4-hour course 11,000 THB; kitesurf 1-hour trial 2,200 THB, 6-hour beginner course 11,000 THB, 12-hour full course 20,000 THB; swimming required. KBA Phuket season chart (image viewed): January kite 'Excellent', e-foil 'Good'. Google: 4.7 from 135 reviews, daily 08:30-18:00; Friendship Beach Resort is 450 m away, and the guide's Chalong area notes kite schools on Friendship Beach. Where lessons start on the water is not stated, so meet at the centre. Coords: Google pin only.

items.name: Wat Doi Thepnimit (hilltop temple view over Patong)
items.coordSource: osm-node-5597525622 ('Wat Doi Thep Nimit Monastery', edited 16 Oct 2026) + google-maps-place 'Wat Doi Thepnimit' (cid 8383725867142626010, 7.899331, 98.3184526), 30 m apart; the paved access road (OSM way 699519569) starts beside Pun Thao Kong Shrine (OSM way 1273355150)
items.gmapsQuery: วัดดอยเทพนิมิต, Patong, Kathu, Phuket
items.bestTime: Late afternoon, then sunset dinner at Pensook View Cafe on the way down.
items.openText: Daily 07:00-20:00 (Google Maps, Oct 2026). The chedi is not always open, but you can walk around it (Phuket 101, Apr 2026).
items.feeText: Free. Parking next to the temple.
items.gettingThere: At the top of the Patong-Kathu hill road, turn off beside Pun Tao Kong Shrine (where drivers honk three times), then follow the paved side road up to the temple, about 1 km. About 10-15 min from Patong, 15-25 min from Kamala.
items.description: A quiet hilltop temple above Patong with a wide view over the whole bay. Its white chedi, in a north-eastern Thai style, is ringed by colourful seven-headed naga. You can spot it from the beach. Monks and nuns meditate and sweep here. A calm break from Bangla Road.
tips: Cover shoulders and knees. It is a working temple.
Check the name in Google Maps: Wat Thepnimit, between Phuket Town and Chalong, is a different temple.
Phuket 101 calls Patong Hill 'notoriously dangerous'. Go by car or Grab if you are new to scooters.
items.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. Phuket 101 temple page (updated 4 Apr 2026): free; the new road to it starts at the top of 'the notoriously dangerous Patong Hill', next to the Chinese shrine where everyone honks three times; 'nicely paved for a couple of kilometres'; ample parking; white pagoda in Pra Tat Pra Nom style with colourful seven-headed naga (the photos show naga balustrades around it); panoramic view over Patong Beach; 'you can see its iconic white pagoda from the beach'; pagoda area not always open; monks and nuns; do not confuse with Wat Thepnimit. Phuket 101 gives no scooter advice, so that tip was replaced. Google Maps (not checked by the researcher): 'Wat Doi Thepnimit', 4.8 from 480 reviews, daily 07:00-20:00, pin 30 m from OSM. OpenStreetMap: the concrete road from the shrine to the temple is about 0.7-0.9 km, so 'about 2 km' was changed to 'about 1 km'.

items.name: Pensook View Cafe (Thai food with a Patong Bay view)
items.coordSource: google-maps-place (cid 3306900368026774723, 7.9043537, 98.3205573; owner-managed, the listing Phuket 101 links), on the OSM 'New road' (way 1219848054) that leaves the main road opposite Pun Thao Kong Shrine (OSM way 1273355150), about 180 m along it; the Facebook address is 'ถนนตัดใหม่ หน้าศาลปุ้นเถ๋ากง' (new road, in front of the shrine). The old pin (the shrine itself) was 210 m away
items.gmapsQuery: Pensook View Cafe, Wichitsongkram Road, Kathu, Phuket
items.bestTime: Come about an hour before sunset (about 18:30 in January) for a sea-facing table, and stay for the half hour after, when Patong lights up.
items.openText: 11:00-22:00, closed Wednesday (Phuket 101, Sep 2026, and Google's lunch hours). Google's main hours say 10:30-22:00 every day, so call 087 884 1524 before a Wednesday visit.
items.feeText: Local restaurant prices. A menu with prices is not published online.
items.gettingThere: At the top of the Patong-Kathu hill road, coming from Patong, turn left onto the new concrete side road opposite Pun Tao Kong Shrine. The cafe is a short way along it. Park by the road. About 10 min from Patong, 15-20 min from Kamala.
items.description: A local Southern Thai restaurant on terraces cut into Patong Hill, with the whole of Patong Bay below. Try the sour orange curry with prawns, squid in black ink or the prawn chilli dip with vegetables. Thatched roofs, rattan chairs and room for a group of 8. Best at sunset and just after.
tips: Google Maps routes get confused on this hill. Look for Pun Tao Kong Shrine and take the side road across from it.
When you leave, do not cross the main road. Turn left downhill and make a U-turn.
Staff ask how spicy you want each dish, so say mild if you need it.
Wat Doi Thepnimit, a hilltop temple with a view, is a short drive from the same shrine.
items.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. Phuket 101 page (updated 20 Sep 2026): Pensook View (เพ็ญสุข วิว), Southern Thai, on the Patong Hill road opposite the Pun Tao Kong Shrine, entrance on your left coming from Patong, 'Google Maps gets confused on this stretch', 11:00-22:00, closed Wednesday, phone 087 884 1524, roadside parking, turn left and U-turn when leaving, the dishes, terraces under thatch on bamboo frames, rattan armchairs, 'a group of ten is not a problem', staff ask how spicy. Google Maps place data (owner-managed): 4.6 from 203 reviews, main hours 10:30-22:00 every day, but its separate 'Lunch' hours list Wednesday as closed (11:00-22:00 other days, Thu to 23:00). Facebook page (posts to 18 Oct 2026): address 'new road, in front of Pun Thao Kong Shrine', phone +66 87 884 1524. OSM shows a new concrete road that leaves the main road (Route 4029) opposite the shrine; the Google pin sits on it 180 m in. The researcher pinned the shrine (210 m away, over the 150 m limit), so the pin moved to Google's. Prices are not published.

items.name: Mae Haad Pier (Koh Tao)
items.coordSource: Google Maps listing 'Mae Haad Pier' (3RMF+WP6, 4.1 from 2,873 reviews) at the pier gate; the OSM main pier (way 233493252) is 57 m west and the 'Lomprayah Koh Tao Pier' node 94 m; Google 'Koh Tao Boonsiri Pier' and 'Songserm Pier' are 200-220 m south (re-checked 19 Oct 2026)
items.gmapsQuery: Mae Haad Pier, Ko Tao
items.description: Koh Tao's main port, in Mae Haad village on the west coast. All boats from Koh Phangan, Samui and Chumphon land here. Lomprayah uses the main pier; Boonsiri and Songserm have their own small piers about 200 m south, so check your ticket. Sairee Beach, with the bars, starts about 600 m north.

routes.operator: Boonsiri, from its own pier (sold by Seatran Discovery)

routes.to: Koh Phangan (Songserm's pier in Thong Sala, 300 m from the main pier)
routes.operator: Songserm, from its own pier (sold by Seatran Discovery)
Lomprayah (to its Bangrak pier); Boonsiri (to the Seatran pier, 900 m east)

routes.priceText: about 100-200 THB per person each way (agree first)

items.facilities: Ticket offices, luggage storage, shops, restaurants and dive shops around the pier. Songthaew taxis wait outside (Visit Thailand Today, Sep 2026).
items.gettingThere: Boat only: about 1-1.5 h from Thong Sala on Koh Phangan, or 1.5-2 h from Bangrak on Samui. On Koh Tao, songthaew taxis wait at the pier; Sairee Beach starts about 600 m north.
tips: The last boat to Koh Phangan is the 16:30 Lomprayah ferry (at Thong Sala 18:10). No boats go to Koh Phangan at night, so after a Koh Tao party take a morning boat back.
Boonsiri and Songserm leave from their own piers, about 200 m south of the main pier. Read the pier name on your ticket and be there 30 minutes early.
Day trip from Koh Phangan: the 08:30 Lomprayah (Koh Tao 09:30, Koh Nang Yuan 09:45), back on the 15:30 catamaran or the 16:30 ferry.
Lomprayah also sells Thong Sala - Koh Nang Yuan direct: 08:30 out, 15:00 back from Nang Yuan (Thong Sala 16:45), 600 THB each way.
Only a few seats on the 12:30 speedboat are sold online (5 or fewer on every date checked). Book it early or take a catamaran.

links.label: Koh Tao - Koh Phangan times (Visit Thailand Today, Oct 2026)

items.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. Lomprayah booking system (quota and boat-info data) for 12, 21 and 22 Jan 2027, the same each day: Koh Tao - Thong Sala 09:15 and 09:30 (600 THB, at 10:30; the 09:30 is a catamaran), 12:30 speedboat (700, at 13:30), 15:30 catamaran (600, at 16:45), 16:30 ferry (450, at 18:10, about 1 h 40 min); Koh Tao - Bangrak 09:15 (700, at 11:00), 11:30 (800, at 13:00), 12:30 (800, at 14:10). The 12:30 speedboat showed 1-5 seats on every date, and 5 on 20 Feb 2027 too, so it is a small online allotment, not a sell-out. Lomprayah also sells Thong Sala - Koh Nang Yuan at 08:30 (at 09:45) and Nang Yuan - Thong Sala at 08:30 and 15:00 (at 16:45), 600 THB (20 Jan 2027). Seatran Discovery engine for 21 Jan 2027 (it resells Boonsiri and Songserm): Boonsiri from 'Koh Tao (Boonsiri Sealine ferry pier)' 09:15, 09:45 and 15:15 to Thong Sala (600 THB, 1 h 15 min) and 09:15 and 15:15 to Bangrak (700, 2-2 h 15 min); Songserm from 'Songserm Mae Haad pier' 09:30 to its own Thong Sala pier (500, at 11:30). Google: 'Koh Tao Boonsiri Pier' (10.08299, 99.82377) and 'Songserm Pier' (10.08350, 99.82276) 200-220 m south of the main pier; Boonsiri's Samui office is at the Seatran Bangrak pier, 40 m from it. Facilities: Visit Thailand Today Mae Haad page (Sep 2026). Longtail to Nang Yuan 100-200 THB: Inside Samui (2026). Sairee Beach: OSM beach way 242648106 starts 600 m north. items.name: Visit Panwa Pier (Cape Panwa)
items.coordSource: Google Maps listing 'Visit Panwa Pier' (marina, 88/88 Moo 7 Wichit, 4.5 from 757 reviews); Megatix gives the same address for Sail Away; the OSM bay 'Ao Makham' (centre 500 m south) is the bay the pier sits on (re-checked 19 Oct 2026). 4 m from the guide's coast line and cape-panwa area, so check.mjs passes
items.gmapsQuery: Visit Panwa Pier, Wichit, Phuket
items.description: A private pier on Ao Makham bay at Cape Panwa, in south-east Phuket. Love Andaman's day boats to Phi Phi and Phang Nga Bay start here (breakfast is served before the Phi Phi trips), and the Sail Away boat party leaves every Saturday at 16:00. There are no public ferries: you come with a booked trip.

items.facilities: Love Andaman's check-in desk, with breakfast before its Phi Phi trips (official tour pages). Google lists the pier as a marina, open 06:00-20:00.
items.gettingThere: From Kamala 29 km, Patong 22 km, Rawai 19 km and Old Town 9 km: 33, 25, 22 and 11 min without traffic (OSRM). Allow 45-60 min from Kamala at busy times. Love Andaman sells pickup for 300 THB per person; for Sail Away take a Grab or Bolt.
tips: No public ferries leave here: come with a booked trip (Love Andaman, Sail Away or another tour). Chalong Pier is a different pier, 13 km away by road, so read your voucher.
Sail Away leaves at 16:00 and late guests get no refund. On a Saturday leave Kamala by about 14:30.
Back from Sail Away at about 20:00? Circoloco in Natai is 60 km away, about 65 min without traffic.
Love Andaman's early Phang Nga trip starts at 05:30 (hotel transfer and check-in). Book the pickup or a driver the day before.

items.verification: Fact-checked 19 Oct 2026. Google Maps: 'Visit Panwa Pier' (marina), 88/88 Moo 7 Wichit, 4.5 from 757 reviews, daily 06:00-20:00. Megatix event 28729: venue 'Visit Panwa, 88/88 Mhu 7 Wichit'. phuketferry.com: Visit Panwa (Numchai Pier) on Ao Makham is a private and hotel-access pier, not a public ferry terminal. Love Andaman official pages: Phi Phi + Bamboo (schema price 3,500 THB; pickup 07:00, check-in with breakfast 08:00 at its 'private pier VISIT PANWA', boat 09:00, back at the pier 16:15); its James Bond page (schema price 4,000 THB) says the normal program is unavailable and sends bookings to the early program (05:30 hotel transfer and check-in, 06:15 briefing, 06:30 boat, back at Visit Panwa about 15:00; no price on that page); Phi Phi + Maiton sunset (schema price 4,500 THB; pickup 08:00, check-in with breakfast 09:00, boat 10:00, back 18:20; the page calls the boat a 'speed catamaran' and a 'double-decker boat'); pickup 300 THB per person on all three, though the Maiton page also lists free pickup in a set zone.
